title: Ecommerce Marketing Manager
description:
**Company Description**

YadaSutra Ayurveda is a doctor-led Indian Ayurvedic mother and baby care D2C brand of Neerozhukkil Vaidyasala Pvt. Ltd. (NVPL), built on over 100 years of traditional Ayurvedic legacy. The company focuses on pregnancy care, postpartum wellness, baby care, and Ayurvedic personal care products that combine authentic formulations with modern quality standards. Built for contemporary mothers, YadaSutra blends clinical Ayurvedic expertise, trusted ingredients, and community-led care to support women and babies through every stage of motherhood. Products are available through www.yadasutra.com and leading marketplaces. YadaSutra's vision is to become India's most trusted Ayurveda brand for mother and baby care.

**Role Description**

The E-commerce Marketing Manager – D2C Growth & Team Leadership is a full-time, permanent role based in Bangalore, with an initial 3-month allocation at the Cochin head office. Reporting to the Managing Director, you will run YadaSutra's online store as a business, lead the marketing team behind it, and take ownership of marketing-led revenue.

The role covers the full e-commerce growth engine, from catalogue and conversion to campaigns and customer retention. You will manage the Shopify store (products, collections, landing pages, offers, apps and analytics), keep the catalogue accurate and high quality, and plan inventory with the operations team so bestsellers stay available and slow movers are cleared with the right offers. You will track margins by product and category and guide pricing, discounts and bundles to protect profitability.

You will improve conversion rate, average order value and the full customer journey through A/B tests on landing pages, product pages, offers and checkout, and work with CRM and retention channels such as WhatsApp, email and SMS to drive repeat purchase and lifetime value. You will build marketing strategies and campaign calendars, plan launches and seasonal campaigns, and coordinate performance marketers or agencies, content creators, scriptwriters, video editors and UGC contributors so that media, creative and the store work together. You will guide UGC concepts, ad scripts and creative direction, and build a library of tested creatives and learnings.

As a team leader, you will set targets, delegate responsibilities, run weekly planning and review meetings, coach team members, support hiring, and define KRAs and KPIs with HR. You will track CAC, ROAS, conversion rates and revenue, prepare weekly and monthly reports with clear insights and next actions, and work with finance and management on budgets and the profit impact of marketing decisions. You will also protect the YadaSutra brand voice and visual identity, and make sure all product pages, ads and content follow applicable regulations for Ayurvedic, baby and personal care products and platform policies, avoiding unverifiable health claims and getting messaging approved by the medical team where needed.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 2 to 3 years of experience working directly in D2C brands, ideally in beauty, skincare, personal care, wellness, or mother and baby care.
* Strong hands-on Shopify skills, including products, collections, landing pages, offers, apps and analytics.
* Proven ability to lead and develop a marketing team, including setting targets, delegating, reviewing quality and managing deadlines.
* Strong understanding of D2C e-commerce, including catalogue development, category management, inventory planning and margins.
* Working knowledge of Meta and Google ads, GA4 and D2C unit economics (CAC, LTV, AOV).
* Good understanding of UGC, short-form video, scripting and campaign storytelling.
* Experience with CRM and retention tools (WhatsApp, email, SMS) and with managing agencies or freelancers.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with ownership of results and clear communication.
* Fluency in English; knowledge of Malayalam is an advantage.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Commerce or a related field (MBA preferred).

title: Marketing Analyst
description:
We are looking for a hands-on and data-driven Marketing / Product Analyst who can convert marketing, product, and customer data into actionable business insights.
  
  
You will work closely with Marketing, Product, Sales, and Business teams to analyse acquisition channels, campaign performance, user behaviour, conversion funnels, engagement, retention, and revenue. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with data, solving ambiguous problems, and taking ownership in a fast-paced startup environment.
  
  
Roles and Responsibilities
  
  

* Analyse the complete customer journey, from lead generation and acquisition to engagement, conversion, retention, and revenue.
* Track and analyse marketing performance across Google Ads, Meta Ads, organic, social, referral, and other acquisition channels.
* Monitor key marketing metrics, including impressions, clicks, CPL, CAC, conversion rates, ROAS, ROI, and lead quality.
* Use Google Analytics to understand website traffic, user behaviour, traffic sources, landing-page performance, and conversion events.
* Build and maintain dashboards and reports using Looker Studio and Metabase.
* Analyse product and marketing funnels to identify drop-offs, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Conduct customer segmentation, cohort, retention, and behavioural analyses.
* Partner with Marketing and Product teams to define metrics and measure the impact of campaigns, product changes, and experiments.
* Support A/B testing by defining success metrics, analysing results, and recommending next steps.
* Extract, organise, and analyse data from AWS-based data sources and internal systems.
* Create trackers, reports, and lightweight analytical models using Google Sheets.
* Automate recurring reports and reduce dependency on manual data extraction.
* Validate data accuracy and investigate inconsistencies across dashboards, advertising platforms, and internal reports.
* Translate complex data into clear insights and recommendations for business stakeholders.
* Proactively identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities through data.

**Requirements**

* 1–3 years of experience in marketing analytics, product analytics, growth analytics, business analytics, or a similar role.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of SQL.
* Hands-on experience building dashboards and reports using Looker Studio and Metabase.
* Experience working with Google Ads, Meta Ads, and Google Analytics data.
* Strong working knowledge of Google Sheets, including formulas, pivot tables, lookups, data cleaning, and reporting.
* Exposure to extracting or analysing data hosted on AWS.
* Good understanding of marketing funnels, product funnels, customer journeys, and conversion metrics.
* Understanding of metrics such as CPL, CAC, ROAS, ROI, conversion rate, retention, engagement, and lifetime value.
* Ability to work with large datasets and translate findings into actionable business recommendations.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and attention to detail.
* Ability to communicate insights clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with evolving priorities and ambiguous business problems.
* High ownership, agility, curiosity, and bias for action.

Good to Have
  
  

* Experience with product analytics or engagement tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, MoEngage, or CleverTap.
* Basic knowledge of Python or R for data analysis and automation.
* Experience with campaign attribution, cohort analysis, experimentation, and A/B testing.
* Familiarity with AWS services such as Redshift, Athena, S3, or QuickSight.
* Prior experience in an EdTech, consumer internet, SaaS, e-commerce, or high-growth startup.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Marketing and Product teams have reliable visibility into their key metrics.
* Campaign, channel, and product decisions are supported by data rather than assumptions.
* Funnel leakages and growth opportunities are identified proactively.
* Dashboards and reports are accurate, automated, and easy for stakeholders to use.
* Insights lead to measurable improvements in acquisition, conversion, engagement, retention, or revenue.

title: Director, Product Management
description:

Let’s build the future of mobile telecommunications together!

About Rakuten Group, Inc. (TSE: 4755) is a global leader in internet services that empower individuals, communities, businesses and society. Founded in Tokyo in 1997 as an online marketplace, Rakuten has expanded to offer services in e-commerce, fintech, digital content and communications to 2 billion members around the world. The Rakuten Group has over 30,000 employees, and operations in 30 countries and regions. For more information visit https://global.rakuten.com/corp/.

**About the Role**

Candidate would be reporting to Vice President of Products, responsible for the end-to-end product strategy, business outcomes, customer success, innovation, and commercial growth of the Site Management product portfolio. The role bridges customers, engineering, PLM, sales, solutioning, operations, and executive leadership to deliver measurable business value and competitive differentiation.

**Key Responsibilities**

Product Strategy & Portfolio Leadership

* Define and own the multi-year product vision and strategy for multiple products.
* Align portfolio direction with market trends, customer requirements, and corporate growth objectives.
* Identify opportunities for platform convergence, automation, AI enablement, and operational efficiency.
* Drive product investment priorities, portfolio-level business cases, product KPIs, and success metrics.

Product Roadmap Ownership

* Own quarterly and annual product roadmaps across the portfolio.
* Prioritize features based on customer impact, revenue potential, strategic differentiation, and technical feasibility.
* Balance innovation, technical debt reduction, scalability, and customer commitments.
* Lead roadmap review sessions with executive stakeholders.

Customer & Market Engagement

* Responsible for strategic customers and conduct customer discovery workshops and executive reviews.
* Translate customer pain points into clear product requirements and business outcomes.
* Represent the portfolio in customer meetings, industry forums, analyst interactions, and product demonstrations.
* Gather competitive intelligence and market feedback to guide product positioning and investments.

AI & Automation Leadership

* Drive adoption of AI-powered capabilities across network operations, site management, workforce management, and operational intelligence.
* Identify use cases for predictive analytics, generative AI assistants, workforce optimization, and automation-led efficiency.
* Partner with engineering teams to convert AI opportunities into scalable product capabilities.
* Define measurable business outcomes from AI investments.

Business & Commercial Ownership

* Support PLM and sales teams in strategic opportunities, proposals, and major customer pursuits.
* Contribute to pricing strategy, commercial packaging, and portfolio positioning.
* Identify expansion opportunities across existing deployments.
* Track revenue contribution, product adoption, customer retention, expansion opportunities, and profitability levers.

Cross-Functional Leadership

* Partner with engineering leaders to define release priorities, resolve strategic trade-offs, improve delivery predictability, and ensure platform scalability.
* Align solutioning and delivery teams with roadmap intent, implementation realities, architecture choices, and customer adoption goals.
* Provide regular updates to leadership and influence investment decisions using business and customer data.
* Lead prioritization councils, portfolio governance, roadmap reviews, and KPI tracking.

Team Leadership

* Lead and mentor product managers and business analysts across the portfolio.
* Build a culture of customer obsession, outcome-driven execution, and product excellence.
* Establish product management best practices and operating rhythms.
* Coach teams on product discovery, requirements management, prioritization, and go-to-market planning.

**Required Qualifications**

Education

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or related fields.
* MBA preferred.

Experience

* 15+ years in product management, telecom technology, or enterprise software.
* 7+ years leading product teams or product portfolios.
* Proven experience with telecom OSS, network operations, RAN management, workforce management systems, and enterprise SaaS platforms.
* Demonstrated experience managing executive customer relationships.

Domain Expertise

* Telecom network operations and Radio Access Networks (RAN).
* Site lifecycle management and field workforce management.
* Network performance, analytics, AI/ML-driven operational automation, cloud-native architectures, and enterprise integration ecosystems.

Success Metrics – First 12 Months

* Strategic customer satisfaction and measurable customer value delivered.
* Product adoption, usage growth, roadmap predictability, and release quality.
* AI feature adoption and business impact.
* Reduction in customer pain points and escalations.
* Portfolio profitability improvement.
* Team engagement and leadership effectiveness.

**RAKUTEN SHUGI PRINCIPLES:**

Our worldwide practices describe specific behaviours that make Rakuten unique and united across the world. We expect Rakuten employees to model these 5 Shugi Principles of Success.

* **Always improve, always advance.**
  Only be satisfied with complete success - Kaizen.
* **Be passionately professional.**
  Take an uncompromising approach to your work and be determined to be the best.
* **Hypothesize - Practice - Validate - Shikumika.**
  Use the Rakuten Cycle to success in unknown territory.
* **Maximize Customer Satisfaction.**
  The greatest satisfaction for workers in a service industry is to see their customers smile.
* **Speed!! Speed!! Speed!!**
  Always be conscious of time. Take charge, set clear goals, and engage your team.

title: Demand Generation Manager

title: Growth Marketing Leader - APAC
description:
Ascendion is a fast-growth, AI-native software engineering company redefining how software, platforms, and intelligent agents are built and delivered at scale. We are hiring a
**Growth Marketing Leader for India**
to drive above-market growth through disciplined field marketing, account-based programs, and tight pursuit support that directly enables our sales and markets teams.
  
  
This role is for a builder hungry to make a mark and capable of operating at speed inside a global services business that is scaling fast.
  
  
This role has two distinct responsibilities.
  
  

* Growth marketing for Ascendion across India and APAC growth markets. This is field marketing, pipeline generation, pursuit support, and brand activation, with your feet on the ground. 80% of your time goes here (India and APAC growth markets; e.g., Singapore).
* Global portfolio marketing for our Global Capability Center offering. This means building the category narrative and go-to-market motion for an offering that's sold and delivered worldwide, not just out of India. 20% of your time will be here. That balance will shift as the business scales, creating meaningful opportunity for expanded scope.

****What You'll Own And Drive****
*Field Marketing and Pipeline Generation (Primary Accountability)*
***Essential Responsibilities:***

* Own the field marketing engine for India: ABM programs, in-person and virtual events, executive engagement, and pursuit-aligned marketing that directly supports active deals.
* Partner daily with the Markets (Sales) team — not as a service function, but as a force multiplier. You are in the room, on the pursuit, at the client.
* Build and run account-based programs targeting named accounts and key verticals with precision. Volume without targeting is noise.
* Orchestrate integrated GTM motions: campaigns, sales enablement materials, roundtables, and executive-level engagement that shorten cycles and strengthen positions.
* Bring a sales-adjacent mindset to everything. You understand how deals are won. You build marketing that helps win them.

***Anticipated Impact:***

* Growth in influenced pipeline from India and APAC Growth Market regions via events, executive connects, campaigns, and account-based marketing.
* Increase in net-new logo additions from India and APAC Growth Market regions influenced by marketing.
* Growth in pipeline sourced specifically through marketing-led events.

*Pursuit Support*
***Essential Responsibilities:***

* Embed directly into active pursuits alongside sales leadership. Translate Ascendion's capabilities into compelling, buyer-relevant narratives under real time pressure.
* Support RFP responses, pursuit decks, and executive briefing materials where marketing has a tangible role in the outcome.
* Ensure every pursuit has the right story, the right evidence, and the right differentiation — not boilerplate.

***Anticipated Impact:***

* Increase in the number and TCV of active pursuits directly supported by marketing (proposals, solutioning, asset development, presentations).
* Higher conversion of marketing-supported pursuits into bookings, measured in both count and TCV.

*Brand Activation in Market (India)*
***Essential Responsibilities:***

* Activate and localize the Ascendion brand across India: analysts, media, digital, social, and executive visibility.
* Work in close coordination with the global brand and content team — your role is to adapt and amplify global positioning for India audiences, not to operate independently of it.
* Build market presence that earns credibility with buyers and feeds the pipeline.

***Anticipated Impact:***

* Brand visibility and credibility in India and key APAC markets reflected in media coverage, analyst recognition, and share of voice versus competitors.
* Growth in digital and social engagement in-market (e.g., site traffic, LinkedIn engagement, executive visibility, campaigns) leading to pipeline.
* Meaningful contribution to Ascendion's APAC growth target through market presence that builds buyer credibility.

**Portfolio Marketing: Global GCC-AI Offering (~20% of role)**
Ascendion is already delivering global capability center (GCC) services globally. We're deploying AI platforms to improve how GCC work is done. For clients, this means faster innovation, process transparency, productivity, and capital unlock. We anticipate this will be a powerful growth engine for the firm. GCC pipeline is a shared metric that will be co-owned with a dedicated sales leader
  
  
***Essential Responsibilities:***

* Build and execute the go-to-market and portfolio marketing strategy for our GCC services, positioning our AI-enabled delivery model against traditional GCC and outsourcing competitors.
* Develop messaging and positioning that translates our AI-driven delivery advantage into buyer-relevant value for CXO and procurement audiences across target geographies.
* Partner with sales and delivery leadership to build enablement assets (case studies, ROI models, competitive battlecards, video assets, thought leadership, etc.) to support this fast-growing offering.
* Design and run demand generation campaigns (digital, events, ABM) targeting enterprise buyers evaluating GCC strategies globally.

***Anticipated Impact:***

* Marketing-influenced GCC pipeline globally.
* Stronger message resonance in sales win/loss feedback.
* Sales team adoption of enablement materials.
* Greater analyst and brand recognition in target segments.

****Who This Role Is For****
This role is designed for someone with experience and on the rise. You likely have:
  
  

* 10+ years of experience in B2B technology marketing, with increasing scope and impact over time.
* A genuine services background. You have worked inside a global technology services firm — consulting, IT services, managed services, or professional services — and you understand how those businesses sell, how clients buy, and what "pursuit" actually means.
* Hands-on field marketing experience: running events, executing ABM programs, building enablement materials, and supporting sales in live deals. Not managing agencies at arm's length.
* A sales-adjacent orientation. You may have started in sales, or worked so closely with sales teams that you think like one. You are not intimidated by revenue targets. You are energized by them.
* Experience working across global teams and adapting global strategy for regional markets without losing clarity or consistency.
* Comfort operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where impact matters more than process.

You are a field and growth marketer with the credibility to walk into a client conversation or a pursuit review and add immediate value.
  
  
****What We're Specifically Looking For****

* Proven track record driving pipeline and pursuit outcomes in India markets (with numbers to back it).
* Demonstrated experience in a global technology services environment.
* Evidence of hands-on execution: events run, ABM programs built, sales enablement delivered, pursuits supported. Supervision and delegation are fantastic, but we are looking for people who roll up their sleeves and personally get things done.
* High engagement as a working style. You actively seek contact with the Markets team. You are in the meetings, on the calls, at the events. You complement and enable sales. You are highly proactive.
* A history of shifting how a company is perceived in a market through consistent, disciplined storytelling.
* Ability to work fluidly within a global marketing structure: aligning to global brand standards and content direction while executing with regional relevance.
* Comfortable engaging external analysts, clients, and partners as well as internal stakeholders including senior global and regional leadership.
* Fluency in AI-powered marketing tools and workflows. High motivation to do more by leveraging all that AI can offer (without losing the human-touch impact).

And also…
**We need evidence of personal storytelling capability.**
We will review recent work product (where permitted) from 2-3 prior employers or engagements.

title: Lead Marketing Scientist
description:
**About the Role**

Lifesight is seeking a Lead Marketing Scientist to head a team of marketing scientists in developing advanced econometric and statistical models that solve complex marketing measurement problems. The role is anchored in scientific rigor and demands strong foundations in econometrics, causal inference, and statistical learning.

You will focus on building robust, interpretable, and scalable models — particularly in Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) — while ensuring causal validity and statistical soundness. Beyond hands-on modeling, you will mentor a team of data scientists and shape the evolution of measurement methodologies across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Econometric Modeling & MMM Development**

* Lead the design and implementation of Marketing Mix Models (MMM), formulating business problems as rigorous quantitative and statistical models.
* Build models using regression-based approaches (linear and non-linear), time series methods for trend, seasonality, and forecasting, and Bayesian and hierarchical modeling frameworks.
* Incorporate core marketing science constructs, including adstock and lag effects, saturation and diminishing returns, and external drivers and control variables.
* Ensure statistical robustness through proper model specification, parameter stability and interpretability, and sensitivity analysis.

**Causal Inference & Measurement Design**

* Apply causal inference methods such as difference-in-differences, synthetic control, and experimental and quasi-experimental designs.
* Design and evaluate incrementality frameworks, including geo experiments and holdout testing.
* Address endogeneity, confounding, and bias in observational datasets to ensure causal validity of model outputs.

**Statistical Validation & Diagnostics**

* Perform rigorous model validation, including residual analysis and diagnostics, multicollinearity checks, and out-of-sample and cross-validation.
* Evaluate model performance using appropriate statistical metrics and ensure alignment with business outcomes.

**Analytical Frameworks & Model Integration**

* Develop integrated measurement frameworks that combine MMM, attribution, and experimentation.
* Apply machine learning techniques where they enhance model performance without compromising interpretability.
* Build scalable, reusable modeling approaches that strengthen the organization’s measurement methodology.

**Scientific Communication**

* Translate complex statistical outputs into structured, interpretable insights for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Clearly articulate model assumptions, limitations, and implications, and support decision-making with evidence-based recommendations.

**Team Leadership & Capability Building**

* Lead and mentor a team of data scientists, establishing best practices in statistical modeling, code quality, and reproducibility.
* Build team capability in advanced topics such as Bayesian modeling, causal inference, and experimental design.

**Research, Delivery & Collaboration**

* Stay current with advancements in econometrics, marketing science, causal inference, and statistical learning, and implement improved methodologies that enhance modeling accuracy and reliability.
* Manage multiple analytical projects to defined timelines and quality standards.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure modeling outputs align with business needs.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* **Experience:**
  8–12 years in advanced analytics, econometrics, or marketing science, with strong hands-on experience in Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM).
* **Technical expertise:**
  Econometrics and regression modeling; time series analysis and forecasting; causal inference and experimental design; Bayesian statistics and hierarchical modeling (preferred).
* **Programming & tools:**
  Proficiency in Python or R, with strong experience in SQL and working with large datasets.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s or PhD in Statistics, Econometrics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
* Experience in marketing analytics or advertising measurement.
* Exposure to SaaS-based analytics platforms.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong quantitative and analytical reasoning, with scientific rigor and attention to detail.
* Structured problem-solving and the ability to formulate ambiguous business questions as tractable statistical problems.
* Clear, precise communication of technical concepts to diverse audiences.
* Ability to mentor and develop scientific talent.

**What Success Looks Like**

* You create/help create statistically sound, interpretable MMM models delivered within Lifesight’s methodology framework.
* You Improve modeling efficiency by leveraging best-in-class AI to automate tasks and reduce manual effort.
* You help create a high-performing, well-mentored team of marketing science professionals at lifesight.
* Our clients are consistently satisfied and trust and act on our measurement insights.

title: Digital Quality Analyst - Marketing Tech Team
description:
At Columbia, we’re as passionate about the outdoors as you are. And while our gear is available worldwide, we’re proud to be based in the Pacific Northwest, where natural wonders are our playground.
  
  
Every product we make and every task we undertake is inspired by the famous words of our founder Gert Boyle: “It’s perfect. Now make it better.” As pioneers of relentless improvement, we are constantly evolving.
  
  
We believe the outdoors is ours to protect and strive to keep our planet healthy. We believe in empowering people to experience the outdoors to the fullest.
  
  
And we believe in you.
  
  
**About The Position**
Although we're an apparel and footwear-focused company, technology is central to everything we do. Columbia Sportswear’s Digital Technology (CDT) group enables an IT infrastructure and applications across four global brands, a global supply chain, and 500+ geographically dispersed stores. These teams support in-store, mobile, and data platforms to enhance customer interface and service in an ever-evolving industry.
  
  
The Quality Analyst II has a solid understanding of technology platforms and utilizes best practices among the quality team. This person reviews test strategies, authors test plans, and authors and executes test cases. The Quality Analyst II uses a variety of testing tools and methods and updates or creates automated test cases. The role executes automated test scripts and identify process and/ technology issues.
  
  
**How You’ll Make a Difference**

* Communication, Collaboration & Leadership: Communicates status in daily meetings, fosters constructive, collaborative and effective communication with others, both internally and externally. Actively participates in design discussions, planning, and retrospective reviews. Explains and simplifies complex information to others.
* Knowledge: Ensures processes are clearly documented. Demonstrates a basic understanding of the functions and technologies of the product. Learns about multiple test techniques, tools and business context and technologies of the software used. Addresses problems, proposes solutions, and takes action to resolve, referring more complex issues to senior employees.
* Metrics: Creates and monitors status dashboards for tracking team progress
* Quality Standards: Drives analysis of post release quality and defect escapes and implements improvements based on the results of analysis. Completes straightforward projects and provides input for enhancements to improve test coverage and processes. Assesses the testability of components and features built by development teams. Works with project team to establish quality standards or metrics and identify risks.
* Test Strategy & Planning: Identifies salient test cases based on product domain knowledge and traceability to use cases, enabling on-time sprint deployments. Writes effective and efficient test scripts and test cases. Reviews of test plans are thoughtful and considerate of the customer and time frames needed for releases.
* Test Execution: Ensures thorough and complete resolution and closure of tickets once deployed to production. Assists developers in desk checks and testing. Works with the team to ensure code is tested at the appropriate level, assists in gaining efficiencies. Identifies and prevents defects early. Proactively works to identify the root cause of problems and identifies efficient ways to reproduce issues. Contributes to bug triage and prioritization processes.
* Mentorship: Provides peer level technical guidance for team members. Helps more junior team members learn, grow and contribute to the team.

**YOU ARE**

* Genuinely curious — you ask why, not just whether. You want to understand why a tag fires in a specific sequence, what the Liquid personalization token is supposed to render for a given profile, and what a consent mode change means downstream for pixel data. You treat every testability gap as a signal worth investigating, not an obstacle to work around.
* Shift-left by default. You don't wait for a build to find problems. You read acceptance criteria like an auditor — spotting what's missing, what's ambiguous, and what will create a defect if it isn't clarified before dev starts. Refinement is where your value shows up first.
* A master of async defect communication. You file bugs the way a distributed team needs you to — self-contained, structured, and immediately actionable. A QA defect in your queue is never a mystery that needs a Zoom call to decode. Your documentation is your reputation.
* Globally minded, with experience working on geographically distributed teams. You understand the discipline, cadence, and over-communication required to make a US–India collaboration genuinely cohesive — and you've built those habits in practice.
* Methodical and detail-oriented — you understand that a missed pixel fire or a broken personalization token has real downstream consequences for marketing measurement and campaign performance. You bring that care to every test case you write and every defect you file.
* A collaborative teammate, comfortable working across engineering, product, analytics, and marketing functions within a globally distributed model. You don't stay in a QA swim lane — you go where quality needs attention.

**YOU HAVE**

* Bachelor’s Degree required Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.
* 4+ years’ experience
* Proficiency with Postman for API testing — structured request/response validation, test data generation, role-based access checks, and SLA timing verification.
* Experience with email QA — template render testing using Email on Acid, Litmus, or equivalent; familiarity with ESP platform testing (Zeta, Braze, Emarsys, or similar).
* Working knowledge of tag management QA — understanding what tag management systems do, how to use browser developer tools to validate tag fires, and how to read data layer objects against a specification. Experience with the Adobe Experience Platform Debugger or equivalent tag debugging tooling is strongly preferred.
* Solid understanding of agile/Scrum delivery — shift-left quality practices, sprint ceremony participation, Definition of Ready and Definition of Done as quality gates, QA sizing in sprint planning.
* Experience with Jira for defect tracking, defect lifecycle management, and sprint ticket status workflows.
* Experience testing across a multi-phase test lifecycle: QA → SIT → UAT → E2E → Production validation.
* Demonstrated experience working on a globally distributed or cross-timezone team — including a US–India GCC model, offshore delivery, or equivalent. Prior experience collaborating with remote stakeholders is strongly preferred.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills — including the ability to write async-friendly defect reports, test status updates, and QA documentation that remote teammates can act on independently without a live call.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with Adobe Analytics validation — understanding how events, eVars, props, and conversion metrics are captured and how to confirm accuracy against a measurement plan (SDR).
* Familiarity with OneTrust or consent management platforms and how they gate tag firing (GDPR/CCPA context).
* Experience testing on Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) — navigating Business Manager for test data setup, order creation, and profile configuration.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipeline integration for test automation — CircleCI, GitHub Actions, or equivalent; understanding of artifact reporting and suite segmentation (smoke, regression, integration).
* Exposure to Liquid templating in ESP platforms — ability to validate personalization logic and token rendering in email templates.

description:
The Choosy Investor simplifies real estate investing in India, focusing entirely on consumer interests in the real estate sector. Through syndicate investing, the company negotiates bulk discounts for buyers by aggregating multiple interested investors. They work only with trustworthy, legally vetted properties and provide seamless site visit coordination, complete with premium customer support. Offering zero brokerage services, The Choosy Investor guides clients through the entire home-buying process, including legal procedures and home loan assistance, ensuring an optimized and hassle-free investment experience.

This is a Hybrid/Onsite contract role for a Senior Performance Marketing Expert. The role involves developing and executing digital marketing campaigns, optimizing marketing strategies for social media and other online platforms, and analyzing campaign performance to meet organizational goals. Responsibilities also include collaborating with the sales team to drive revenue growth and contributing to strategy discussions for market positioning.

Scaling high-performance campaigns across Meta (Advantage+), Google (Search, PMax, Display), and LinkedIn.

Leveraging Taboola and Outbrain to drive top-of-funnel awareness and mid-funnel intent via discovery-based placements.

Implementing server-side tracking, CAPI, and multi-touch attribution to accurately map the real estate buyer's journey.

**Funnel Optimization:**

Engineering high-converting landing pages and lead-capture flows with constant A/B testing.

AI tools: Should be able to use AI tools to increase daily work efficiency.

description:
**Full job description**

**Designer**

**About Finiteloop**

Finiteloop is a technology and design studio helping organisations build, transform, and scale with engineering, AI, and design working as one integrated capability. We are looking for people who are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment designing and developing physical and digital products and experiences.
**The design studio works in digital and physical spaces and will have a wide range of opportunities to be creative and experiment**

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a hands-on Designer and a social media manager who shapes experiences. You will be embedded in delivery — working alongside business enterprise leaders, engineers, AI developers, and client teams to design interfaces, identities, and experiences that are intuitive, accessible, and build physical and digital products as well as create social media content and manage social media. Some of the opportunities to work on physical products are www.stepsaside.in and www.openego.in

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Be an original works creator. Ability to implement original ideas for branding and with a highly evolved aesthetic taste. Knowledge of various styles of design and historical evolution of design, and able to deliver design across multiple styles.**

* Design high-fidelity mockups and prototypes using latest tools
* Conduct field research, user interviews, and usability testing before getting a single output. Collaborate with Developers and front-end engineers to ensure faithful implementation of designs.
* Build and maintain scalable design systems with reusable components and design tokens. Design AI-specific interaction patterns: data visualisations, and intelligent assistants.
* Work directly with clients across industries (maritime, FMCG, enterprise, manufacturing, automation) to translate real workflows into design solutions.
* **Develop and execute branding identities that hold across digital, physical, and time — from visual language to brand systems.**
  Ability to use tools like Photoshop, illustrator, video editing tools, Figma , Canva efficiently to create works. Any skills in animation and motion graphics is an added advantage
* **Design for digital, print and packaging is an important part of this role — the same research-grounded rigour that applies to digital touchpoints applies equally to physical ones. Every surface matters.**
* Ensure designs meet WCAG 2.1 accessibility standards.
* Contribute to Finiteloop's design thinking, frameworks, and IP that reflect how we approach experience design. Adopt other design systems when necessary.
* Good understanding of designing for Digital marketing and social media. Excellent communication design capabilities.
* **Ability to strategize and manage social media fully**
* **Do field work for research, printing and packaging and product development.**

**Required Qualifications**

* 2-3 years of design experience across digital and physical products and brand design.
* **Strong portfolio with demonstrable experience working on both physical and digital products — end-to-end UX process, high-quality visual design, branding, print, and packaging work across mediums.**
* Solid understanding of branding principles — visual identity, typography, colour systems, and brand guidelines.
* **Experience in print and packaging design;**
  understanding of production requirements, print specifications, and material considerations.
* Proficiency conducting user research, usability testing, and synthesising qualitative and quantitative data.
* Solid understanding of design systems and design thinking, design processes, atomic design principles, and library based working.
* Knowledge of WCAG 2.1 accessibility standards and inclusive design practices.
* Excellent communication skills — able to present and defend design decisions clearly to both technical teams and non-technical client stakeholders. Work on editorial design and work seamlessly with content writers.
* Able to work with minimal supervision, take ownership of the design process end to end, and drive work forward independently. Eye for detail.
* Comfortable in a consulting/studio environment — multi-client, fast-context-switching, outcome-focused. Ability to take stretch goals.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience designing with AI
* Familiarity with Design Systems
* Exposure to field research methodologies.
* Experience in industrial or product design — physical objects designed with the same rigour as digital ones.
* Background in Agile or iterative delivery environments; comfortable with short cycles and visible progress.

Please share any dribble or behance references / portfolio website.

Location : Bangalore, No remote work.

If you are in South Bangalore, you have a locational advantage.

**Why This Role at Finiteloop**

We are seeking a hands-on Designer who shapes experiences. You will have scope to experiment with all aspects of design. From Research to seeing your design implemented in physical products. From communication design to see it work in a digital marketing driving sales.

We are also honest about what we value. Have a look at our culture code at finiteloop.ai/culturecode and evaluate your fitment in our environment.

title: EYP-CorpStrat-Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Associate Director, Strategy & Execution, Consumer Products and Retail, EY-Parthenon GDS India**
At EY, we develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We empower you in a flexible environment and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
We work together across our full spectrum of services and skills, powered by technology and AI, so that business, people and the planet can thrive together.
  
  
We’re all in, are you?
  
  
Join EY and shape your future with confidence.
  
  
**The opportunity**
The Strategy & Execution team in EY-Parthenon recognizes that CEOs and business leaders are tasked with achieving maximum value for their organizations’ stakeholders in a transformative business environment. We challenge assumptions to design and deliver strategies that improve profitability, strengthen competitiveness and create long-term value.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced strategy consulting professional to join EY-Parthenon GDS India as an Associate Director within the Consumer Products and Retail sector.
  
  
You will be based in EY GDS India and work as an integrated member of the Singapore Strategy & Execution team, primarily supporting client engagements across Singapore and the wider ASEAN region.
  
  
This is a client-facing consulting and leadership role. You will work closely with EY-Parthenon teams and clients across ASEAN to develop and deliver strategic opportunities, drawing on market, competitor and customer insights and incorporating commercial, operational, financial and implementation perspectives.
  
  
The role provides the opportunity to work on complex, cross-border engagements, develop relationships with senior stakeholders and contribute to building EY-Parthenon’s Consumer Products and Retail capabilities across Singapore, ASEAN and GDS India.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Client engagement and delivery**

* Lead client engagements, major workstreams or independent modules across strategy, commercial transformation and operational transformation assignments.
* Structure complex business problems, develop hypotheses and define robust approaches to address clients’ strategic and operational priorities.
* Lead the collection and analysis of quantitative and qualitative information, translate findings into insights and formulate practical recommendations.
* Take ownership of the quality, timeliness and commercial relevance of project deliverables.
* Work directly with client stakeholders to understand their priorities, align on project objectives and communicate emerging findings and recommendations.
* Lead or contribute to client discussions, working sessions, presentations and senior stakeholder meetings.
* Develop clear, compelling and evidence-based presentations and reports for senior client audiences.
* Work effectively with geographically dispersed engagement teams, coordinating closely with colleagues in Singapore, GDS India and other ASEAN markets.

**Strategy and transformation**
You will work across a range of strategy and transformation engagements, which may include:
  
  

* Market entry and growth strategy
* Go-to-market strategy
* Revenue growth management
* Commercial transformation
* Digital and AI-led transformation
* Commercial due diligence
* Post-merger integration
* Divestment strategy and execution
* Cost and organization transformation
* Supply chain and procurement transformation
* Sales and operations planning
* Retail commercial and operational transformation
* Turnaround strategy and rapid value creation

**Team leadership and capability development**

* Lead, coach and develop teams working across GDS India, Singapore and the wider EY-Parthenon network.
* Provide clear direction, constructive feedback and day-to-day support to team members.
* Contribute to building a strong Consumer Products and Retail capability within EY-Parthenon GDS India.
* Support recruitment, onboarding, learning and broader capability-development initiatives.
* Help strengthen collaboration and knowledge sharing between the Singapore and GDS India teams.
* Promote an inclusive, high-performing team environment focused on development, quality and client impact.

**Business and practice development**

* Support the development of ASEAN-focused proposals, credentials and other business-development materials.
* Contribute sector insights and subject-matter expertise to pursuit teams and client discussions.
* Help identify opportunities to deepen existing client relationships and support the development of new relationships.
* Contribute to the continued growth of the Strategy & Execution practice and its Consumer Products and Retail portfolio across ASEAN.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
To succeed in this role, you should be able to:
  
  

* Lead complex strategy and transformation workstreams with limited supervision.
* Combine rigorous analysis with sound commercial judgment and practical recommendations.
* Communicate complex ideas clearly and confidently to senior internal and client stakeholders.
* Build trusted working relationships across different organizations, markets and cultures.
* Manage multiple priorities and maintain high standards in a fast-paced, project-based environment.
* Lead, motivate and develop diverse teams operating across locations.
* Collaborate effectively with Singapore-based and wider ASEAN engagement teams.
* Demonstrate a strong understanding of the strategic, commercial and operational issues affecting Consumer Products and Retail businesses.
* Adapt your working approach to different client, cultural and market contexts.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* A bachelor’s degree from a recognized institution. A master’s degree or MBA is preferred.
* At least six years of relevant professional experience, including significant experience in a strategy consulting firm or a closely related consulting environment.
* Demonstrated experience in the Consumer Products and Retail sector.
* Experience leading substantial workstreams, project modules or client engagements.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical and financial analysis skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience developing and presenting materials for senior stakeholders.
* Experience managing and developing consulting teams.
* The ability to work effectively with colleagues and clients across locations, functions and cultures.
* A willingness and ability to travel internationally in line with client and engagement requirements.

**Relevant Consumer Products And Retail Experience**
Relevant experience should include one or more of the following areas:
  
  

* Corporate, portfolio, market entry or growth strategy
* Go-to-market strategy and commercial transformation
* Revenue growth management
* Digital and AI-led business transformation
* Cost reduction and operating-model transformation
* Supply chain and procurement transformation
* Sales and operations planning
* Retail commercial or operational transformation
* Commercial due diligence, post-merger integration or value creation

**Ideally, you will also have**

* Previous experience working with clients or consulting teams in Singapore, ASEAN or other international markets.
* Experience operating as part of a cross-border or globally integrated consulting team.
* Familiarity with the business environment, consumer trends and market dynamics of Singapore and the wider ASEAN region.
* Experience supporting consulting proposals, business development and client pursuits.
* Experience building sector capabilities, coaching teams or contributing to recruitment and learning initiatives.
* Strong executive presence and the ability to establish credibility with senior client stakeholders.

**Regional exposure and ways of working**

* The role requires close collaboration with colleagues and clients across ASEAN, with reasonable flexibility to accommodate regional engagement requirements.
* Periodic travel to Singapore and other ASEAN markets will be required, depending on client and engagement needs. This may include short-duration on-site assignments at different stages of an engagement.
* The successful candidate should be comfortable working in an integrated regional team, building relationships remotely and in person, and adapting to the requirements of cross-border client engagements.
* Strong performers may be considered for future international mobility opportunities, subject to business requirements, performance, immigration requirements and applicable firm policies.

**What We Offer You**
We will fuel your ambition and potential with future-focused skills development that equips you with state-of-the-art methodologies and technology-enabled solutions. With more than 25,000 people in 150 countries, you will join an inclusive and empowering culture that values your uniqueness, prioritizes your wellbeing, and immerses you in the diverse thinking and cross-cultural experiences necessary to help deliver impact to clients across the globe and help build a better working world.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: BTL Assistant Manager -Marketing
description:
Job Description: Assistant Manager / Manager – BTL Marketing
  
  
Business Vertical: Wires & Cables
  
  
Company: Sturlite
  
  
Department: Marketing
  
  
Position: Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager / Manager
  
  
Experience: 6 to 8 years of relevant experience
  
  
Reporting To: Head – BTL Marketing
  
  
Location: Bangalore, India
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a dynamic and execution-oriented BTL Marketing professional to drive below-the-line marketing initiatives for Sturlite’s Wires & Cables business. The role will focus on strengthening brand visibility and market presence, enhancing channel engagement, influencing purchase decisions, and driving business growth through targeted trade marketing initiatives and on-ground activations.
  
  
The incumbent will work closely with sales teams, channel partners, distributors, dealers, retailers, electricians, contractors, and other relevant stakeholders to plan and execute impactful BTL programs across key markets.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* BTL Strategy & Execution
* Plan and execute BTL marketing initiatives aligned with business objectives, brand strategy, and sales priorities.
* Develop and implement market-specific activation plans to improve brand awareness, product visibility, and consumer preference.
* Drive on-ground marketing activities, including market activations, promotional campaigns, product demonstrations, roadshows, and local events.
* Ensure timely and effective execution of campaigns across identified markets and sales territories.
* Channel & Trade Marketing
* Design and execute dealer, distributor, and retailer engagement programs to strengthen channel relationships and improve brand preference.
* Develop trade promotion schemes, retail visibility initiatives, point-of-sale (POS) materials, merchandising programs, and in-shop branding.
* Identify opportunities to improve product visibility and brand recall at electrical retail outlets and channel partner locations.
* Collaborate with sales teams to support market expansion, channel activation, new product launches, and achieve business targets.
* Electrician, Contractor & Influencer Engagement
* Plan and execute engagement programs for electricians, electrical contractors, installers, and other key purchase influencers.
* Organize electrician meets, contractor meets, product awareness sessions, technical demonstrations, loyalty programs, and recognition initiatives.
* Support the development of influencer engagement and advocacy programs to improve brand consideration and product recommendations.
* Build and maintain engagement calendars for key influencer segments across priority markets.
* Market Development & Competitor Intelligence
* Work closely with regional and territory sales teams to identify market opportunities and prioritize BTL investments.
* Conduct market visits to assess brand visibility, channel engagement, competitor activities, and effectiveness of existing programs.
* Track competitor promotions, trade schemes, retailer engagement initiatives, and market activation practices.
* Translate field insights into actionable recommendations for improving marketing effectiveness and market penetration.
* Agency & Vendor Management
* Coordinate with activation agencies, event partners, printers, fabricators, and other vendors for campaign execution.
* Develop campaign briefs, evaluate vendor proposals, and ensure quality, cost efficiency, and adherence to timelines.
* Monitor execution quality through field visits, photographic evidence, campaign reports, and stakeholder feedback.
* Ensure adherence to company brand guidelines, procurement processes, and vendor compliance requirements.
* Budgeting & Performance Measurement
* Assist in developing and managing the annual and monthly BTL marketing budgets.
* Track campaign expenditure, vendor payments, and budget utilization against approved plans.
* Define and monitor KPIs such as outlet coverage, number of activations, influencer participation, campaign reach, visibility compliance, cost per activation, and lead or sales contribution wherever measurable.
* Prepare periodic performance dashboards and post-campaign reports, highlighting outcomes, learnings, and improvement opportunities.
* Evaluate the effectiveness and ROI of BTL activities and recommend optimization measures.
* Cross-functional Coordination
* Collaborate with sales, product management, brand marketing, regional marketing, and supply chain teams to ensure integrated execution.
* Support new product launches, seasonal campaigns, regional promotions, and market specific business initiatives.
* Ensure availability of marketing collateral, promotional materials, and campaign-related product information at the right locations and time.
* Share regular updates on campaign progress, market feedback, and key business opportunities with the BTL Head.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely execution of planned BTL activities and campaigns.
* Dealer, retailer, electrician, contractor engagement and participation.
* Retail outlet coverage and quality of in-store branding and visibility.
* Effectiveness of trade promotions and market activation programs.
* Campaign expenditure versus approved budgets.
* Cost efficiency and measurable return on BTL investments.
* Improvement in brand visibility and preference across target markets.
* Contribution to lead generation, channel productivity, and sales growth, wherever attributable.
* Quality and timeliness of campaign reporting and market intelligence.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Education:

MBA/PGDM in Marketing or a relevant postgraduate qualification; candidates with a strong track record in trade marketing or BTL execution may also be considered.
  
  

* Experience:

Approximately 6 to 8 years of relevant experience in BTL marketing, trade marketing, channel marketing, or field marketing.
  
  

* Experience in electricals, wires and cables, building materials, lighting, paints, adhesives, consumer durables, or a similar channel-driven industry is preferred.
* Hands-on experience in dealer and retailer activation, influencer engagement, trade promotions, vendor management, and on-ground campaign execution.
* Experience working with regional sales teams and managing multiple markets or territories is desirable.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong execution, planning, and project management skills.
* Understanding distributors, dealers, retailers, and influencer ecosystems.
* Good commercial acumen, budgeting, and vendor negotiation skills.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to analyze campaign performance and derive actionable insights.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with marketing dashboards and reporting tools is an advantage.
* Willingness to travel extensively across assigned markets.
* High ownership, accountability, and ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.

title: Manager - AI GTM and Market Intelligence
description: About GoKwikGoKwik is a growth operating system for D2C and eCommerce brands, enabling checkout optimization, RTO reduction, payments, retention, and post-purchase engagement. Today, GoKwik powers 15,000+ merchants globally, processes ~$2 billion in GMV, and continues to strengthen its AI-powered infrastructure across India, the UK, Europe, and the US.Why This Role MattersMost GTM teams wait for demand to declare itself. This role builds the systems that find it first. As Manager — AI GTM and Market Intelligence, you will own the engine that identifies high-fit D2C merchants before they raise a hand, the internal tools Marketing and Sales rely on daily to see what our spend is actually producing, and the proprietary data stories that establish GoKwik’s authority in the market. This is a builder’s role rather than an analyst’s: the output is working software and published research other teams depend on, not reports. You will use AI as your primary build leverage, partner closely with Demand Generation, Sales, Brand and PR, and own each system end to end — from the idea to the thing running in production.What You’ll OwnAI Outbound & Signal Pipeline - Own GoKwik’s outbound motion end to end: build the ICP from proprietary merchant data and third-party market sources, detect intent signals such as checkout migrations, funding rounds and founder activity, and convert them into AI-personalised outreach that reaches high-fit D2C brands before they enter the market. Marketing Intelligence Platform - Own the internal tools Marketing, Sales and CS run on: the funnel from lead to go-live, ad spend joined to closed deals for true cost-per-outcome, competitive share of voice, and self-serve AI reporting that removes the dependency on manual data pulls. Each tool ships with a user guide and must be actively used by the team it was built for.Data-Led Thought Leadership - Turn GoKwik’s proprietary transaction data into publishable industry research no competitor can replicate. Own the data and the narrative from first principles to final draft, in partnership with Brand and PR. Attribution & Funnel Integrity - Own how marketing performance is measured: canonical definitions for lead, MQL, SQL and go-live, campaign taxonomy and UTM governance, and distinct attribution for outbound and signal-sourced pipeline in Salesforce. Hold these definitions steady across Marketing, Sales and Finance when numbers are contested.Automation & Reliability - Run these systems as production software, not side projects. Own the scheduled jobs, monitoring and alerting that keep them trustworthy, and design alerts that stay quiet until something genuinely needs attention.Enablement & Documentation - Build for handover from day one. Every tool, dashboard and automated workflow carries written documentation, a named owner and a walkthrough session, so no system depends on one person’s context to keep running.Who You Are4–6 years of experience across growth, demand generation, marketing analytics, revenue operations or product, with a track record of building tools rather than only reporting on them.Demonstrable experience building working internal tools, automations or data products using AI as the primary build leverage. You should be able to walk us through something you shipped that other people depended on, and what broke along the way.Strong SQL and comfort interrogating a number to its source before it is acted on. Hands-on experience with Salesforce or a comparable CRM, and with a data warehouse.Commercial fluency in D2C, eCommerce, payments or B2B SaaS go-to-market. You understand what a lead, an MQL and a go-live mean, and why the definitions get argued about.Proven experience running outbound or lifecycle campaigns, including prospect research, segmentation, sequencing and reply handling.Excellent written communication. A large part of this role is explaining a number to a senior stakeholder who will act on it, and writing research that stands up to external scrutiny.Comfortable owning systems in production: when a scheduled job fails, you investigate rather than escalate.Hands-on experience with ad platforms and campaign measurement across Google, Meta or emerging AI ad surfaces is a strong plus.A computer science degree or a background as a software engineer is not required. What matters is the judgment to know what is worth building and the ability to direct AI tooling to build it correctly.Why GoKwikAt GoKwik, you work at the intersection of go-to-market, product and data. This role sits on a foundation that already exists: a live platform of internal GTM products, an outbound engine with a scored universe of more than 16,000 D2C brands, and first-party transaction data across 15,000+ merchants that no competitor can replicate. You are not starting from a blank page, and you are not inheriting a backlog of requests — you are taking custody of systems people already use and deciding where they go next.You get unusual autonomy and unusually direct exposure: the freedom to choose what gets built, a short line to senior stakeholders, and work that is visible externally through published research as well as internally through the tools leadership reviews. For someone who wants to build rather than brief, in a performance-driven team with real ownership from week one, there are few roles in Indian eCommerce with this much surface area.Required SkillsAI stakeholder management Problem-solving marketing automation analytics Business growth

description:

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

title: Assistant Director
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS – Commercial Excellence – Assistant Director**
As an Assistant Director in Strategic Pricing & Insights team under Commercial Excellence, you will specialize in financial and commercial leadership for EY’s large and complex opportunities to improve for winnability and profitability. You will design and execute pricing strategies, work on innovative commercial models, help shape deal constructs, build compelling business cases, architect differentiated competitive strategies, advise engagement teams and articulate the value of EY’s offers to clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**




+ Architect and lead pricing strategies for complex pursuit: Collaborate with pursuit teams and stakeholders to prepare business cases, design commercial structures, analyze proposed solutions, create fit-for-purpose charging models, optimize deal positioning and value proposition, and develop client facing proposals and presentations.
+ Build trust-based relationship with leadership: Provide actionable insights that enable EY leadership to make pricing and commercial decisions that create superior returns for EY by understanding the total value creation of an opportunity and identifying client’s willingness-to-pay.
+ Monetize the value of EY’s differentiated solution, mitigating commercial risks: Design and execute innovative pricing and commercial models (e.g., outcome-based, risk-reward, consumption-based) incorporating behavioral economics techniques to accelerate client value while safeguarding EY’s margin and risk exposure.

Validate solution estimates against typical market approaches to identify sources of differentiated value and/or optimize them for competitiveness.
+ Refine the pricing strategy aligned with the differentiated value of our solution: Develop detailed price-to-win assessments to refine price positioning strategy leveraging market benchmarks, macro and micro economic indicators, knowledge of client pain points and objectives, and competitor intelligence.
+ Synthesize sales, price and solution insights into actionable intelligence: Collaborate with competitive intelligence, analytics, and other internal teams to perform research and refine the pursuit’s pricing strategy, positioning and offer design to help build compelling proposals.

+ Active contributor to negotiations and client communications: Lead development of client-facing financial and commercial documents, assist in high-stakes negotiations, and articulate deal constructs and value propositions to engagement partners and pursuit leaders to support securing of strategic agreements and strengthen client relationships.
+ Drive commercial transformation through training and facilitation: Contribute to thought leadership activities for development of pricing and commercial acumen within the organization. Develop collateral, assets and white papers for spreading commercial knowledge outside of the function.
+ Adept at team building: Mentor and coach team members to enhance performance.

+ Collaborate effectively across a matrix organization displaying pursuit and relationship management skills to deliver a high-quality work product while navigating conflicting interests.
+ Executive-level communication and negotiation skills to influence senior stakeholders and articulate differentiated value propositions.
+ Possess natural coaching skills, ease team discussions, speak in large group settings, handle difficult conversations and objections, influence without authority and write persuasively.
+ Execute with a high degree of independence and autonomy.
+ Ability to demonstrate innovation and creativity.
+ Strong data driven or statistical and problem-solving skills.
+ Be a transformative leader, both as an individual and as a counsellor.
+ Ability to prioritize strategic decisions under ambiguity and high-stakes timelines.

+ MBA and / or certifications covering financial knowledge (CFA, CMA, CPA) would carry significant advantages.
+ At least 6 years of relevant experience in professional services, preferably in functions like pricing and commercials, Price-to-Win, strategy consulting, financial planning & analysis, SaaS/cloud commercialization etc.

+ English language fluency (oral and written).

description:
