Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.
  
  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.
  
  
**Job Function**
Data Analytics & Computational Sciences
  
  
**Job Sub Function**
Business Intelligence
  
  
**Job Category**
Professional
  
  
**All Job Posting Locations:**
Bangalore, Karnataka, India
  
  
**Job Description**
Role Summary
  
  
The Digital Product Management Business Lead is an experienced role bridging business needs and digital solutions while leading and developing a team of professionals.
  
  
The Digital Product Management Business Lead translates business needs into clear, actionable requirements that enable successful delivery and adoption of digital, analytics, automation, data science, and AI products. The role works across business, product, design, data, engineering, quality, and technology partners to identify business needs, define requirements and future-state capabilities, shape product priorities, and guide digital solutions from discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.
  
  
This role collaborates closely with Product Managers, and is responsible for leading and developing a team, setting priorities, managing performance, and strengthening business analysis and product management capabilities
  
  
Business Analysis & Problem Definition
  
  

* Partner with business stakeholders, product teams and business analysts to ensure strategic priorities, business processes, pain points, opportunities, risks, and desired outcomes are effectively understood and documented.
* Guide and mentor business analysts in planning and facilitating discovery sessions through stakeholder interviews, workshops, process analysis, data analysis and user research.
* Provide oversight and direction on process and systems assessments, business requirements documentation, epics, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria ensuring solutions align with business objectives and product management best practices.
* Review and coach analysts on developing structured recommendations and business cases that support informed decision-making and investment prioritization.

Digital Product Management
  
  

* Lead and develop business analysts, providing guidance on product management practices, prioritization, and execution.
* Support adherence to product management frameworks, governance processes, and ways of working to ensure consistency across products and teams.
* Oversee product vision, roadmaps, backlogs and establish clear priorities for delivery teams.
* Partner with engineering, architecture, data, UX/design, and other teams throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Identify opportunities to leverage digital technologies, data, automation, analytics, and AI to improve business outcomes, assessing whether AI is the appropriate solution based on value, user need, data readiness, feasibility, risk, and required oversight.

**Product Performance & Business Value**

* Review and coach analysts on defining measurable product outcomes, KPIs, adoption metrics, and value measures, including relevant measures for AI-enabled capabilities such as reliability, output quality, user trust, exception rates, and productivity improvement.
* Monitor product performance and identify opportunities for optimization and enhancement, using AI-assisted analysis to detect patterns, adoption barriers, emerging risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Track expected and realized value from digital investments, using AI to synthesize performance, financials, adoption, and user data.
* Recommend whether products or capabilities should be enhanced, scaled, consolidated, or retired based on value, performance, adoption, risks, and strategic fit.

Stakeholder & Cross-functional Leadership
  
  

* Serve as a key connection point between SCE Product Managers and Business Analyst using AI-assisted synthesis to improve shared understanding of needs, decisions, requirements, and delivery implications.
* Build alignment across stakeholders with differing priorities and perspectives, using AI to organize inputs, compare options, clarify areas of agreement, conflict, and unresolved risks.
* Facilitate decisions on requirements, priorities, scope, trade-offs, and delivery, using AI-supported analysis to present options and implications while ensuring accountable stakeholders make final decisions.
* Communicate product roadmaps, progress, risks, dependencies, and outcomes to leadership, using approved AI tools to accelerate concise, audience-appropriate updates that are reviewed for accuracy and context.
* Translate technical and AI concepts, capabilities, limitations, risks, and trade-offs into clear business language, and translate business needs into actionable direction for technology teams.

People Management & Team Development
  
  

* Manage, coach, and develop a team of business analysts, product professionals, and related roles, including building their ability to use approved AI tools responsibly to improve work quality, speed, and business impact.
* Establish clear objectives, priorities, roles, and performance expectations, including expectations for appropriate AI use, verification of outputs, data protection, and accountability for final work products.
* Provide ongoing feedback, coaching, performance management, and career development, using AI-assisted preparation where appropriate while retaining personal judgment and accountability for employee decisions.
* Allocate work and resources based on priorities, capacity, skills, and development opportunities, using AI-supported workload and scenario analysis to inform—not determine—management decisions.
* Mentor team members in business analysis, product management, stakeholder engagement, Agile ways of working, and responsible application of AI to research, synthesis, requirements, testing, and communication.
* Establish consistent standards and best practices for requirements, product documentation, prioritization, delivery, and AI-assisted ways of working, including validation, traceability, privacy, security, and governance expectations.
* Identify capability gaps and create development plans to strengthen team effectiveness, including AI literacy, prompt and context design, critical evaluation of outputs, data fluency, and value measurement.
* Foster a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing team culture that encourages responsible experimentation, shared learning, and scaling of proven AI-enabled practices.

**Other Duties**
Cultivate and Sustain Collaboration: Collaborate across teams to build trust, open communication, and shared ownership of project goals.
  
  

* Champion J&J Values: Model J&J C.E.O. Leadership Behaviors and values to reinforce a healthy and motivating workplace culture.
* Support Team Cohesion: Plan and participate in team-building activities, knowledge-sharing sessions, and feedback loops that foster trust, collaboration, and team cohesion.
* Encourage Growth: Support mentorship, and continuous learning within the team.

**Required Minimum Education**
: Bachelor’s Degree (with 7+ years of experience) and/or Master’s Degree (with 5+ years of experience)
  
  
**Required Years Of Related Experience**

* 5+ years of relevant experience

**Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**

* Bachelor's degree and/or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Engineering or Supply Chain.
* 5+ years of relevant experience in business analysis, product management, digital transformation, technology delivery, or related disciplines in highly regulated business environments.
* Demonstrated people management experience, including coaching, performance management, prioritization, and employee development.
* Digital acumen and strong business analysis experience, including process analysis, requirements definition, future-state design, and stakeholder facilitation.
* Experience managing digital products or technology-enabled capabilities through multiple stages of the product lifecycle.
* Experience developing product roadmaps, managing backlogs, writing requirements/user stories, and prioritizing features.
* Strong understanding of Agile product development and cross-functional delivery.
* Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with business, engineering, architecture, data, and other technology teams.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, and decision-making skills.

Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to engage senior leaders
  
  
**Required Skills**
**Preferred Skills:**
Accountability, Advanced Analytics, Analytical Reasoning, Business Intelligence (BI), Business Requirements Analysis, Communication, Data Analysis, Data Governance, Data Modeling, Data Privacy Standards, Organizing, Problem Solving, Statistical Analysis Systems (SAS) Programming, Systems Development, Technical Credibility, Technical Writing, Workflow Analysis

title: Director of Product Management
description:
**Who are we?**
RZR Global is an AI-driven company specializing in mobile advertising solutions designed to fuel revenue growth. We leverage AI to discover audiences in a privacy-first environment through trillions of contextual bidding signals and proprietary behavioral models. Our audience engagement platform includes creative strategy and execution. We handle 5 million mobile ad requests per second from over 10 billion devices, driving performance for both publishers and brands. We are headquartered in San Francisco, CA, with a global presence across the United States, EMEA, and APAC.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a Director/Senior Director of Product Management to lead the strategy and execution for our DSP Platform,Connected TV (CTV) product line and new initiative . This role owns the foundations that make the DSP scalable and self-serve (campaign workflows, bidding/pacing primitives, reporting/measurement surfaces, APIs, experimentation), while also driving CTV-specific capabilities (supply integrations, deal mechanics, creative standards, measurement, brand safety, and performance).
  
  
You will operate at the intersection of engineering, data/ML, ad operations, supply partnerships, and revenue teams, translating market needs into platform bets and shipping roadmaps that improve scale, performance, reliability, and margin. The ideal candidate has deep programmatic advertising experience (especially CTV), strong platform product instincts, and a track record of building and leading high-performing PM teams.
  
  
**What will you do?**
Product Strategy & Roadmap (Platform + CTV)
  
  

* Define and communicate a 12-24 month product vision for DSP Platform and CTV aligned with company OKRs (revenue growth, margin, scale, retention).
* Own the roadmap and prioritization across platform investments and CTV-specific capabilities (supply, deals, measurement, creative, policy).
* Build business cases for major initiatives and decide build vs buy vs partner.

**Sprint Planning & Delivery Monitoring**

* Lead sprint planning and backlog grooming for Platform and CTV squads: define sprint goals, prioritize work, clarify scope, confirm capacity, and manage cross-team dependencies.
* Ensure stories are execution-ready with clear acceptance criteria, instrumentation requirements, rollout plans, and a shared Definition of Ready/Done.
* Monitor sprint delivery health using lightweight metrics (commit vs complete, velocity trends, cycle time, blocked work) and drive corrective actions (re-prioritization, scope management, escalation of blockers).
* Facilitate sprint reviews and retrospectives to improve predictability, quality, and team health; convert learnings into backlog actions and process improvements.

DSP Platform Ownership (Foundational Capabilities)
  
  

* Drive improvements in campaign creation & management (self-serve UX, bulk tools, validations, rules).
* Own bidding & decisioning primitives (targeting, frequency, pacing, budget control, bid modifiers).
* Improve experimentation & measurement surfaces (A/B testing, lift frameworks, reporting truth sources).
* Evolve reporting & insights (near-real-time performance, diagnostics, alerting, finance reconciliation).
* Own APIs & integrations (advertiser/agency workflows, trafficking, data onboarding).
* Partner with engineering to set and maintain reliability, latency, and throughput SLOs for platform-critical systems.

CTV Product Leadership (Demand + Supply + Measurement)
  
  

* Own end-to-end CTV buying experience: inventory access, deal support (PMP/PG), targeting, creative QA, brand safety, and measurement integrations.
* Partner with Supply/Partnerships and AdOps to expand CTV reach while protecting quality (fraud mitigation, allow/block controls, supply-path insights).
* Ensure compatibility and operational excellence across industry standards

Cross-Functional Leadership & GTM
  
  

* Align Sales, CS, Solutions, and Marketing on packaging, positioning, and enablement for CTV and platform capabilities.
* Build a feedback loop with top customers/agency trading desks and use it to guide roadmap choices.
* Establish a strong operating cadence: roadmap reviews, launch readiness, post-launch adoption tracking, QBRs.

Team Leadership
  
  

* Manage and mentor PMs (or build the team), ensuring clear ownership boundaries, high-quality PRDs, and success metrics.
* Raise the bar on product craft: discovery, validation, experimentation, metrics, and decision memos.

**What are we looking for?**

* 8+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years leading PMs (or equivalent leadership scope).
* Proven track record building platform products (APIs, core services, workflow systems) with measurable adoption and reliability outcomes.
* Strong programmatic advertising domain knowledge: DSP mechanics (auctions, pacing, frequency, targeting, optimization, reporting, measurement) and CTV specifics (supply dynamics, deal types, creative constraints, brand safety, fraud patterns).
* Ability to work deeply with engineering/data teams; comfort with event-driven systems, data pipelines, experimentation design, and performance metrics.
* Strong executive communication: crisp narratives, tradeoffs, stakeholder alignment, and decision making under ambiguity.
* Experience owning product outcomes tied to business goals (revenue, margin, retention, platform cost).

**RZR is an equal opportunity employer**
RZR is a place where everyone can grow. However you identify, and whatever background you bring with you, we invite you to apply if this role excites you.
  
  
RZR provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. title: Marketing Specialist, SEM
description:
**About The Team**
The zMedia Center of Excellence team develops and implements marketing campaigns across various Paid Social and Search Engine Marketing (SEM) platforms to achieve both brand and performance goals. We help people discover Zillow and connect them to our tools and services, ultimately guiding them to their next home. The team is collaborative, data-informed and innovative. We work with a wide range of partners to support business objectives and deliver high-performing marketing campaigns.
  
  
**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.**
Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a new team member who has the skills, knowledge and expertise to build, manage and implement Search Engine Marketing (SEM) campaigns at scale across multiple platforms. This team member is a performance marketer excited by new challenges and looking to develop the breadth and depth of campaign management and analytical capabilities!
  
  
Primary responsibilities will include:
  
  

* Build, QA, launch, and optimize Google SEM and Demand Gen campaigns for multiple lines of business
* Improve performance by managing bids, refining keywords, and testing new targeting, creative, and advertising capabilities
* Support various SEM workstreams including campaign audits, troubleshooting, reporting, and analyses
* Collaborate asynchronously with team members in North America through Slack, email, Google Drive, and project management tools
* Attend virtual team meetings occurring during the evenings in India Standard Time
* Understand rules, regulations, and data ecosystems related to paid marketing and identify and communicate issues when they arise

This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.
  
  
Who you are
  
  

* 2-5 years of work experience in SEM, including hands-on execution of campaigns such as Google Search and Microsoft Search with annual budgets exceeding $250K USD.
* Proven ability to effectively manage campaigns to drive strong business results
* Experience with newer Google Ads capabilities including Performance Max, AI Max, and Demand Gen
* Innovative mindset with a track record of successfully implementing experiments to improve performance
* Detail-oriented with strong quantitative and analytical skills. Experience analyzing large amounts of data from multiple sources and compiling them into insights & recommendations to improve results.
* Familiarity with incrementality testing and conversion event implementation and QA
* Strong problem-solving and time management skills
* Comfortable working asynchronously with team members in North America
* Fluent in English and strong written/verbal communication skills
* BS degree or equivalent experience in Business, Economics, Statistics or related field preferred.

Get to know us
  
  
At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.
  
  
Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.
  
  
No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.
  
  
*Zillow Group is committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and to providing equal employment opportunities. We comply with applicable laws that prohibit discrimination in employment and recruitment.*

*Qualified applicants will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable law.*

title: Marketing Communications Intern
description:
**Marketing & Communications Intern**

**Location:**
Bengaluru (Hybrid) |
**Internship Stipend:**
₹25,000 per month |
**Duration:**
6 Months

***Are you the kind of person who notices a great social media campaign, loves writing, and wants to build real marketing experience rather than just "assist" with it?***

***At the IET, you'll help tell stories that matter.***

From engineering breakthroughs and member success stories to scholarships, professional registration, events and communities, you'll help create content that reaches thousands of students, engineers and technology professionals across India. The role includes content creation, social media, blogs, website content, campaigns, member engagement and digital marketing.

This isn't a coffee-and-PowerPoint internship.

You'll write. A lot. With AI help, and without.

You'll interview people, create campaigns, build content, contribute ideas and help shape how engineering is communicated to audiences across India.

**What you'll be doing:**

- Write social media posts, articles, blogs, newsletters, member stories, case studies and campaign content.

- Interview engineers, volunteers, students and stakeholders and turn their experiences into engaging stories.

- Create content for LinkedIn, Instagram, websites and email campaigns.

- Support campaigns focused on membership, professional registration, scholarships, awards, events and communities.

- Help maintain and update website content.

- Track campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve engagement.

- Create simple visual assets using Canva and other tools.

- Bring fresh ideas to content, campaigns and audience engagement activities.

- Work with colleagues, volunteers and stakeholders across India and internationally.

**Who we're looking for:**

We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys writing. You might be running a blog, writing on LinkedIn, contributing to a student publication, creating content for a society, or simply be the person everyone asks to write things because you're good at it.

You don't need years of marketing experience. You do need curiosity, creativity, strong communication skills and the ability to tell a story people actually want to read. And a willingness to learn and grow.

**If you're the sort of person who spots a typo from across the room, we'll probably get along.**

**Essential Skills:**

- Excellent written English.

- Strong storytelling and communication skills.

- Ability to simplify complex topics into engaging content.

- A creative, problem-solving mindset.

- Strong attention to detail.

- Good organisational skills.

- Interest in marketing, communications, journalism, content creation or digital media.

- Willingness to learn and take ownership of projects.

**Good to have:**

- Experience writing blogs, articles or newsletters.

- Managed a social media account, publication or student community.

- Experience with Canva or basic graphic design tools.

- A personal blog, LinkedIn newsletter, Medium, Substack or portfolio website.

- Experience creating content for clubs, societies or volunteer organisations.

**What you'll get:**

- ₹25,000 monthly stipend

- Real ownership from day one

- Exposure to social media, content marketing, website management and digital campaigns

- Opportunities to interview professionals and create published content

- A portfolio of real-world marketing and communications work

- Mentorship and hands-on experience across multiple marketing disciplines

- A chance to help tell the stories of engineers, innovators, volunteers and future technology leaders across India

**How to apply:**

Please send the following to
**annasaju@theiet.in**

- Your CV

- A short note (maximum 300 words) telling us why you'd be a great fit

- At least two writing samples (blogs, articles, newsletters, LinkedIn posts, essays or published content)

- OR A portfolio link (Google Drive, Notion, Medium, Substack, personal website or similar)

- Bonus Points: If you spot anything in this job description that could be improved, tell us when you apply

***Important:***
*Applications without writing samples or a portfolio link will not be considered. We're less interested in where you've worked and more interested in what you've written. Show us something you're proud of. And remember to In your application email, include the word "Engineering" somewhere in the subject line in your email.*

**Ideal Candidate:**

A curious storyteller who loves writing, enjoys learning new things, isn't afraid to ask questions, and wants to build a career in marketing and communications while working on projects that support engineers, students and technology professionals across India

**About the IET:**
Every year, millions of people choose engineering as a way to solve problems, improve lives and shape the future. The IET exists to support them.

We work with students, engineers, researchers, volunteers and organisations through scholarships, professional registration, technical communities, events, publishing and career development opportunities. In India, our work reaches thousands of aspiring and practising engineers across the country. Visit: www.theiet.org

description:
**Job Description**

We, at NBIL, are always looking for enthusiastic, and creative individuals to join our team. We are currently having an opening for the role of a Jr. Marketing Executive to drive adoption and scale of biofabrication on a global scale. In a nutshell, your role is to make cutting-edge technology exciting for a global audience.

**Job Role**

* Develop and execute marketing campaigns and promotional strategies in digital space.
* Responsible for building social media marketing content which includes editing videos, images, written content etc. You have to be well versed with the understanding of how different social media tools work like, Instagram, Twitter, Linkedin, Youtube. Also, building performance marketing ads in Facebook, Twitter.
* Communication and collaboration skills to work with team members and potential customers
* Building, Launching and managing online events, courses, workshops.
* Measuring and reporting on the performance of all digital marketing campaigns
* Maintain and execute email marketing calendar for clients assigned, including ideation and concepting campaigns, building or getting emails &/or Landing pages built, segmenting lists, deploying campaigns and reporting results.
* Create, execute and analyze A/B test plans to improve email campaign performance and conversion rates including all metrics.
* Measure and report on email campaign and A/B test plan performance and manage ongoing reporting for launched campaigns and work on aligning each campaign performance to email marketing objective for each clients.
* Assist in marketing automation campaigns, retargeting ads, list clearing and more aspect of digital marketing.

**What are We Looking For?**

* Minimum qualification of a Bachelors Degree
* Proficient in English
* Proficiency in AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini)
* Should have expereince of building a strong social media presence, building followership, making contents viral, knowledge of twitter marketing and so onSelf motivated, adept at planning and organization
* Proactive in identifying opportunities as well as challenges
* Creative and innovative mindset with ability to multitask
* Attention to detail with respect to data collection, data management and data interpretation
* Ability to allocate resources effectively

**About Next Big Innovation Labs :**

Next Big Innovation Labs® is a Bengaluru-based biofabrication engineering company building precision focussed bioprinters for larger global impact. Since 2016, we’ve designed and manufactured the Trivima® bioprinter line (from the Sanskrit for “three-dimensional”) for clinical and research applications. Researchers and clinicians use Trivima to fabricate living tissue for drug testing, regenerative medicine and biomaterials research, which reduces the need for animal testing.

Today, Trivima systems are installed at numerous sites in India and abroad. Customers include IIT Madras, IIT Delhi, IIT Kharagpur, AIIMS New Delhi, and labs in South Korea. Our range runs from entry-level to multi-technology research platforms (Trivima NP, Pro and Aura).

NBIL is a World Economic Forum Technology Pioneer. We’ve been backed by the Government of Karnataka, BIRAC (Department of Biotechnology), Tata Trusts, Lockheed Martin and Merck’s accelerator program.

We’re a team of engineers, biologists and builders, and everyone works close to the product and the customer.
As a marketer here, you’ll tell the story of deep-tech hardware that’s reshaping how labs do research. You’ll work with the scientists who build it and the researchers who use it, and see your campaigns reach institutes across India and the world.

title: Performance Marketing Specialist
description:
**Job Title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager**

**Location: Bangalore**

**Experience: 5–8 Years | Performance Marketing | D2C & Marketplaces | Revenue Growth**

**Industry: FemTech | Skincare | Nutraceuticals | FMCG | Consumer Health**

**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

Miror is India's leading FemTech platform transforming how women experience peri-menopause and menopause. In just a year, we've built India's largest menopause-focused WhatsApp community, partnered with the National Health Mission and the Indian Menopause Society, and launched category-defining nutraceutical products and digital health services.

Our app blends science and technology—offering personalized care pathways, symptom tracking, diagnostics, AI-powered chat, expert consultations, and more. We are proud recipients of the Innovation in Menopause Care Award at the Global Women's Health Innovation Conference 2024

We simplify supplements using transparency, data, and proven ingredients. With a strong presence across D2C, marketplaces, and app ecosystems, we are seeking a senior, revenue-obsessed Performance Marketing leader to own acquisition, retention, and sales growth through high-impact digital strategies.

Learn more: www.miror.in

**SUMMARY**

Senior Performance Marketing Manager with 5–8 years of experience owning paid acquisition, revenue scaling, and multi-channel campaign strategy for D2C and e-commerce brands. Deep expertise in Meta and Google Ads, with a strong commercial lens on sales outcomes, ROAS, CAC optimisation, and full-funnel growth. A proven revenue driver with the ability to build frameworks, lead experiments, and align marketing spend directly to business growth. Experience in Nutra healthcare, skincare, or FMCG is a strong added advantage.

**CORE COMPETENCIES**

·       Senior Paid Media Strategy — Meta Ads & Google Ads

·       D2C & Marketplace Sales (Amazon, Website)

·       Revenue Scaling & Commercial Growth Ownership

·       Full-Funnel Campaign Architecture (Prospecting → Retention)

·       Budget Forecasting — CAC, ROAS, LTV, MER, AOV

·       A/B Testing & Structured Experimentation

·       Marketing Analytics, Attribution & Incrementality

·       Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO)

·       App-Led Growth & Marketplace Revenue Expansion

·       Creative Strategy & Performance Briefing

·       GA4, Google Tag Manager, Pixel & Conversion API

·       Revenue Reporting & Actionable Insights

·       Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are seeking a Senior Performance Marketing Manager to own end-to-end paid acquisition and revenue growth at Miror. This is a high-impact, senior individual contributor role with the potential to build and lead a performance team. The ideal candidate brings a revenue-first mindset, sharp analytical thinking, and deep hands-on expertise in scaling D2C sales through paid media and performance-led growth strategies.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Revenue Strategy & Commercial Ownership**

·       Own the paid marketing P&L — set and deliver revenue, ROAS, and CAC targets across all paid channels.

·       Build full-funnel campaign architectures aligned to monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue goals.

·       Forecast budgets and revenue projections in partnership with the business and product teams.

·       Drive sales growth across D2C, marketplaces, and app ecosystems through performance-led strategies.

**2. Campaign Execution & Optimisation**

·       Lead execution and optimisation of campaigns on Meta Ads (Facebook, Instagram) and Google Ads (Search, Shopping, Display, YouTube).

·       Continuously iterate on audiences, bidding strategies, placements, and creative formats.

·       Run structured A/B tests on ad copies, landing pages, and audience segments to maximise conversion.

·       Implement and maintain event tracking, pixel setups, and conversion APIs for accurate measurement.

**3. Analytics, Attribution & Reporting**

·       Monitor daily and weekly performance — take decisive corrective action to protect KPIs and revenue.

·       Build executive-level dashboards and reports highlighting key insights, wins, and growth opportunities.

·       Measure incrementally, optimise attribution models, and focus on LTV-driven growth over short-term ROAS.

·       Leverage data to identify revenue leakages and unlock untapped audience or channel opportunities.

**4. Creative & Messaging Strategy**

·       Brief the creative team with data-backed direction for high-converting ad creatives and landing pages.

·       Identify winning hooks, messaging frameworks, and creative formats based on performance signals.

·       Champion a test-and-learn culture for creative iterations tied to sales outcomes.

**5. Growth, Scaling & Innovation**

·       Identify and activate scalable audience pools and new revenue channels.

·       Experiment with new campaign types, emerging ad formats, and growth loops to unlock incremental revenue.

·       Lead CRO initiatives to improve landing page performance and purchase conversion rates.

·       Evaluate and onboard new tools, automation, and technologies to improve performance efficiency.

**6. Team & Stakeholder Leadership**

·       Collaborate closely with brand, product, content, and tech teams to align performance efforts with business priorities.

·       Mentor junior performance marketers and contribute to building a high-performance growth team.

·       Present performance insights and growth strategies to senior leadership.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

·       3–5 years of hands-on experience running Meta and Google performance campaigns for a D2C or e-commerce brand.

·       Deep understanding of performance metrics — ROAS, CAC, LTV, MER, AOV — and how they connect to business revenue.

·       Demonstrated track record of scaling revenue profitably at a D2C brand.

·       Strong analytical ability to derive insights from complex data and make fast, high-quality decisions.

·       Proficiency in GA4, Google Tag Manager, Shopify, and ad automation/optimisation tools.

·       Experience in Nutra healthcare, skincare, or FMCG is a strong added advantage.

·       Creative mindset balanced with a rigorous, data-driven approach to problem-solving.

**PREFERRED SKILLS (GOOD TO HAVE)**

·       Experience in app-led growth, marketplace categories, or multi-vertical revenue scaling.

·       Familiarity with marketing automation, deep linking, and experimentation platforms.

·       Prior experience leading or mentoring a performance marketing team.

·       Interest in skincare, wellness, beauty, or consumer-first health brands.

·       Experience with incrementally testing, MMM (Marketing Mix Modelling), or advanced attribution frameworks.

**TOOLS & PLATFORMS**

·       Meta Ads Manager & Google Ads

·       Shopify & D2C Website Platforms

·       SEO & Analytics Tools (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Search Console)

·       Reporting Dashboards

·       Marketing Automation & Deep Linking Tools

**WHAT WE OFFER**

·       Competitive senior-level compensation + performance-based bonuses

·       Direct ownership of revenue outcomes with high visibility to leadership

·       Opportunity to build and scale a performance team as the company grows

·       Dynamic, data-driven, and purpose-led working environment

·       Career growth into a Head of Growth or Marketing Leadership role

**WHY JOIN US?**

·       Be part of a high-growth startup tackling a real and underserved need in women's healthcare.

·       Work with a passionate, purpose-driven team at the intersection of health and technology.

·       Own meaningful revenue goals with the autonomy to build and execute your strategy.

·       Competitive salary and a clear path to senior leadership as we scale toward our $1B+ vision.

**Experimentation and Growth**

* Conduct structured experiments across campaign messaging, targeting, bidding strategies, creatives, offers, and landing pages.

* Strong understanding of landing-page optimisation, ad copy, creative testing, and lead qualification.

* Campaign-sourced pipeline and revenue
* Customer acquisition cost
* Return on advertising spend
* Landing-page conversion rate
* Campaign engagement and click-through rate
* Advertising budget utilisation and forecast accuracy
* Number and quality of experiments conducted.

We are looking for someone who goes beyond launching advertisements and reporting clicks. title: Marketing Intern
description:
**What 78flex is**

78flex is Kinetic Blume's marketplace for flexible workspace in India. Someone describes what they need in plain language 'a desk for the week near Indiranagar', 'a meeting room on Thursday ', and we match them to real inventory they can book directly.

**Where we actually are**

Better you know now than in week three. The platform is live, we have ten partner spaces across Bengaluru, and almost nobody has heard of us. There is no brand budget, no agency and no marketing team; you would be it. The working budget for a thirty-day cycle is about ₹5,000, so every rupee has to be arguable.

**The pipeline you would own**

Six parts. You run all of them, and you are the only person who does.

**1. Presence.**
Instagram and X, posted consistently and well. Spaces, localities, the occasional useful thing about working in this city. This is what an operator checks before deciding whether to sign with us, and what a first-time visitor checks before booking from a company they have not heard of.

**2. Pages that catch intent.**
Locality and meeting-room pages built to answer a search, not to read nicely: the count and the price in the headline, fifteen genuinely local questions answered, honest comparison to the next locality over.

**3. Paid, carefully.**
Google Search on a small budget: exact and phrase match, manual bids, pinned to one locality. You read the cost per click, per enquiry and per booking by ad group, and you turn off what is losing.

**4. Distribution through operators.**
Get manager access to our operators' Google Business Profiles and place tracked booking links on them. QR standees in the spaces. Directory listings. This is the cheapest demand available to us, and nobody is doing it.

**5. Conversion.**
WhatsApp links with the message already written, and a reply time we actually keep. Responding within an hour makes a lead roughly seven times more likely to qualify; we currently have thirty enquiries nobody has called.

**6. Measurement.**
Tag everything, then say honestly which page, post, ad or operator produced a real booking and which produced nothing.

**How each half is judged**

Social and content are measured on reach and on whether operators and visitors find a company that looks real. They are not measured on bookings, because the evidence says first bookings do not come from social, and holding you to a number you cannot move would be unfair.

Pages, paid, operator distribution and conversion are measured on one thing: qualified enquiries that turn into bookings, and what each one cost.

**What you need to be able to do**

1. **Write.**
   Clearly, in plain English, for a page meant to be found and for a post meant to be read. Most of this job is writing. Send us something you wrote that people who were not your examiners read.
2. **Make things look decent.**
   Canva is enough — posts, a one-pager, a printable QR standee. Figma is a bonus, not a requirement.
3. **Post consistently.**
   Including the unglamorous half: scheduling, replying to comments and DMs, and keeping it going in the weeks when nothing is happening.
4. **Run a small Google Search campaign without breaking it.**
   Keyword Planner, exact and phrase match, manual bids, geographic targeting. If your instinct is Performance Max, this is not the role.
5. **Be straight with numbers.**
   UTMs built properly, a web analytics tool you can navigate, and bookings grouped by where they came from. You should want to know whether something worked and be willing to say when it did not.
6. **Talk to people.**
   You will pitch spaces to companies and ask operators for profile access. A marketing job here is not a job away from customers.
7. **AI-first.**
   You reach for an AI tool by default and can say specifically what you used it for last week.

Not required: a marketing degree, agency experience, a follower count, or video production.

**If you are in your final semester**

(a) We take final-semester students who need a placement or industry internship to complete their degree, and we do the paperwork properly.

(b) We will complete your college's internship forms, sign the evaluation and provide a named mentor.

(c) Your exams and academic commitments are accommodated — tell us the dates and we work around them.

(d) You get a Certificate of Internship within ten working days of finishing, whatever the outcome, plus a reference from the people you worked with.

(e) All we need from you is a no-objection or placement letter from your institution before you start.

The six-month term is set so it fits a January-to-May final semester: start early November 2026, finish end of April 2027.

**What you get out of it**

1. Direct access to the founders, not a layer between you and them.
2. A number with your name on it, and the authority to move it.
3. Founder-led training, honest weekly feedback, and a formal review at 45 working days with a written outcome.
4. A certificate of internship and a reference written by the people you worked with.
5. We are offering a stipend of 10,000/month + incentives

**How to apply**

Email lrampalli@kineticblume.com with your CV and three or four sentences on why this role. Use the subject line “Marketing Intern — Bengaluru”. We reply to everyone who applies, including the people we do not take forward.

The Head of Digital Marketing will design, execute, and own the end-to-end digital growth strategy to maximize high-quality lead generation, lower Cost Per Lead (CPL), and drive site visits and final bookings for our premium residential and commercial projects. This leadership role demands a highly numbers-driven marketing professional who can seamlessly bridge the gap between digital spend and tangible real estate sales revenue.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Digital Strategy & Revenue Ownership**

* Formulate and execute a 360-degree digital and performance marketing roadmap tailored to micro-markets and distinct target demographics (e.g., luxury buyers, first-time homeowners, investors).

* Take complete ownership of the digital growth funnel: from initial brand awareness and lead qualification to property site visits and final bookings.

**Performance Marketing & Lead Generation**

* Oversee high-intent paid acquisition campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), LinkedIn, and programmatic real estate networks.

**Marketing Automation & CRM Integration**

* Design and execute sophisticated automated email and WhatsApp drip nurture campaigns to re-engage cold leads and maximize lifecycle marketing value.

**Analytics, Reporting & Cross-Functional Alignment**

* Maintain comprehensive, executive-ready analytical dashboards evaluating digital marketing spend directly against site-visit and booking performance.
* Work in lockstep with the Real Estate Sales Team to audit lead quality daily, adjusting digital campaigns immediately based on feedback from the ground.

**Required Profile & Qualifications**

* Education: MBA in Marketing, Business Administration, or a closely related quantitative field from a premier institution.

title: Social Media Strategist
description:
**Storyteller (Social Media & Video) at Saturn Labs**

Our revenue grew 20x in four months, and our company X account is still a blank page. We're hiring a storyteller (fancy name for social media) to close that gap.

You'll get footage most storytellers never see, more stories than you can post, and the freedom to tell them your way.

**About Saturn Labs**

Saturn Labs makes human data for Physical AI. We collect the real-world data robots learn from: video, touch and more, recorded on hardware we build in-house as people go about their work. Robotics labs use it to train their models, and we're backed by Entrepreneurs First.

**What you'll tell**

Your audience is engineers and researchers, especially people working in robotics. There's plenty to tell them:

* **Our hardware.**

  How our hardware gets designed, built, broken and rebuilt.
* **Our data collectors.**

  Who they are, what they record, and what a day on the job looks like. You'll interview them and tell their stories honestly, with their consent.
* **Our customers and partners.**

  What labs are building with our data.
* **The field.**

  What's happening in Physical AI and where human data fits in, explained well enough that researchers share it.
* **Behind the scenes.**

  The real version of building a robotics data company from Bangalore.

**What you'll do**

* Build our accounts on X, LinkedIn and TikTok from scratch, working directly with the founding team
* Shoot, edit and post short videos from our footage, our workshop and the field
* Interview data collectors and turn those conversations into clips and posts
* Write posts and threads that robotics engineers actually want to read
* Work with our founders on their own posts, and cover our launches, hiring and community events
* Post consistently, track what lands, and do more of it

**What success looks like**

* **In 30 days:**

  a steady posting rhythm across our accounts, and the first data-collector interviews live.
* **In 90 days:**

  robotics engineers and researchers know who Saturn Labs is, and some reach out because of something you made.

**You're a fit if**

* **Your own feed is the proof.**

  You've grown an account, yours or someone else's, and can explain why it worked. We care about what you've grown, not your years of experience.
* You can cut a sharp 30-second clip fast. Phone editing is fine.
* No robotics background needed, but you'll have to learn the Physical AI space fast: who's building what, the research that matters, and what people are debating. Our audience is engineers, and they can tell when you're faking it.
* You're comfortable pointing a camera at people and getting them to talk.
* You can handle a sensitive topic with care. People have strong feelings about humans training robots, and you'll tell our side honestly.

**Not a fit if**

* You'd rather schedule posts than make them.
* Your playbook is stock visuals, hashtags, "JUST IN" and "excited to announce".
* You hate Robots :D

**How to apply**

Email
**hiring[AT]saturnlabs.ai**

with:

1. Your handle(s) or handles of other entities you have grown. We look at your feed before anything else.
2. The post or video you're proudest of, and one line on why it worked.
3. A post from the Physical AI space that went viral, and why you think it did in as brief a way as possible.

﻿

We don't use AI or an ATS to shortlist, so please don't send AI-generated emails :)

2. Links to any Instagram pages you've managed or content you've created.

title: EY - GDS Consulting -AI Strategy & Go-To-Market
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**JOB DESCRIPTION | AI & DATA TECH CONSULTING**
**AI Strategy & Go-To-Market**
Career Family: AIA – AI Strategy & GTM
  
  

* Pursuits, RFPs & Offering Development

**LEVEL**
**Senior/Manager**
**Experience**
**8–12 years**
**LOCATION**
EY GDS
  
  

* Hybrid

**ORIENTATION**
**Strategy-led**
THE OPPORTUNITY
  
  
We are seeking a strategic Manager to join our AI & Data Tech Consulting team, focused on shaping how clients adopt Agentic AI and GenAI — and how the firm takes its AI offerings to market. The ideal candidate brings a blend of AI product strategy, solution positioning, and pursuit leadership, with enough technical fluency to credibly translate AI capabilities into business value, without being a hands-on builder.
  
  
You will work closely with account leaders, solution architects, C-suite stakeholders, and alliance partners to win and shape AI programs — owning the narrative from opportunity qualification and RFP response through solution storyboarding, commercial framing, and client orals.
  
  
**WHERE YOUR TIME GOES**
**40%**
**RFPs, Proposals & Pursuits**
Win themes, solution storyline, client orals
  
  
**30%**
**Go-To-Market & Offerings**
Positioning, enablement collateral, alliances
  
  
**30%**
**AI Strategy & Advisory**
Roadmaps, business cases, operating models
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
AI Strategy & Value Advisory
  
  
■ Partner with client leadership and Operating Partners to define AI / Agentic AI vision, use-case portfolios, and adoption roadmaps.
  
  
■ Build use-case prioritization frameworks (value vs. feasibility vs. risk) and translate them into phased roadmaps (discovery → MVP → scale).
  
  
■ Develop business cases with ROI, cost-to-serve, and value-realization metrics that leadership can fund against.
  
  
■ Frame AI operating models — CoE design, governance, Responsible AI guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  
  
■ Knowledge of business process transformation and industry value chains (Health, FS, Consumer, Industrials) would be an added advantage.
  
  
Go-To-Market & Offering Development
  
  
■ Shape and package AI offerings, accelerators, and assets into market-ready propositions — positioning, messaging, pricing logic, and differentiation.
  
  
■ Build sales enablement collateral: pitch decks, solution one-pagers, executive pagers, demo storylines, case studies, and battle cards.
  
  
■ Conduct market, competitive, and analyst research (vendors, hyperscalers, AI-native startups) to inform build / buy / partner decisions and offering roadmaps.
  
  
■ Work with alliance partners (Microsoft, AWS, Google, ServiceNow, Salesforce, etc.) on joint GTM motions, co-sell plays, and partner-funded programs.
  
  
■ Track adoption and pipeline KPIs for offerings and feed market signals back into the offering roadmap.
  
  
RFPs, Proposals & Pursuits
  
  
■ Lead end-to-end RFP / RFI / RFQ responses for AI and data programs — bid / no-bid qualification, win themes, solution storyline, and response orchestration.
  
  
■ Translate client requirements into a crisp solution narrative, scope, delivery approach, staffing model, and commercial construct, in collaboration with architects and delivery leads.
  
  
■ Own proposal quality — compliance matrices, executive summaries, value articulation, risk and assumption logs.
  
  
■ Prepare and lead client orals, executive workshops, and proof-of-value storyboards; coach pursuit teams on messaging.
  
  
■ Maintain a reusable pursuit library of proposal content, case studies, and credentials.
  
  
AI Fluency (Conversational, Not Hands-On)
  
  
■ Working understanding of LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI frameworks, AI evaluation & observability, and LLMOps — enough to engage architects and challenge solutions credibly.
  
  
■ Awareness of AI risk, regulation, and governance (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001) and how they shape client buying decisions.
  
  
■ Familiarity with cloud AI platforms (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI) and enterprise data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake) at a solution level.
  
  
■ Comfort with AI productivity tools to accelerate research, content, and proposal creation.
  
  
Business Development & Client Management
  
  
■ Work closely with account leaders to identify, qualify, and shape opportunities and build tailored value propositions for strategic accounts.
  
  
■ Build trusted relationships with client CXOs, product owners, and transformation leaders.
  
  
■ Represent the firm at analyst briefings, industry forums, webinars, and thought-leadership platforms; author POVs, whitepapers, and blogs.
  
  
Team Leadership & Collaboration
  
  
■ Lead and mentor a small team of strategy consultants and pursuit analysts.
  
  
■ Orchestrate collaboration across solution architects, delivery, sector specialists, alliances, legal, and pricing teams.
  
  
■ Drive knowledge sharing, offering playbooks, and capability-building across the practice.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes**
Educational Background
  
  
■ MBA / PGDM in Strategy, Marketing, or Business Management from a premier institute. Engineering or quantitative undergraduate background preferred.
  
  
Professional Experience
  
  
■ 8–12 years of experience across AI / data product management, strategy consulting, solution / pre-sales, or GTM roles.
  
  
■ Proven track record of shaping and winning AI, GenAI, or data-driven transformation deals, or of taking AI products from strategy to launch and adoption.
  
  
■ Experience building offerings, roadmaps, business cases, and executive-facing collateral for enterprise clients.
  
  
■ Exposure to market research, competitive benchmarking, startup / vendor evaluation, or innovation programs is a strong plus.
  
  
Soft Skills
  
  
■ Exceptional storytelling and executive presence — able to turn complex AI concepts into a compelling, simple business narrative.
  
  
■ Strong structured thinking and problem-solving; comfortable working under pursuit deadlines.
  
  
■ Excellent written communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, especially with C-suite executives.
  
  
■ Influencing without authority across large, matrixed pursuit teams.
  
  
**Preferred Certifications**
■ GenAI / AI strategy certifications (Microsoft, AWS, Google, Coursera, ISB / IIM executive programs, etc.)
  
  
■ Product management or agile certifications (SAFe POPM / PM, Pragmatic, CSPO), Design Thinking.
  
  
■ APMP (proposal management) certification is a plus.
  
  
IDEAL PROFILE
  
  
**You will thrive here if you…**
■ Have taken AI / data products from 0 → 1 and know what drives adoption
  
  
■ Love building the story, the business case, and the winning proposal
  
  
■ Can hold your own with architects — and simplify for the CXO
  
  
■ Have run market scans, vendor evaluations, or innovation programs
  
  
**This role is not…**
■ A hands-on engineering or model-building role
  
  
■ Writing production code, data pipelines, or agent frameworks
  
  
■ Pure delivery / project management
  
  
■ A back-office bid-desk formatting role
  
  
WHY JOIN US
  
  
■ Shape how leading global enterprises adopt AI — and how the firm wins in the AI market.
  
  
■ Work at the intersection of strategy, technology, and growth, with direct visibility to account and practice leadership.
  
  
■ Collaborate with a team of AI experts, solution architects, and industry specialists in a highly entrepreneurial environment.
  
  
**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  
■
**Continuous learning**
— You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
  
  
■
**Success as defined by you**
— We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
  
  
■
**Transformative leadership**
— We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
  
  
■
**Diverse and inclusive culture**
— You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Associate Manager, Market Development
description:
Reporting to the Head of Sales, South Asia, the Associate Manager, Market Development, will be a key member of the Global Sales organization responsible for driving market growth, demand generation, and revenue execution across the South Asia region.
  
  
The role will focus on expanding Shure's presence within the Collaboration and Conferencing ecosystem by developing strategic relationships with end users, consultants, system integrators, distribution partners, and alliance partners. Leveraging market intelligence, competitive insights, and customer engagement, this individual will help build pipeline, accelerate specifications, and drive adoption of Shure's collaboration, conferencing, networked audio, and enterprise solutions portfolio.
  
  
This position can be based in Bangalore or Hyderabad.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Revenue Growth & Pipeline Development**

* Drive business development, pipeline creation, and revenue growth within the Collaboration and Conferencing market to support regional sales objectives and long-term business growth.
* Identify, prioritize, and develop strategic opportunities, key accounts, and emerging market segments to expand Shure's customer base and specification influence.
* Work closely with sales leadership, distribution partners, and system integrators to accelerate opportunity conversion and improve win rates.

**End-User & Ecosystem Engagement**

* Develop strong relationships with end users, consultants, technology influencers, and channel partners to position Shure as the preferred audio and collaboration solutions provider.
* Promote Shure's complete ecosystem, including conferencing, collaboration, networked audio, wireless, and software offerings, to drive cross-portfolio adoption and attachment opportunities.
* Influence project specifications and technology recommendations through proactive customer engagement and solution-based selling.

**Partner Enablement & Capability Development**

* Plan and deliver training, workshops, demonstrations, and enablement programs for distribution partners, consultants, and integration partners.
* Strengthen partner capabilities around Shure solutions, value proposition, competitive positioning, and sales motions.
* Measure the effectiveness of enablement activities and recommend actions to improve partner engagement and conversion.

**Market Activation & Demand Generation**

* Collaborate with Marketing and Market Activation teams to execute customer events, roadshows, industry conferences, webinars, and thought leadership initiatives.
* Support local demand-generation campaigns that increase market awareness, create qualified opportunities, and strengthen customer engagement.
* Represent Shure at key industry events and customer-facing activities throughout the region.

**Business Intelligence & Strategic Planning**

* Provide market insights, customer feedback, competitive intelligence, and regional trends to support sales strategy, portfolio planning, and go-to-market decisions.
* Support forecasting, pipeline reviews, account planning, and business reviews through data-driven insights and opportunity analysis.
* Monitor competitive developments and recommend actions to strengthen Shure's market position and accelerate growth.

**Travel**

* Ability to travel minimum 50% of the time, including occasional weekends, as business needs require.

**Qualifications**

* Proven success driving business development, revenue growth, and strategic account expansion within the Integrated Systems, Unified Communications, or professional AV industry.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience with 8-10 years of relevant experience in professional audio, collaboration technologies, or audiovisual solutions.
* Strong understanding of Integrated Systems markets, including Audio Visual Integration, Unified Communications, Collaboration Solutions, Networked Audio, Video Conferencing, and Multi-Language Discussion Systems.
* Demonstrated ability to influence complex buying decisions and build relationships across end users, consultants, integrators, distributors, and alliance partners.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to analyze market trends, identify growth opportunities, and develop actionable sales strategies.
* Excellent presentation, communication, and customer engagement skills, with the ability to articulate business value to both technical and executive audiences.
* Experience with audio system design, DSP platforms, conferencing technologies, and enterprise collaboration solutions is highly desirable.
* Self-motivated, highly organized, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, CRM platforms, and pipeline management processes.
* Native language fluency appropriate for the region with excellent spoken and written English.

**Who We Are**
Shure’s mission is to be the most trusted audio brand worldwide – and for over a century, our Core Values have aligned us to be just that. Founded in 1925, we are a leading global manufacturer of audio equipment known for quality, reliability, and durability. We engineer microphones, headphones, wireless audio systems, conferencing systems, and more. And quality doesn’t stop at our products. Our talented teams strive for perfection and innovate every chance they get. We offer an Associate-first culture, flexible work arrangements, and opportunity for all.
  
  
Shure is headquartered in United States. We have more than 35 regional sales offices, engineering hubs, distribution centers and manufacturing facilities throughout the Americas, EMEA, and Asia.
  
  
Join Shure and
**Amplify Your Impact.**
Explore our unique culture and learn the key pillars that define our legacy of excellence.
  
  
**THE MIX MATTERS**
Don’t check off every box in the job requirements? No problem! We recognize that every professional journey is unique and are committed to providing an equitable candidate experience for all prospective Shure Associates. If you’re excited about this role, believe you’ve got the skills to be successful, and share our passion for creating an inclusive, diverse, equitable, and accessible work environment, then apply!

title: AVP - Partnership & Marketing
description:
**Factspan Overview:**

Factspan is a pure play data and analytics services organization. We partner with fortune 500 enterprises to build an analytics center of excellence, generating insights and solutions from raw data to solve business challenges, make strategic recommendations and implement new processes that help them succeed. With offices in USA, Canada, UK, Europe & India; we use a global delivery model to service our customers. Our customers include industry leaders from Retail, Media & Entertainment, Hospitality, and Logistic & Supply Chain.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a high-caliber, net-new pipeline-driven AVP / VP of Partnership & Marketing to architect, execute, and scale our B2B demand generation engine. In this strategic leadership role, you will be entirely focused on accelerating qualified lead generation and pipeline velocity through two primary levers: deep strategic alliances with major technology ecosystems (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP, Snowflake, Databricks) and highly targeted Account-Based Marketing (ABM) campaigns.

You will own the bridge between our cutting-edge Data & AI service offerings and enterprise clients looking to modernise their tech stacks. The ideal candidate brings a data-driven approach to marketing automation and AI-driven workflows, combined with a proven track record of monetizing partner networks within the professional services or IT consulting landscape.

**What You’ll Do**

**1. Strategic Partnerships & Co-Selling**

* Ecosystem Pipeline Generation: Identify, build, and scale commercial relationships with premier cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) and data/AI platform partners (Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft, OpenAI) to secure inbound service leads.
* Joint Go-To-Market (GTM): Architect and execute co-marketing plans with tier-1 partners, driving high-impact webinars, roundtables, and co-authored thought leadership that capture enterprise buyer intent.
* Partner Tier Optimization: Drive our standing within partner tier frameworks (e.g., achieving Premier/Elite competencies), unlocking internal referral mechanisms, partner-led funding programs (MDF), and co-sell opportunities.
* Alliance Enablement: Equipping cloud partner account managers (PAMs) and enterprise sellers with clear sales plays, case studies, and distinct value propositions regarding our AI implementation capabilities.

**2. Growth Marketing & Enterprise Lead Generation**

* Pipeline Acceleration: Own the quarterly and annual lead generation quotas, converting marketing and partner investments into highly qualified opportunities (MQLs/SQLs).
* Account-Based Marketing (ABM): Design multi-channel hyper-targeted ABM campaigns tailored to Fortune 500 / Global 2000 logos, positioning our custom AI framework, MLops, and data engineering solutions.
* Modern Growth Stack Execution: Direct data-driven campaigns spanning content marketing, SEO/SEM, organic search, paid media, and industry-specific events.
* AI-Enhanced Operations: Inject AI-driven personalization, advanced marketing automation tools, and predictive intent data platforms (e.g., 6sense, Demandbase, HubSpot, Salesforce) into the everyday lead routing workflow.

**3. Leadership & Cross-Functional Alignment**

* Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and evaluate a lean, high-performing team of Inside Sales, Marketing, and demand generation specialists.
* Sales-Marketing Interlock: Maintain strict SLA alignment with the enterprise sales team on lead definitions, lead scoring thresholds, and quick-response follow-up timelines.
* ROI Data Governance: Track, analyze, and present key performance metrics (CAC, LTV, MQL-to-SQL conversion, Partner-Influenced Revenue) to executive stakeholders, shifting budgets rapidly to top-performing channels.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Partner-Sourced Pipeline: Total dollar value of qualified sales opportunities originated directly via cloud and technology partners.
* Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs) / Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs): Volume and conversion rate of enterprise leads into active pipeline opportunities.
* Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) Efficiency: Cost optimization per channel, maximizing return on marketing spend (ROAS).
* Partner-Influenced Revenue: Percentage of total closed-won annual contract value (ACV) touched by marketing or alliance programs.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Experience & Expertise**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field (MBA preferred).
* Experience: 15+ years of B2B marketing and/or channel management experience, with a minimum of 4+ years in a senior leadership role inside an IT consulting, professional services, or Data & AI services firm.
* Industry Fluency: Profound understanding of cloud infrastructure ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP) and modern data/AI concepts (Generative AI, LLMs, data warehousing, business intelligence).
* MarTech Proficiency: Hands-on experience scaling CRM platforms (Salesforce) and marketing automation ecosystems with a clear understanding of intent-data frameworks.
* Commercial Acumen: Exceptional negotiation, relationship-building, and public presentation skills, with a history of converting abstract tech alliances into structured revenue streams.

title: Dir, Product Management
description:

In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam’s etch and deposition products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry.

It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees.
  
  
*Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On-site Flex’ you’ll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.*

title: CRM Manager
description:
PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life-till-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace). Culture:
  
  
At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
  
  
**Job Description**
**About The Role**
We are looking for a CRM Lead who can write high-converting copy and design automated user journeys across app and web. Your primary focus will be crafting the push notifications, in-app messages, emails, and WhatsApp sequences that guide users through key financial flows. You bring past experience in fintech or digital banking, knowing how to write clear, simple copy for complex steps like KYC, onboarding, and loan applications. You are a high-agency strategist who uses writing to improve retention and solve funnel drop-offs.
  
  
**Focus Area 1: Copywriting & Journey Architecture**

* Core Copywriting: Write all copy for push notifications, in-app banners, SMS, WhatsApp messages, and email sequences.
* Journey Mapping: Structure communication flows across the user lifecycle, adapting message angles based on user behavior and drop-off points.
* Funnel Drop-Off Recovery: Identify friction points in registration and product funnels, writing targeted recovery messaging to bring users back.
* Voice & Clarity: Keep messaging simple, direct, and transparent across all dynamic templates and automated sequences.

**Focus Area 2: Narrative Experimentation & Analytics**

* A/B Copy Testing: Run continuous experiments testing subject lines, hooks, message length, call-to-action buttons, and value propositions.
* Performance Analysis: Track open rates, click-through rates, and conversion metrics to see which messaging variations drive actual transactions.
* Dynamic Messaging: Set up modular content rules so message copy automatically adjusts based on user profiles and past activity.

**Focus Area 3: Product Alignment & Setup**

* Tech Coordination: Work with Product Managers and Tech Leads to trigger the right messages based on specific user events and backend actions.
* Frequency Control: Manage notification schedules to keep messages helpful without annoying users or causing uninstalls.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Fintech / Banking Writing Experience: Direct experience writing product copy and lifecycle campaigns for digital banking, lending, payments, or investment apps.
* CRM Stack Fluency: Hands-on experience working with tools like MoEngage, CleverTap, WebEngage, or Braze to set up and send written campaigns.
* Analytical Thinking: Ability to read funnel drop-off charts and figure out what copy change will fix the leak.

**Mindset To Succeed**

* Clear Communication: You know how to distill complex financial products into one or two clear sentences.
* High Agency: You take full ownership of retention metrics, rewriting underperforming campaigns without waiting for a nudge.
* Audience Understanding: You understand user hesitation around financial decisions and write a copy that builds trust and prompts action.

**Additional Information**

Insurance Benefits - Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance Wellness Program - Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System Parental Support - Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day-care Support Program Mobility Benefits - Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy Retirement Benefits - Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment Other Benefits - Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy

**Position Summary**
**Deloitte USI - Growth - Specialist Assistant Manager**

Through Consulting Services, we provide innovative solutions for cross-cultural cross-border challenges our teams may encounter around the world. **Overview of the role**
The professional will play a key role within the Cost Transformation team, helping to activate the Global Pillar focused on defining and executing GTM strategy across Deloitte’s businesses and offerings. The professional will help accelerate the execution of Growth strategic agenda by delivering high impact strategic projects, simplifying, and streamlining operations (reporting, PMO activities etc.), creating compelling and transparent leadership communications to solve the most complex challenges in exponentially powerful ways. This position is critical to advancing Cost Transformation initiatives, with a particular focus on Strategic Support and Go-To-Market priorities.

The professional will work with the India colleagues and senior leaders across Consulting Services practice. They will need to develop a knowledge of the firm’s Consulting Services business, strategic priorities to enable sharing of insights, trends, and escalation of issues/variances as appropriate. The professional will analyse quantitative and qualitative data, synthesize findings, and demonstrate solid analytical and writing skills. The professional will also be responsible to develop compelling narrative with clear recommendations based on the research, analysis, and findings. The team’s projects are typically high-impact and high-visibility aligned to the global firm and Consulting Services leadership’s strategic priorities. Projects often involve collaboration across workstreams to ensure coordination and alignment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the Cost Transformation team in activating the Pillar dedicated to defining and executing GTM strategy across Deloitte businesses and offerings

Requisite core skills
  
  

* Ability to prepare leadership ready materials that “tell-the-story” succinctly and logically; ability to flex the communication and messaging to the audience and context
* Excellent project and time management skills; able to independently manage multiple high-quality deliverables under pressure and adapt to diverse cultures, communication styles, and working environments
* Capable of building effective working relationships with internal stakeholders across multiple business areas, functions, and geographies in a virtual environment
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint with strong attention to detail and best in class deliverables
* Must possess the ability to manage highest level of confidential information

We seek an enthusiastic, energetic, and self-motivated individual who thrives both independently and collaboratively, and is comfortable working on projects of varying sizes within a close-knit team environment.
  
  

* Academic qualification: Master’s Degree like MBA

* Location: Bengaluru

**About Deloitte**

These firms are members of Deloitte Touché Tohmatsu Limited DTTL, a UK private company limited by guarantee. With 260,000+ people in over 150 countries, Deloitte member firms serve more than 80 percent of the world's largest companies as well as large national enterprises, public institutions, and successful fast-growing companies
