title: Brand Manager
description:
Job Role: Manager / Senior Manager– Branded Content & Media Partnerships

Reporting: Branded Content Head.

**Role Purpose**

We are looking for an experienced Branded Content professional with strong relationships across the Indian media and entertainment ecosystem and a practical understanding of how branded content is developed and executed across multiple platforms. The candidate should have working relationships with Broadcast Television networks, OTT platforms, production houses, radio networks, publishers and digital content partners, and should understand how brand integrations work within each of these environments. The role is highly execution-oriented. The candidate should be able to take an opportunity from an initial conversation with a media partner through commercials, ideation, integration planning, production, approvals and final delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

● Manage branded content and media partnership projects end-to-end across:

o Broadcast Television

o OTT Platforms

o Digital Publishers

o Radio

o Print

o Films and entertainment content

o On-ground and experiential extensions where relevant

● Understand client briefs and identify relevant media properties, content franchises, shows, films, formats and partnership opportunities.

● Work directly with broadcasters, OTT platforms, production houses, publishers, radio networks and other media partners to develop executable branded content opportunities.

● Understand different branded content formats, including:

o In-show integrations

o Fiction integrations

o Non-fiction integrations

o Vignettes

o Sponsorships

o Branded IPs

o Film integrations

o Radio integrations

o Print-led branded content

o Publisher-led custom content

o Digital extensions

o Long-term content partnerships

● Assess opportunities from both a creative and execution perspective.

● Work closely with partners to convert broad opportunities into clearly defined and executable branded content solutions.

● Lead discussions around commercials, deliverables, inventory, production requirements and timelines.

● Negotiate with media partners and production houses to optimise costs and extract maximum value.

● Understand production processes and independently coordinate: Scripts, Integrations, Pre-production, Shoot planning, Production, Brand visibility, Post-production, Edit feedback, Final approvals

● Attend shoots where required and ensure that agreed brand integrations are executed correctly.

● Work closely with production partners and platform teams to troubleshoot execution issues.

● Manage brand and partner feedback during scripting, production and post-production stages.

● Proactively identify relevant upcoming shows, series, films, content franchises, events and cultural opportunities for brands.

● Build longer-term partnerships with broadcasters and platforms instead of relying only on one-off integrations.

● Work closely with internal strategy, media, client servicing and implementation teams.

● Manage multiple projects and partner conversations simultaneously.

**Experience**

Preferred Experience: 6–10 years

Candidates may come from:

● Broadcaster branded content teams

● Network brand solutions teams

● Media agencies – content teams

● OTT partnership teams / solutions teams

● Integrated content agencies

**Ideal Candidate**

We are specifically looking for someone who understands how branded content actually gets made.

The ideal candidate should know who to call at a broadcaster or platform, understand what is realistically possible within a show or content environment, negotiate the opportunity, structure the execution and ensure that what was promised to the client is actually delivered.

They should be equally comfortable:

Sitting across the table from a broadcaster negotiating an integration, and standing on a shoot floor ensuring that the integration has been executed correctly. Candidates whose experience has primarily been limited to strategy, ideation or presentation development without hands-on execution experience may not be suitable for this role.

If interested, please share your resume at kaushik.kujur@verse.in

**Consumer Make in India (MII) strategy and execution**
, while also managing key category, alliance, and consumer-insights responsibilities.
  
  
The role will work closely with
**Lenovo AP teams, manufacturing partners, supply chain, product teams, finance, strategic technology partners, and global stakeholders**
to identify and execute opportunities for local manufacturing, ensure supply readiness, and support the growth and profitability of the Consumer business.
  
  
In addition, the role will own the
**Consumer Chromebook category**
, manage strategic technology alliances, and provide actionable consumer and market insights to support business decisions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Make in India – Primary Responsibility
* Own and manage the end-to-end Consumer Make in India process, from product identification and feasibility assessment through manufacturing readiness and execution.
* Assess the Consumer product portfolio and identify products/categories suitable for local manufacturing in India.
* Evaluate business, operational, supply-chain and commercial considerations for bringing products into local manufacturing.
* Coordinate closely with AP teams to align product roadmaps, manufacturing plans, supply requirements and MII priorities.
* Work with manufacturing teams and partners to drive execution, readiness and successful ramp-up of MII products.
* Manage forecast, supply and demand planning for locally manufactured products and proactively identify supply risks and gaps.
* Work cross-functionally with Product, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance and Operations teams to ensure smooth execution of MII initiatives.
* Track key MII milestones, issues, dependencies and business impact, and provide regular updates to leadership.
* Identify opportunities to improve localization, cost competitiveness, supply resilience and operational efficiency.
* Support Lenovo's broader India manufacturing and localization strategy, including relevant government initiatives and programs.
* Consumer Chromebook Category Management
* Own the Consumer Chromebook category and manage the overall category business performance.
* Drive PL management, including revenue, margin, cost and profitability objectives.
* Manage end-to-end supply, demand, forecasting and inventory for the Chromebook portfolio.
* Identify opportunities to improve portfolio performance, inventory health and overall category profitability.
* Work closely with internal stakeholders to manage product lifecycle, supply constraints, launches and business priorities.
* Strategic Alliance Management
* Coordinate with alliance partners on business initiatives, product programs, joint activities and relevant Consumer priorities.
* Ensure effective internal alignment and execution of partner-led programs.
* Consumer Category Insights Market Intelligence
* Own the GfK relationship and end-to-end consumer market intelligence process for the Consumer business.
* Manage and utilize GfK, IDC and other relevant consumer/market reports to generate actionable business insights.
* Analyze market trends, category performance, competitive movements, pricing and consumer dynamics.
* Translate market data into clear recommendations for product, category, pricing and business strategy.
* Own the AP BMS deck end-to-end, ensuring accurate, timely and insightful reporting of Consumer business performance.
* Develop regular management insights and presentations to support decision-making by senior leadership.

**Key Deliverables / Success Measures**

* Successful execution of the Consumer Make in India roadmap and localization targets.
* Identification and successful transition of appropriate Consumer products to local manufacturing.
* Improved supply availability, forecast accuracy and inventory health for MII products.
* Strong financial and operational performance of the Consumer Chromebook category.
* Effective management of strategic technology alliances and partner programs.
* Generation of actionable insights that contribute to Consumer business growth, profitability and market competitiveness.

**Required Experience Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Marketing or a related discipline; MBA is preferred.
* 5–10 years of relevant experience in consumer electronics, technology, PC, manufacturing, supply chain, category management, business management or a related field.
* Strong understanding of Make in India, local manufacturing and supply-chain processes.
* Experience managing cross-functional projects involving regional/global teams.
* Strong business acumen with experience in PL, forecasting, supply-demand planning and business performance management.
* Experience working with technology partners, OEM/ODM partners or ecosystem stakeholders is preferred.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to translate market/business data into actionable insights.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to operate effectively in a matrixed, fast-paced and globally connected organization.

*We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any federal, state, or local protected class.*

title: AVP - Category
description:
At Pocket, we’ve experienced rapid growth in both revenue and scale over the past few years, further fueling our ambition. With a long-term vision, we are well-positioned and well-capitalized to drive sustained expansion.

We operate across diverse industries and geographies, tackling complex challenges that require leaders who can navigate ambiguity and drive impact. These roles demand the ability to solve novel, first-of-their-kind problems often without precedent. Thriving at Pocket requires a mix of high IQ and EQ, analytical rigor, and an entrepreneurial mindset.

We offer ambitious goals, complex problem-solving, and full ownership over execution. Prior experience solving similar problems isn’t required. What matters is adaptability, a willingness to learn and reinvent, and intellectual humility.

**You’ll be solving for one of these problem statements:**

* This role sits at the intersection of analytics, product, and growth; tackling first-time, complex challenges across diverse genres.
* Content Growth & Expansion: Improve CPI for new shows and scale high-performing content to reach new audience segments. Test, iterate, and scale both paid and organic channels to drive sustainable growth
* Revenue & Retention Optimization: Maximize monetization, improve retention metrics, and enhance user lifetime value
* AI-Driven Production & Scaling: Shift user acquisition testing from thumbnail optimization to AI-driven experiments and scale realistic AI-generated videos for content distribution
* Content Adaptation & Commissioning: Optimize content adaptation for broader appeal and identify high-potential growth shows across key categories
* Live-Action Production: Maintain and scale live-action content as a core part of our ongoing operations; leveraging A/B testing and advanced analytics to optimize content performance and acquisition strategies

**Here’s what we are looking for:**

* Astute problem-solving skills and the ability to break (seemingly) large problems into smaller, practical, solvable pieces with a data-driven approach to decision-making
* Someone who excels at developing and implementing a plan from concept to completion, generating measurable outcomes across retention, engagement, and monetization
* Track record of productive teamwork starts with “why” rather than “what,” enjoys getting hands dirty, and possesses a drive for continuous learning
* A deep understanding of user needs, preferably gained in consumer-first companies
* Comfort working with AI automation tools and exposure to LLM-based workflows to drive scalable growth initiatives
* Action bias: solves problems, executes, and iterates as needed

description:

Key job responsibilities

The Books market segment opportunity in India is incredibly large - estimated at $50B in 2022 and growing to over $60B by 2025. The size of prize makes this category one of the most exciting and keenly pursued consumer opportunity in the Indian internet landscape. To increase the online penetration for readers and learners is the north-star vision for Books business on Amazon.in. The Books team is organized to make decisive progress in this must win and critical priority for A.in.
  
  
The A.in Books team is looking for an entrepreneurial Category Manager, to help us deliver our ambitious growth objective.
  
  
A Category Manager will lead businesses within Books, and will need to identify areas of selection expansion, improvement in selection efficiency, top line growth and key projects for the category they handle. In doing so, they will engage with multiple stakeholders across the organization including Category, Product, Sales & Business Development, Account Management and Cx teams. They will champion the requirements for their category, through the sales funnel, and drive initiatives to influence conversions, with partner teams. He will need to act as both a thought leader and influence execution through other stakeholder teams. They will be expected to represent the category in top brand/seller meetings, and internal meetings alike.

* Drive cross-functional strategic initiatives to continuously improve flywheel, profitability, customer experience and making S3P business successful.

title: Director, Product Management
description:
**Opentext - The Information Company**
OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
  
  
**AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.**
At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As the Director of Product Management – Messaging, you will lead the vision, strategy, and modernization of OpenText’s enterprise messaging portfolio, shaping the evolution of our current messaging capabilities toward a next-generation, SaaS-native Messaging Channels platform.
  
  
This is a strategic growth and transformation role with end-to-end responsibility for product vision, business strategy, roadmap, product boundaries, and transition planning across existing and future messaging capabilities. You will help build an email-first platform, with SMS and additional digital messaging channels, designed to support OpenText Communications, Experience Cloud applications, and API-driven customer use cases.
  
  
You will lead and develop the Product Management team responsible for messaging services, APIs, channels, and related platform capabilities. Working closely with Engineering, Architecture, Cloud Operations, Security, Support, and other Product organizations, you will translate customer needs and market opportunities into a focused, scalable product strategy.
  
  
A key part of your impact will be balancing innovation with the needs of our existing customers. You will guide the development and commercialization of the new messaging platform while managing customer commitments, operational dependencies, product economics, channel strategy, and migration from legacy messaging services.
  
  
You will also bring strong commercial and customer perspective to the portfolio, defining investment priorities, pricing and packaging strategies, channel economics, partner relationships, and business cases that support sustainable growth.
  
  
**What The Role Offers**

* Own the vision, strategy, roadmap, and business plan for OpenText Messaging.
* Lead and develop a Product Management team responsible for messaging services, APIs, channels, and platform capabilities.
* Define a compelling long-term messaging vision and translate it into a focused, phased product roadmap.
* Lead the development and commercialization of the OCP-native Messaging Channels platform.
* Shape product boundaries across message delivery, channel selection, orchestration, campaign logic, consent, preferences, suppression, compliance, retry behavior, and reporting.
* Drive evidence-based investment decisions across email, SMS, RCS, WhatsApp, push, and future messaging channels.
* Define API-first messaging capabilities supporting OpenText applications, partners, developers, and direct customer integrations.
* Drive a product strategy that supports both multi-tenant OpenText applications and single-tenant or off-cloud OpenText Communications deployments.
* Partner across Communications, Journey, Experience Cloud, OCP, Engineering, Architecture, Cloud Operations, Support, and Security organizations.
* Establish measurable product success criteria across functionality, adoption, financial performance, scalability, security, reliability, and operational performance.
* Drive product requirements, project charters, architecture alignment, release planning, and dependency management.
* Own the commercial and customer transition strategy from legacy messaging services to the next-generation platform.
* Balance investments in the existing platform across customer commitments, security, regulatory requirements, technical currency, and business-critical priorities.
* Define pricing, packaging, aggregation, volume, margin, and monetization strategies for messaging services.
* Evaluate aggregator and channel-provider relationships, including geographic coverage, channel economics, and operational dependencies.
* Guide product ownership and service-boundary decisions across shared messaging infrastructure and software assets.
* Engage directly with customers and field teams on strategic opportunities, roadmap priorities, escalations, and evolving channel requirements.
* Develop business cases supporting investment, modernization, migration, partnership, and portfolio retirement decisions.
* Strengthen the integration between Messaging and OpenText Communications to deliver a coherent customer experience across content design, orchestration, delivery, compliance, and reporting.

**What You Need To Succeed**

* 14+ years of product management experience across enterprise software, SaaS, cloud services, communications, messaging, or platform products.
* Demonstrated experience leading Product Managers and complex, cross-functional product initiatives.
* Proven success defining and launching new platforms or materially modernizing established enterprise products.
* Strong understanding of enterprise messaging, email infrastructure, SMS, messaging APIs, CPaaS, aggregators, delivery status, and channel economics.
* Knowledge of messaging compliance requirements, including consent, opt-out and suppression management, data retention, auditability, sender identity, and geographic considerations.
* Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture, multi-tenancy, APIs, identity, security, observability, resilience, scalability, and service operations.
* Demonstrated ability to establish clear product boundaries within complex ecosystems spanning applications, platforms, infrastructure, and third-party providers.
* Experience developing product visions, project charters, PRDs, measurable success criteria, and phased MVP strategies.
* Strong commercial judgment with experience across pricing, packaging, margins, partner economics, revenue planning, investment decisions, and business cases.
* Ability to balance net-new product innovation with existing customer commitments, platform modernization, and migration requirements.
* Proven ability to partner effectively with Engineering and Architecture while maintaining clear ownership of product vision, priorities, and requirements.
* Strong customer-facing, stakeholder management, and executive communication skills.
* Ability to operate effectively across global teams and navigate ambiguity, complex dependencies, and competing priorities.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field.

OpenText's efforts to build an inclusive work environment go beyond simply complying with applicable laws. Our Employment Equity and Diversity Policy provides direction on maintaining a working environment that is inclusive of everyone, regardless of culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.
  
  
If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact us at hr@opentext.com. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

title: Senior Director, Product Management
description:
ThoughtSpot is a Data & AI platform that helps companies turn data into enterprise advantage. We're Gartner MQ leaders with more than 1,000 customers globally and offices in Mountain View, Chicago, London, Bangalore, Sydney, and Tokyo.
  
  
**About Spotter**
Spotter is ThoughtSpot’s agentic analytics product. It reasons over governed enterprise data and shows its work, so its answers hold up in a board meeting. It covers:
  
  

* Data connectors that bring structured and unstructured data into Spotter.
* Spotter Analyst, the AI analyst inside ThoughtSpot.
* Slack and Microsoft Teams connectors that deliver answers where teams already work.
* The MCP Server, which brings Spotter into Claude, ChatGPT and other AI assistants.
* Embedded Spotter, for customers building it into their own applications.

**What You'll Do**
You’ll own a product for all of Spotter and lead the Spotter PM team, with the full backing of ThoughtSpot’s R&D organization.
  
  

* Set the strategy. Decide where Spotter goes across data, surfaces and embedding, and what to cut.
* Make trust in the product. Partner with Engineering so accuracy, reasoning and governance hold up whatever the data source and wherever the answer is delivered.
* Win every surface. Make Spotter the analytics layer people reach for in ThoughtSpot, in Slack and Teams, in AI assistants and in customers’ own applications.
* Ship in days, not quarters. Get things in front of customers early and iterate in the open.

**What You Bring**

* You’re a builder. You stay hands-on: you prototype, try the product yourself and get into the details, rather than leading from a distance.
* You’ve run a product for an AI or data platform at scale.
* You understand both end-user and developer/platform products: data integration, MCP, APIs and embedding.
* You have a strong point of view on where agentic analytics is going, and you change course fast when you’re wrong.
* You build PM teams that own their decisions.

****In-Office at ThoughtSpot****
Spotters are expected in-office 3+ days per week to be part of the energy of their local team. Momentum compounds when we're in the room together with faster decisions, sharper problem-solving, and the kind of peer learning that doesn't happen over a screen. Being in-office is our default way of working, with flexibility available where it's genuinely needed.
  
  
**About ThoughtSpot**
The world’s most innovative companies turn to ThoughtSpot’s AI-Powered Analytics to put data in the hands of everyone, from the C-suite to the frontline. With simple, natural language search and AI, anyone can ask questions, discover insights, and act with confidence. Unlike legacy tools that sacrifice performance for complexity, ThoughtSpot is intuitively designed for every business user while being built to handle the most complex, large-scale data, wherever it resides. This unique combination of speed and simplicity is why enterprise leaders trust ThoughtSpot to transform decision-making into a truly data-driven culture.
  
  
At ThoughtSpot, we’re a curious, data-driven bunch. We believe the world works better when everyone has access to facts. That’s why we build products that make asking and answering data questions as natural as having a conversation.
  
  
**Mandatory And Required Skills For All ThoughtSpot Roles**
Spotters are expected to demonstrate AI literacy and workflow integration to include to ability to:
  
  

* Comfortably and confidently integrate artificial intelligence into their daily workflow to increase productivity and quality.
* Hands-on experience to leverage AI tools (industry-leading LLMs) to increase productivity, automate routine tasks, and improve work quality.
* Speak to the experience of using AI for research, content creation, and document summarization while maintaining ownership of judgment and final decisions.
* Write effective prompts to get the most accurate and creative results from AI tools.

Spotters are expected to exemplify these key traits and AI Mindset:
  
  

* Curiosity in exploring new AI tools
* Adaptability to quickly learn and implement new, emerging AI technologies
* Critical thinking to know when to identify when AI should be used versus when human judgement is necessary

This combination of curiosity, adaptability, and discernment defines the AI mindset, and it’s required for every role at ThoughtSpot.
  
  
****AI Mindset for All Spotters****
At ThoughtSpot, we believe AI is a necessary and essential part of how we work. Every role, across every team, is expected to be fluent and comfortable with using AI to do their best work.
  
  
All Spotters are expected to experiment with ThoughtSpot’s AI tools (like Spotter and SpotterViz) and leading industry LLMs to streamline workflows, enhance output, and uncover new insights. Whether drafting content, analyzing data, or summarizing documents, AI is a daily partner. We value curiosity, openness to learning, and thoughtful application of AI to create real value. Training and resources are provided so every Spotter can confidently create with AI.
  
  
****ThoughtSpot for All****
At ThoughtSpot, diverse teams build better products. Complex data problems need many perspectives, not just one. We welcome different backgrounds, identities, and experiences, and we work to create a place where everyone can be themselves and do their best work. If this role excites you and you believe you’re a strong match, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
****What Makes ThoughtSpot a Great Place to Work?****
ThoughtSpot is the Agentic Analytics Platform that empowers every enterprise to transform insights into action, on a mission to make the world more fact driven. We hire people with unique identities, backgrounds, and perspectives - this balance-for-the-better philosophy is key to our success. When paired with our culture of Trust, Customer Obsession, Innovation and Intensity, ThoughtSpot cultivates a respectful culture that pushes norms to create world-class products. If you’re excited by the opportunity to work with some of the brightest minds in the business and make your mark on a truly innovative company, we invite you to read more about our mission, and apply to the role that’s right for you.

title: Marketing Automation Specialist
description:
**Description**
About Norstella
  
  
Norstella is a premier and critical global life sciences data and AI solutions provider dedicated to improving patient access to life-saving therapies. Norstella supports pharmaceutical and biotech companies across the full drug development lifecycle — from pipeline to patient. Our mission is simple: to help our clients bring therapies to market faster and more efficiently, ultimately impacting patient lives.
  
  
Norstella unites market-leading brands - Citeline, Evaluate, MMIT, Panalgo, Skipta and The Dedham Group and delivers must-have answers and insights, leveraging AI, for critical strategic, clinical, and commercial decision-making. We help our clients:
  
  

* Accelerate the drug development cycle
* Assess competition and bring the right drugs to market
* Make data driven commercial and financial decisions
* Match and recruit patients for clinical trials
* Identify and address barriers to therapies

  
  
Norstella serves most pharmaceutical and biotech companies around the world, along with regulators like the FDA, and payers. By providing critical proprietary data supporting AI-driven workflows, Norstella helps clients make decisions faster and with greater confidence. Norstella’s investments in AI are transforming how data is consumed and decisions are made, disrupting inefficient legacy workflows and helping the industry become more efficient, innovative, and responsive to patient needs.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an energetic and highly organized individual to join our growing Marketing and Client Delivery team. The Marketing Automation Specialist is responsible for executing, managing, and optimizing automated marketing campaigns with a strong emphasis on email. This role combines platform expertise, technical execution, data-driven automation, and quality assurance to deliver scalable, reliable, and high‑performing client marketing programs. This individual will report to the Director of Client Delivery, working closely with other members of the Marketing and Client Delivery team and collaborating with various internal teams across Skipta to ensure flawless execution of client campaigns within contractually obligated timelines.
  
  
You will serve as a hands-on execution expert, translating campaign strategies into automated journeys, personalized communications, and well-tested deployments across Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC), Salesforce Data Cloud, and connected data platforms.
  
  
The Marketing Automation Specialist should be results and performance driven, possess enthusiasm to cross-train, take on ambitious goals, and strive to optimize strategies. * 2-5 years in marketing automation, email marketing, or marketing operations
* Minimum Bachelor’s Degree, Marketing and/or Marketing Automation concentration preferred
* Experience in Healthcare/pharmaceuticals is a plus
* Experience with SFMC Engagement Plus and/or Salesforce Data Cloud (Data360) is a plus.
* Working knowledge of email automation, journeys, and triggered messaging.
* Experience with data segmentation, SQL queries, or automation logic
* Familiarity with HTML/CSS for email (building, editing, and troubleshooting)
* Experience with QA/testing tools (e.g., Litmus)

* Bold, Passionate, Mission-First.
* Integrity, Truth, Reality.
* Kindness, Empathy, Grace.
* Resilience, Mettle, Perseverance.
* Humility, Gratitude, Learning.

title: Digital Marketing Manager (SEO)
description:
PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life-till-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace). Culture:
  
  
At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
  
  
**Job Description**
About The Role
  
  
We are looking for an Digital Marketing Manager (SEO) Lead to build and scale our central SEO function from zero. This is a strategic thinker-plus-doer role (70% strategy and alignment, 30% tactical capability). You will design our organic growth roadmap, manage external agency execution, and navigate cross-functional alignments with product and tech teams. You will also spearhead our transition into the AI era ensuring our brand dominates both traditional search engine results and AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude). While you will rely on agency support and internal hires for day-to-day execution, you must have the deep technical capability to step in, run audits, validate agency output, and fix high-priority bottlenecks yourself when needed.
  
  
Focus Area 1: Strategy, Architecture & Agency Leadership
  
  

* SEO & AEO/GEO Blueprint: Define the central organic roadmap across web properties, aligning traditional search strategy and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) with core business and acquisition goals.
* Agency Management: Brief, guide, and hold agency partners accountable for technical execution, AI-optimized content production, entity building, and link acquisition.
* Early Wins & Strategy: Identify high-impact, low-hanging organic opportunities and deploy quick-win strategies with agencies to demonstrate early ROI.
* Team Scaling: Map out resource requirements and selectively hire internal specialists (technical SEOs, AI/content strategists) as the SEO unit grows.

Focus Area 2: Product & Engineering Alignment
  
  

* Cross-Functional Integration: Partner directly with Product Managers and Tech Leads to build SEO/AEO requirements (site architecture, structured data/schema for AI crawlers, dynamic rendering) into development sprints.
* Stakeholder Enablement: Help non-SEO stakeholders across marketing, product, and leadership understand search and AI discovery priorities and business impact.
* Brand Protection & Entity Visibility: Ensure site migrations, platform redesigns, and new product launches maintain search authority, clear entity signals, and structural integrity across search engines and AI models.

Focus Area 3: Technical Governance & AI-Age Quality Control
  
  

* AEO & GEO Optimization: Build frameworks to monitor brand citations, sentiment, and visibility across LLM platforms, ensuring our products are correctly recommended in generative AI answers.
* Tactical QA & Audits: Periodically dive into the details using tools like Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, Google Search Console, and AI monitoring platforms to audit agency deliverables and verify technical site health.
* Performance Systems: Set up reporting dashboards to track keyword visibility, AI citation share of voice, organic acquisition funnels, and technical performance metrics.

**Qualifications**
What We Are Looking For

description:

Through immersive centres, public engagement platforms, outreach programmes, maker spaces, leadership initiatives, and digital communities, the Foundation creates experiences that inspire curiosity, creativity, learning, and meaningful societal impact.

**At its core, Param Foundation is committed to:**

● Inspiring Curiosity - Creating engaging, hands-on experiences that make learning interactive, memorable, and accessible.

● Empowering Innovation - Supporting new ideas, entrepreneurship, experimentation, and future-ready thinking through collaborative platforms and innovation ecosystems.

● Celebrating Heritage - Showcasing India’s rich scientific, cultural, and historical legacy in relevant and contemporary ways.

● Building Communities - Creating inclusive spaces that bring together students, families, educators, institutions, creators, and changemakers.

**Job Description**

The Social Media Manager will own Param Foundation’s social media presence across platforms, driving content planning, execution, community engagement, and growth for the Foundation, its centres, programmes, events, and initiatives. The role will work closely with the Marketing, Creative, Academy, Programme, and other internal teams to translate brand, programme, and campaign objectives into engaging social media content that builds awareness, drives engagement, and supports business and visitor goals.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Develop and manage the social media strategy and content calendar for Param Foundation and its various initiatives, centres, programmes, and events.

2. Create and curate engaging content across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.

8. Monitor social media performance and prepare regular reports covering reach, engagement, growth, content performance, and other relevant metrics.

9. Support paid social media campaigns by developing content and creative requirements in coordination with the performance marketing team.

**Requirements**

● Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Advertising, Media, Journalism, or a related field.

● Ability to manage multiple projects, campaigns, and deadlines with a high degree of ownership.

Bangalore, India (On-site)

Full-time

**Experience:**
2–4 Years

**CTC:**
₹6–7 LPA

title: Digital Marketing Intern
description:
* **Title**
  : Growth Marketing Strategy Intern
* **Location**
  : Bengaluru, India (Work from Office, 5 days a week)

  : 2-10 pm

**About Joveo**

As the global leader in AI-powered recruitment marketing, we are transforming talent attraction and recruitment media buying for the world’s largest and smartest employers, staffing businesses, RPOs, and recruitment advertising agencies.

The Joveo platform enables businesses to attract, source, engage, and hire the most relevant candidates on time, within their budget. Powering millions of jobs every day, our data-driven recruitment marketing platform uses advanced data science and machine learning to dynamically manage and optimize talent sourcing and applications across all online channels while providing real-time insights at every step of the job seeker journey, from click to hire.

This is an
**in-office, high-ownership**
role for a sharp, ambitious individual looking to dive deep into the mechanics of B2B SaaS marketing strategy, with a heavy emphasis on digital execution and data analytics. You won't just be assisting; you’ll be contributing to core business outcomes.

**Your Mission: Drive Strategy & Execution**

You will be embedded within our dynamic marketing team, gaining hands-on experience across the strategic and tactical layers of a global marketing organization.

**1. Digital Strategy & Campaign Management**

* Own the execution and initial analysis of digital marketing campaigns across Meta (Facebook, Instagram), Google Ads, and emerging B2B platforms.
* Learn to optimize advertising performance by tracking key metrics, gathering actionable insights, and preparing comprehensive campaign reports.
* Explore the strategic principles of programmatic advertising, advanced audience targeting, and rigorous A/B testing to inform future strategy.

**2. Data-Driven Engagement & Retention**

* Assist in building, testing, and deploying email and SMS re-engagement campaigns that directly impact our lead nurture funnel.
* Focus on optimization—from template readability and mobile responsiveness to ensuring impeccable quality control (grammar, spelling, and formatting).
* Track detailed campaign performance and translate results into concrete recommendations for improving audience engagement.

**3. Marketing Analytics & Business Intelligence**

* Become proficient with core marketing tools: Google Analytics, CRM (Salesforce/Hubspot), and advanced Excel for data manipulation and reporting.
* Help synthesize raw data into clear, concise reports and strategic insights that influence executive decision-making.
* Develop a foundational understanding of SEO, SEM, and crucial marketing performance metrics (CPA, ROAS, LTV) within a B2B context.

**4. Cross-Functional Strategic Support**

* Collaborate closely with Product, Sales, and Content teams to support high-priority, ongoing marketing initiatives.
* Maintain critical marketing documentation, track project deliverables, and ensure strategic alignment across all projects.
* Conduct high-value research, including deep competitor analysis and market trends, to inform content and strategic planning.

**The Tech Stack You'll Master:**

Get hands-on experience with the tools that power a high-growth tech company:

* **Core Platforms:**
  Excel, CRM, Google Analytics, Advanced Email & SMS marketing platforms.
* **Ad Platforms:**
  Direct exposure to Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager.
* **Analytics & SEO**
  : Learn the ropes with top-tier SEO/SEM tools like SEMRush.

**Who You Are:**

This role is for the
**future marketing leader**
—someone who is curious, results-oriented, and thrives in a fast-paced environment.

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related analytical field.
* A data-driven mindset is non-negotiable—you love solving problems with data and are fascinated by digital platforms.
* Exceptional analytical, critical thinking, and communication skills (written and verbal).
* Highly adaptable and capable of managing multiple priorities in a dynamic, high-growth environment.
* Bonus: Any prior exposure to digital marketing (personal projects, coursework, previous internships) is a plus, but your raw potential and drive are what matter most.

**What You’ll Gain:**
Your Acceleration Path

* **Real-World Impact:**
  You'll work on live, global campaigns that directly contribute to Joveo's growth. No busy work.
* **Advanced Toolset:**
  Master cutting-edge ad technologies and marketing analytics tools used by top B2B firms.
* **Mentorship:**
  Learn the ropes from industry experts and work within a collaborative, fast-moving marketing team.
* **Career Pipeline:**
  This internship is a highly visible, performance-based opportunity with a clear and strong potential pathway to a full-time role.

**Build the next chapter of Joveo. Apply now**

Our marketing charter is grounded in measurable impact—leveraging in-house tools and data-driven strategies to automate and scale campaigns that bring in new customers and maximize their lifetime value.

title: Marketing Associate/Senior Associate
description:
**About Vimaan and the Role**

Vimaan is a Silicon Valley-based B2B deep-tech/SaaS startup, backed by Amazon and recognized by Gartner. We’re building Inventory Intelligence for warehouses and distribution centers, selling to operations and supply chain leaders at large enterprises across the world. We’re building a new category, so marketing here is market building, not just doing activities.

As a Marketing Associate, you will work closely with the Head of Growth & Marketing, helping plan and run the programs that build Vimaan's brand and generate demand.

**Location:**
Bengaluru, In-office

**Reports to:**
Head of Growth & Marketing (Raushan Barnwal)

**Type:**
Full-time

**What You Will Do**

Your work will span the areas below, with real ownership of each:

1. **Campaign Management:**
   Run our CRM (HubSpot) setup - contact lists, segmentation, forms, email builds and sends, and database hygiene. Execute the recurring email program and LinkedIn outbound sequences, drive paid campaigns, and manage the quarterly marketing calendar.
2. **SEO and AEO:**
   Drive our visibility in search and AI engines like Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini; track performance, build a weekly view of what’s working vs not, publish content and pages with the right on-page setup, and act on what the data shows.
3. **Website:**
   Coordinate with external web developers on the changes the website needs, from briefing to testing to going live, and publish and maintain pages day to day.
4. **Creatives:**
   Work closely with graphic designers, video makers and editors; share clear creative briefs, track production, review against the brief, and get assets produced on time.
5. **Content:**
   Take briefs from ideas to publishing - maintain the editorial calendar, coordinate with writers and freelancers, check drafts against our style and accuracy rules, publish, and distribute across channels. You don’t necessarily need to write the content, but you run everything around it.
6. **Events and Webinars:**
   Help with tradeshow logistics and lead follow-up, and running webinars: registration, reminders, hosting support, post-event nurture and reporting.
7. **Reporting:**
   Track deliverables and spend, and give leadership a clear monthly summary of results and learnings.
8. **AI for Marketing**
   : Across all of the above, you will also look for repeatable work to automate, using AI tools and lightweight workflows to maximize productivity.

**What We Are Looking For**

We care more about how fast you learn and how reliably you deliver than just about years of experience.

* Passionate about B2B technology products, and curious about how a deep-tech product works and why enterprises buy it.
* A degree from a top-tier institution and 1-3 years of experience in marketing and/or growth at a fast-paced tech startup; strong internships count as well.
* Comfortable with startup life: you want ownership and impact rather than a 9-to-5 job, and you enjoy building things that do not exist yet.
* Flexible and adaptable: priorities shift quickly, and you are happy to pick up whatever the work needs.
* Ownership: a record of owning something end to end, however small, and following it through without being chased.
* Proficient in or genuinely eager to learn AI tools, and keen to use them for everything they can do well. We expect you to automate repeatable work and find faster ways to get things done.
* Comfort with data: you read a spreadsheet or a dashboard and say what it means and what to do next.
* Clear communication: You will write emails, briefs, reports and status updates; and talk with different stakeholders regularly.
* Attention to detail: In our category, a wrong number or an overstated claim costs credibility, so accuracy matters.
* Based in Bengaluru already and able to work from our office as the work needs close daily collaboration.

**Good to have**

* Hands-on experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM and marketing automation tool.
* Exposure to B2B marketing, especially for technical or industrial products, or supply chain and logistics.
* Experience with web analytics, Google Search Console or SEO tools.
* Basic scripting or no-code automation skills.

title: Digital Marketing Manager – Growth (Paid & Organic)
description:
Digital Marketing Manager, Growth (Paid & Organic)

Location: Bangalore, Gurgaon or Mumbai (India), Singapore, or Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia). Flexible for the right candidate.

Reports to: Marketing Director, working closely with our Enterprise Sales leadership

ABOUT BIPO

BIPO is a global HR and payroll technology company with 15+ years of experience, over 5,600 clients and 700,000+ users. One integrated platform covers HRMS, Global Payroll Outsourcing (90+ countries) and Employer of Record services (170+ countries). We run our own payroll engine in 26 countries, have 51 offices worldwide and are a Workday Platinum Partner. Having raised over USD 50 million, BIPO is now scaling its enterprise business globally.

THE ROLE

You will build and run BIPO's digital demand engine across paid, organic and data-driven outbound channels. Your job is not clicks or impressions. It is a steady flow of qualified meetings and pipeline for our sales teams from HR, Finance and IT leaders at multi-country companies.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will run Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads yourself, build target-account lists and automated workflows in Clay and Apollo, grow organic and AI-search visibility, and turn data into decisions every week. Coverage is APAC first (Singapore, Malaysia, India, Greater China, Southeast Asia), with support for global campaigns.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Paid acquisition

- Plan, build and optimise Google Ads campaigns (Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube) for high-intent keywords such as global payroll, EOR and HRMS, by country and language

- Run account-based and persona-based LinkedIn Ads campaigns aimed at CHROs, CFOs, HR and payroll leaders

- Own the paid budget, pacing and bidding, and manage cost per lead, cost per meeting, cost per opportunity and ROAS

- Run a structured test plan for copy, offers, formats and landing pages

Organic growth

- Own keyword strategy, technical SEO, on-page optimisation and link building across BIPO's website and country pages

- Improve BIPO's visibility in AI search results such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews

- Identify content opportunities based on search demand and campaign performance, and brief the Marketing team on digital requirements

Outbound, ABM and data

- Build ideal-customer-profile and target-account lists with Clay, Apollo and LinkedIn Sales Navigator, enriched with firmographic, technographic and intent data

- Turn buying signals (expansion into new countries, HR leadership changes, hiring surges) into targeted campaigns and audience segments

- Work with Sales and SDRs on target audiences, lead definitions and handover criteria, and use performance data to improve lead quality

- Support digital ABM campaigns for priority enterprise accounts

Website, MarTech and analytics

- Own landing pages and website conversion, including A/B tests on forms and demo-request flows

- Set up and maintain GA4, Google Tag Manager, LinkedIn Insight Tag, offline conversion imports and UTM standards

- Build, test and optimise automated campaigns, nurture workflows and lead scoring

- Build dashboards showing spend, leads, meetings, pipeline and revenue by channel, country and campaign

- Use AI and automation tools (Clay, n8n, Make, Zapier) to make demand generation faster and more efficient

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- First 90 days: paid, SEO, tracking and CRM audit completed; clean attribution in place; Google Ads rebuilt or optimised; first Clay/Apollo outbound plays live with SDRs

- First 12 months: clear rise in marketing-sourced pipeline and meetings, lower cost per opportunity, growth in organic traffic and AI-search mentions, and a repeatable ABM programme for top accounts

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must have

- 5+ years in digital, performance or growth marketing, with at least 3 years in B2B SaaS or tech selling to business buyers

- Hands-on Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads experience: you have built, run and scaled campaigns yourself, with results you can show

- Strong working knowledge of Clay, Apollo and LinkedIn Sales Navigator (or ZoomInfo, Lusha, Cognism)

- Solid SEO knowledge (technical, on-page, content) and an understanding of AI-search visibility

- A pipeline mindset: you measure success by meetings, opportunities and revenue, not vanity metrics

- Strong with data, spreadsheets and dashboards

- Experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, Ahrefs, Semrush, UTMs and conversion tracking

- Hands-on experience managing websites in WordPress or a similar CMS

- Excellent written English with clear, punchy copywriting. Fluency in another Asian language is ideal for supporting local-language campaigns across APAC

Nice to have

- Experience in HR tech, payroll, EOR, fintech or other compliance-heavy B2B products

- Multi-country campaigns across APAC markets and languages

- ABM and intent platforms such as 6sense, Demandbase, Bombora or G2 Buyer Intent

- Automation and technical skills: n8n, Make or Zapier; basic SQL, Python or spreadsheet scripting

- Google Ads, LinkedIn Marketing Labs, HubSpot or Salesforce certifications

title: Web2/Web3 Marketing & Growth Specialist
description:
**Job Description: Web2/Web3 Marketing & Growth Whiz**

**Company:**
Basil Health

**Website:**
https://basilhealth.ai/

**About Basil Health**

Basil Health is building at the intersection of
**AI, cognitive wellness, EEG technology, and Web3**
. Through our CalmSync platform, we aim to make cognitive wellness more personalised and accessible using brain-signal insights, AI-powered coaching, and tailored wellness experiences. We are also exploring Web3-powered rewards and community engagement. We’re an ambitious, early-stage team looking for creative, driven people who want to help build something meaningful.

**The Role: We Need a Self-Starter, Not Just a Poster!**

We want a
**social-media-native, growth-minded marketer**
who:

* **Understands Eastern Gen Z and Millennials.**
  You understand how young people across India and other Eastern markets think, communicate, discover brands, respond to humour, follow trends, and decide whether something is worth their attention. You can create content that feels culturally relevant and authentic—not forced, generic, or copied from Western marketing playbooks.
* **Is a self-starter.**
  You don't wait for a detailed brief for every post or campaign. You identify opportunities, propose ideas, test them, learn, and execute.
* **Thinks beyond vanity metrics.**
  Likes and followers are not the end goal. You care about reach, engagement quality, profile visits, website traffic, sign-ups, community growth, retention, and ultimately product adoption.
* **Can make complex ideas interesting.**
  AI, EEG, cognitive wellness, brain data, and Web3 can sound intimidating. You know how to turn them into simple, relatable, memorable stories.
* **Understands both Web2 and Web3.**
  You are comfortable with mainstream social media and digital growth, and you understand the culture of online communities, crypto-native audiences, tokens, rewards, and decentralised ecosystems—or are eager to demonstrate that you can learn quickly.
* **Has a point of view.**
  You bring original ideas, challenge weak approaches, and can explain why you believe a campaign will work.
* **Can execute independently.**
  You can plan, write, create, publish, analyse, and improve content without needing constant supervision.

**What You’ll Do**

 

* **Build visibility:**
  Develop and execute a social media and digital marketing strategy across relevant platforms such as Instagram, LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and online communities.
* **Create engaging content:**
  Produce compelling posts, reels, videos, memes, carousels, and campaigns that make AI, cognitive wellness, and Web3 interesting and relatable.
* **Understand the audience:**
  Know how Eastern Gen Z and Millennials—especially in India and other relevant markets—think, communicate, follow trends, and engage with brands. Create content that resonates culturally rather than feels generic or copied.
* **Drive growth:**
  Turn content engagement into website visits, sign-ups, product trials, and community participation.
* **Build communities:**
  Engage with creators, influencers, wellness communities, and Web3 audiences to expand our reach.
* **Measure performance:**
  Use analytics to track reach, engagement, traffic, conversions, and growth. Experiment, learn, and continuously improve.

**What Success Looks Like**

 

Success isn’t measured by how many posts you publish. It’s measured by the visibility, audience growth, engagement, website traffic, sign-ups, and community you help build for Basil Health.
 

**How to Apply**

 

Share your portfolio, social media handles, or examples of campaigns you’ve worked on at areddy@brainwavescience.com / newhires\_hr@basilhealth.com. Tell us what results you achieved and what your contribution was.
 

**Bonus:**
Share three creative content ideas for Basil Health and briefly explain how you would grow our visibility in your first 30 days.
 

**If you love marketing, understand internet culture, think creatively, and can turn ideas into measurable growth, we want to hear from you. Come help us build Basil Health’s brand and community from the ground up!**

title: Founding Marketing Lead (Strategy & Content)
description:
---------
**WHAT WE DO**

---------

Slidely AI is a PowerPoint AI assistant built for professionals. In the last 30 days, users created more than 50,000 slides with Slidely, and 82.5% of them made it into real presentations.

Professionals at Deloitte, Airtel, Axis Bank and ABM Industries use Slidely, and our customers include teams at Fortune 500 companies. We’ve done this with a team of fewer than 10 people.

Now we’re hiring our founding marketing lead to shape how the world hears about Slidely. Your job will be to decide what Slidely says and where it says it, and then write it.

---------
**WHY SLIDELY EXISTS ---------**

ChatGPT and Claude have made presentations easier for casual users. For professionals, a big gap remains.

**Making PowerPoints is nobody’s job but everybody’s problem**

Decks take up 30 to 50% of a consultant’s time, but nobody is paid to make them faster, and the best AI model changes every month. Keeping up is our job, so it doesn’t have to be theirs.

**AI has no judgement, and no one has time to teach it**

It doesn’t know which slides a sell-side private equity deck needs, or when a slide is too dense to read. We build what good looks like in each industry into every workflow: 95% best practice, 5% you.

**A bad first draft just pushes the work to later**

Without that judgement, ChatGPT and Claude ignore your template and put your speaker notes on the slide. Our plugin starts from your template, your industry’s best practices and your past work, and our PowerPoint add-in handles the iteration.

**AI guesses what you want instead of checking with you**

It asks a few generic questions, then disappears on a long job. Slidely confirms the storyline, data and layouts before building your deck, and shows you three options when you redesign a slide.

**A sloppy deck comes off as sloppy work**

A deck can decide whether you get the funding, the investment or the approval, and the audience judges the work by the slides. Set up one design kit, and every slide anyone in your company creates follows it.

**Making a great deck is hard freaking work, so nobody wants to do it again (and again)**

A great deck takes days, sometimes weeks, so people keep reusing their best old slides. Slidely does that for the whole company, and every deck makes the next one better.

---------
**ABOUT THE TEAM & COMPANY**

---------

We're backed by Y Combinator and supported by prominent founders, operators and executives.

Despite being a team of fewer than 10, we serve demanding enterprise customers and operate at a much larger company's pace.

Our founders, Apoorve and Nikhil, are computer science graduates from IIT Kharagpur with deep backgrounds in AI.

This is an in-person role from our office in HSR Layout, Bengaluru. We work six days a week, typically 9-10 hours a day, together.

---------
**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

---------

You’ll own what Slidely says and how it reaches the people who need it. Working closely with our CEO, you’ll set our content, SEO and AEO strategy, then write the words that carry it. Once a process works, you’ll work with our GTM engineer to automate it, so you spend your time on the work only you can do.

1. **Set the SEO and AEO strategy.**
   Decide which topics, keywords and pages we should win, and which questions Slidely should come up for in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini. Then build the plan to get there.
2. **Own what’s working.**
   Read our performance across traffic, rankings, AI search, sign-ups and engagement, decide what to double down on and what to kill, and adjust our content and strategy accordingly.
3. **Write blog posts and key pages**
   (comparison, industry and feature pages) that rank, get cited by AI search, and that people actually want to read.
4. **Run case studies.**
   Decide how we get customer stories (like offering power users credits for an interview), write the outreach, interview customers and turn their wins into stories that sell.
5. **Write social content**
   for our channels: LinkedIn, X, Reddit.
6. **Write email copy**
   for onboarding, re-engagement and outreach that gets opened and acted on.
7. **Write homepage copy**
   that explains what Slidely does in seconds.
8. **Run creator partnerships.**
   Find, brief and manage creators for paid UGC and influencer marketing.
9. **Turn what works into a process.**
   Once a format proves itself, define what good looks like and work with our GTM engineer to automate it.

---------
**YOU'LL DO WELL HERE IF YOU**

---------

1. **Write clearly and sharply.**
   You can explain complex ideas simply, and you cut more than you keep. You know how to write a hook that stops the scroll and a CTA that gets the click. You also know where AI falls short, and you edit until nothing reads like AI slop.
2. **Know SEO deeply.**
   You understand the fundamentals, you’ve published blog posts with traffic to show for it, and you can turn that experience into an SEO strategy for Slidely.
3. **Get social media.**
   You’ve built a following on at least one platform, and you have good instincts for what an audience will engage with, like knowing when a short clip beats a YouTube link.
4. **Understand your audience.**
   You can explain Slidely’s benefits in terms a consultant, PE associate or strategy lead actually cares about.
5. **Are AI-native.**
   You use AI to research, draft and repurpose content at a pace a one-person team couldn’t manage otherwise, and you build your own prompts, skills and workflows to do it.
6. **Let data guide you.**
   You track what’s working in traffic, rankings, sign-ups and engagement, and you double down or kill things based on the numbers, not on what you like.

---------
**BENEFITS**

---------

* Total CTC: ₹12-18 LPA + ESOPs
* One-time joining bonus of ₹50k
* Access to leading AI and marketing tools
* Workstation setup and upgrades
* Additional software required to do your best work

title: Marketing Operations
description:
**About the Team**

The Growth Marketing team at Navi is responsible for activation, engagement, and retention of users who are on the Navi App. The CLM team owns the end-to-end lifecycle of the user, through every message that reaches our customers after they install our app. We operate at high volume, with a strong focus on precision, compliance, and continuous improvement. Our mission is to make every customer communication relevant, useful, timely, and effortlessly clear - so that the customer feels Navi understands them.

**About the Role**

● Execute marketing campaigns end-to-end on a daily basis - setting up, scheduling, and dispatching across SMS, WhatsApp, email, and push channels with accuracy and speed.

● Maintain detailed, structured records of every campaign run - including audience segments, message variants, send times, and outcomes, so that nothing is lost or ambiguous in the audit trail.

● Work closely with the content and design team to give campaign briefs, refine them, test with real users, and finally test and execute them with high accuracy.

● Analyse the result of each campaign, get learnings, and report them, with clear insights and next steps.

● Maintain the marketing calendar, ensuring that marketing campaigns get created accurately and executed on time.

● Identify recurring friction points in the execution workflow and propose or help implement process improvements, checklists, or alerts to reduce manual error.

**What We Expect From You**

● A methodical, process-first approach — you follow steps precisely, document everything, and treat shortcuts as a risk .

● Strong attention to detail — you catch discrepancies in audience lists, message content, or scheduling parameters before they go out, not after.

● A collaborative instinct — you ask the right questions when a brief is unclear rather than making assumptions, and you loop in stakeholders early when something looks off.

● A structured mindset around error prevention — you naturally think in terms of checklists, version control, and confirmation steps.

**Must Haves**

● Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets - for managing audience lists, tracking campaign logs, and maintaining execution records.

● Demonstrated experience in a high-volume, process-driven operations or execution role.

● Excellent record-keeping habits - can maintain a clean, auditable log of all work done with zero ambiguity.

● Ability to follow detailed SOPs precisely and raise a flag when something deviates from the defined process.

● Good written communication skills in English - for coordination with internal teams and documenting execution notes.

**Good to have**

Familiarity with any marketing tool like Clevertap, Moengage, Hubspot or Raven is preferred.

**About Navi**

We are shaping the future of financial services for a billion Indians through products that are simple, accessible, and affordable. From Personal & Home Loans to UPI, Insurance, Mutual Funds, and Gold — we’re building tech-first solutions that work at scale, with a strong customer-first approach.

Founded by Sachin Bansal & Ankit Agarwal in 2018, we are one of India’s fastest-growing financial services organisations. But we’re just getting started!

**Our Culture**

At Navi, we’re a place where ambition meets opportunity and ideas turn into impact quickly. We empower people with high ownership from the start, encouraging them to solve meaningful problems and build with excellence. Teams here work in an environment that values speed, collaboration and craftsmanship, while celebrating learning, growth and shared wins along the way. Whether you’re shaping the future of fintech products or driving innovation behind the scenes, life at Navi means being part of a high-energy, talent-driven workplace where your contributions truly make a difference.

We’re guided by our own operating system - The Navi OS - a set of principles that shape how we work and win together. You can explore them at navi.com/our-values to see what drives us every day.

If this feels like you, Navi is the place to grow, thrive, and make a real impact.

Location                       : Bengaluru (Bannerghatta Road)

**Job Profile:**

Amagi is hiring a Marketing Operations Lead to own the systems, data, and automation that power our GTM engine. This is not a traditional MOps seat - it sits at the intersection of marketing operations and GTM engineering. You’ll run the full marketing-ops backbone (campaign ops, lead lifecycle, attribution, database hygiene) while building AI-native automations that eliminate manual work across Sales, Marketing, and RevOps. **Marketing Operations Ownership**

Administer HubSpot and Salesforce hands-on — objects, workflows, fields, and integration — keeping Salesforce as the single source of truth.

Drive SLA adherence and clean handoffs between Marketing, BDR/SDR, and Sales.

**AI-Native Automation & GTM Engineering**

Build end-to-end automations using a Claude + Clay combination plus n8n / Make to enrich, research, and act on data with minimal human overhead.

Stand up advanced enrichment and account-intelligence pipelines (ICP matching, contact/title enrichment, ABM, outreach automation).

Proactively identify automation opportunities; ensure workflows are scalable, fail-safe, and maintainable.

**Reporting That Drives Outcomes**

Own reporting and dashboards across HubSpot, Salesforce, and the GTM stack for stakeholders up to leadership.

Translate pipeline, campaign, and funnel data into actionable recommendations — and own the follow-through.

Use SQL (and Python where useful) to extract, transform, and analyze data across systems; run a 30-60-90 reporting cadence.

**Cross-Functional Partnership**

Partner with Sales, SalesOps, BDRs, PMM, and Leadership to turn business needs into scalable systems.

Document workflows and data flows, train the team, and support rapid deploy-measure-iterate experiments.

**Skills and Expertise Required:**

AI-native operator: fluent in applying LLMs (Claude in particular) to design and ship real workflows — not just prompt occasionally.

Hands-on, advanced proficiency with HubSpot, Salesforce, and Clay (all must-have).

Proven ability to build automations with Claude + Clay and orchestration tools (n8n / Make); SQL for querying GTM data.

Reporting and dashboarding, with the judgment to turn data into action.

Strong grasp of GTM workflows: lead routing, scoring, ICP matching, ABM automation, attribution, and pipeline hygiene.

Python; warehouse / BI exposure (Databricks, Looker / LookML basics).

AI-first by default: you reach for a Claude-powered workflow before a manual process and treat LLMs as core to how you operate.

A systems thinker with a bias for automation, strong ownership, and a builder’s instinct in high-growth environments.

This is also a good opportunity for someone who wants to move into a product management role. As a creative team, we work closely together in the office, and work-from-office all days of the week is required.

title: OFF page SEO & GEO Specialist
description:
**Job Description: Off-Page SEO & GEO Specialist**

**Job Title**

**Off-Page SEO & GEO Specialist**

**Experience**

**2–5 years**
in Off-Page SEO, Digital PR, Link Building, Content Outreach, Reputation Management, or GEO/AEO

**Employment Type**

Full-Time/ Part time

**About the Role**

We are looking for an
**Off-Page SEO & GEO Specialist**
who will be responsible for building the company's external authority, online reputation, brand visibility, and presence across search engines, AI search platforms, communities, media publications, and industry websites.

The person will manage the complete off-page function, including
**Digital PR, backlinks, brand mentions, Reddit, Quora, reviews, ratings, community engagement, outreach, citations, guest contributions, influencer/podcast opportunities, and AI/GEO visibility**
.

This role is suitable for someone who understands that modern off-page SEO is not only about generating backlinks. The focus is on building
**credible brand mentions, authoritative references, relevant citations, relationships, and external signals**
that can support both traditional search visibility and AI-generated answers.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Digital PR & Media Outreach**

* Identify relevant media publications, journalists, editors and industry websites.
* Develop and execute digital PR campaigns.
* Pitch relevant company stories, announcements, research and expert opinions.
* Secure relevant editorial coverage and brand mentions.
* Identify opportunities for founder/executive interviews.
* Identify journalist request platforms and relevant media opportunities.
* Coordinate with internal teams to prepare expert comments and responses.
* Track media coverage and resulting mentions/links.
* Build long-term relationships with journalists and publishers.

**2. Off-Page SEO & Link Building**

* Develop and execute ethical, relevance-focused link-building strategies.
* Identify high-quality, industry-relevant websites for outreach.
* Conduct competitor backlink analysis.
* Identify backlink gaps and link opportunities.
* Conduct guest article and expert contribution outreach.
* Identify resource pages and relevant editorial opportunities.
* Find broken-link opportunities where appropriate.
* Identify unlinked brand mentions and pursue relevant attribution.
* Monitor new and lost backlinks.
* Evaluate backlink relevance and quality.
* Avoid spammy, automated or low-quality link-building practices.

**3. Reddit Management**

* Identify relevant Reddit communities and discussions.
* Monitor questions and discussions related to the industry.
* Provide genuinely useful and non-promotional responses.
* Identify opportunities for relevant brand/product references.
* Build a credible participation history.
* Monitor brand mentions and discussions.
* Identify discussions that may influence search or AI-generated answers.
* Maintain a natural community-first approach rather than promotional posting.

**4. Quora & Q&A Platforms**

* Identify relevant questions related to the company's products, services and industry.
* Create useful, factual and comprehensive answers.
* Identify opportunities to establish the company as a credible source.
* Monitor existing questions and answers for brand mentions.
* Identify outdated or inaccurate information where appropriate.
* Track visibility of company-related questions and answers.

**5. Reviews & Ratings**

* Identify relevant review platforms for the business.
* Develop a process for generating genuine customer reviews.
* Monitor ratings and review trends.
* Track positive and negative customer feedback.
* Coordinate with customer/support teams where responses are required.
* Respond to reviews professionally and appropriately.
* Identify recurring customer concerns and report them internally.
* Monitor competitor ratings and review presence.

**Important:**
Reviews must be genuine. The role should not involve buying, fabricating or manipulating reviews.

**6. Brand Mention & Reputation Management**

* Monitor brand mentions across the web.
* Identify unlinked brand mentions.
* Identify incorrect company information.
* Identify outdated information that requires correction.
* Track product/service mentions.
* Monitor founder and leadership mentions where relevant.
* Identify opportunities to convert relevant mentions into citations/links.
* Maintain a monthly brand mention report.

**7. Industry Communities & Forums**

* Identify relevant industry communities.
* Participate in professional discussions.
* Answer industry questions.
* Build relationships with relevant community members.
* Identify opportunities for expert contributions.
* Monitor conversations involving the company, products and competitors.

**8. Guest Contributions & Expert Outreach**

* Identify authoritative websites accepting expert contributions.
* Pitch relevant article topics.
* Coordinate with internal SMEs for expert content.
* Manage outreach from prospecting to publication.
* Maintain a database of publishers and contacts.
* Ensure published content is relevant and genuinely useful.
* Track published articles, mentions and links.

**10. Industry Directories & Citations**

* Identify relevant industry directories.
* Maintain accurate business information.
* Identify authoritative local and industry citations.
* Find duplicate or inaccurate listings.
* Maintain consistent company information across important platforms.
* Avoid mass submission to low-quality directories.

**GEO / AI Search Responsibilities**

A major part of this role will be
**Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)**
.

The candidate will help improve the likelihood that the company's brand, products, services and expertise are discovered, mentioned and cited by AI/search systems.

**Competitor Research**

The candidate will regularly analyse competitors for:

* Backlinks
* Referring domains
* Digital PR coverage
* Brand mentions
* Media coverage
* Reddit discussions
* Quora visibility
* Review presence
* Industry directory presence
* Expert contributions
* Podcast appearances
* Social mentions
* AI citations
* AI brand mentions
* External sources frequently cited by AI platforms

The objective is to identify
**new, legitimate opportunities**
, not simply copy competitor link-building tactics.

**Outreach Responsibilities**

The candidate should be comfortable with:

* Email outreach
* Journalist outreach
* Publisher outreach
* Blogger outreach
* Expert outreach
* Podcast outreach
* Partnership outreach
* Community outreach
* Review platform outreach

They should maintain an organized outreach database containing:

**Website | Contact | Email | Industry | Opportunity | Status | Follow-up Date | Result | Link/Mention | Notes**

**Reporting & Measurement**

The candidate will prepare regular reports covering:

**Off-Page SEO**

* New referring domains
* New backlinks
* Lost backlinks
* Relevant editorial links
* Brand mentions
* Unlinked mentions
* Digital PR coverage

**Reputation**

* Review count
* Average rating
* New reviews
* Review sentiment
* Major customer issues

**Community**

* Reddit mentions
* Quora visibility
* Forum/community mentions
* Relevant discussions

**GEO**

* AI brand mention rate
* AI citation rate
* AI visibility
* Number of cited external sources
* Competitor citation presence
* Brand/entity consistency
* Relevant external sources appearing in AI answers

**Outreach**

* Prospects identified
* Outreach sent
* Responses
* Opportunities secured
* Articles published
* Media coverage obtained
* Podcasts/webinars secured
* Links/mentions acquired

**Required Skills**

**Must Have**

* Strong understanding of Off-Page SEO
* Link-building experience
* Digital PR experience
* Outreach experience
* Competitor backlink analysis
* Brand mention monitoring
* Reddit knowledge
* Quora knowledge
* Review/reputation management
* Basic understanding of GEO/AEO
* Strong research skills
* Strong written English
* Good communication skills
* Spreadsheet/Google Sheets proficiency
* Ability to conduct structured outreach

**Good to Have**

* Experience with digital PR platforms
* Journalist outreach experience
* Podcast outreach experience
* Experience with AI search/GEO
* Experience monitoring ChatGPT/Gemini/Perplexity visibility
* Experience with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, Moz or similar
* Experience with Google Search Console
* Experience with reputation-management platforms
* Experience working with SaaS, technology, automotive, travel, finance or other competitive industries

**What This Role Is NOT**

This is
**not a bulk backlink submission role**
.

The person will not be expected to:

* Buy large quantities of backlinks.
* Spam forums.
* Create automated Reddit/Quora accounts.
* Generate fake reviews.
* Submit websites to hundreds of low-quality directories.
* Use private blog networks.
* Generate irrelevant guest posts purely for links.
* Spam communities with promotional content.

The focus is on
**credible external authority, relevant mentions, editorial coverage, community presence, reputation and AI/search visibility**
.
