title: Marketing Manager
description:
**About RenewCO2**




 RenewCO2 makes carbon\-negative chemicals and fuels. Our electrocatalytic CO2 utilization technology runs on electricity, water, and waste CO2, and the product drops straight into existing industrial supply chains. Because the process is energy\-efficient, our cost structure competes with fossil\-derived incumbents rather than relying on a green premium.
 



  





 We are venture\-backed with grant funding from the U.S. Department of Energy, NSF, DARPA, the New Jersey Commission on Science, Innovation and Technology, and Breakthrough Energy. The technology is demonstrated at pilot scale with customers, and we are now building toward commercial scale. R\&D is based in the United States; product development and manufacturing happen in India. Our customers are chemical, fuel, and materials producers across Asia, Europe, and North and Latin America.
 



  





 This role is based in Chikkaballapur, Karnataka, at Ohmium International, which builds green hydrogen electrolyzers at a gigafactory there. RenewCO2 has a joint development agreement with Ohmium: working beside a partner that already makes electrochemical stacks at volume shortens our path to manufacturing at scale.
 



  





**The role**




 You will be our first marketing hire in India, owning marketing execution: what we say, where we say it, and whether the market takes us seriously. This is a build job — no playbook, no large budget, no agency doing the thinking.
 



  





 Our buyers are chemical producers, fuel producers, industrial gas companies, EPC contractors, and licensors. They make eight\-figure decisions slowly, with a technical committee in the room. Your job is to make RenewCO2 legible to that audience and make a small team read as the serious technology company it is. You will work with a Brand \& Marketing Designer, hiring in parallel, and directly with technical and commercial leadership in the U.S.
 



  





**What you will do**




*Positioning and messaging* 



* Own the messaging architecture: what RenewCO2 is, what each product line solves, why our approach wins on cost and energy efficiency, and what we can and cannot claim today.
* Turn technical and techno\-economic material into arguments that hold up in front of a process engineer and a CFO in the same meeting.
* Track adjacent CO2 conversion, power\-to\-X, and low\-carbon chemical players, and feed that back into positioning and commercial strategy.



  





*Content* 



* Run the content calendar: technical posts, bylined articles, case notes, explainers, LinkedIn, newsletters.
* Write and place bylines and interviews in the trade press our buyers actually read — chemicals, energy, hydrogen, aviation fuel, and polymers.
* Write and submit award applications; handle analyst and industry\-database relationships.



  





*Website and digital* 



* Run the website as a commercial asset: information architecture, copy, publishing cadence, on\-page SEO, conversion paths. You publish in the CMS directly with the designer.
* Run LinkedIn as our main organic and paid channel, plus targeted email.
* Set up the measurement layer: GA4, CRM hygiene, UTM discipline. Report on what produces qualified conversations.



  





*Events and conferences* 



* Own the conference program: which events, abstract and speaking submissions, booth briefs, pre\-show outreach, meeting scheduling, follow\-up, and cost reporting.
* Prepare spokespeople with slides, talk tracks, likely questions, and clear boundaries on what is public.



  





*Commercial and investor support* 



* Build what the commercial team needs: capability decks, one\-pagers, technical FAQs, objection handling, customer\-specific pitch versions.
* Support fundraising and partner diligence with investor\-grade material, working with the CEO and CTO.
* Coordinate joint communications with partners, including anything tied to the Ohmium joint development agreement, with written approval on both sides.



  





*Team, vendors, and budget* 



* Manage and art\-direct the Brand \& Marketing Designer. Brief and manage outside vendors: PR support, translators, printers, exhibit builders, videographers.
* Own the marketing budget and report on spend and return each quarter.



  





**Required qualifications**



* Five to seven years in B2B marketing, at least three marketing something technical: process technology, capital equipment, specialty chemicals, energy, or industrial hardware.
* You work straight from technical source material — hand you a conference abstract, a techno\-economic analysis, or a process flow diagram and you produce accurate copy without an engineer rewriting it. Bring an example.
* Comfortable with the units our buyers live in: tonnes of CO2 per year, cost per tonne, kWh per kilogram, capacity factor, carbon intensity, life cycle assessment, technology readiness level. You do not need to be an electrochemist. You do need to never publish a wrong number.
* Experience marketing to industrial buyers — procurement, sustainability, corporate development, process engineering — through a sales cycle measured in years.
* You have run a B2B conference program: abstracts and speaking submissions against hard deadlines, booth planning, pre\-show meeting generation, and post\-show reporting. Familiarity with the chemicals, hydrogen, carbon management, sustainable aviation fuel, or polyester and packaging circuits helps.
* Hands\-on with LinkedIn organic and paid, a CRM or marketing automation platform (HubSpot, Salesforce, or Marketo), GA4, and a CMS you can publish in yourself.
* Publication\-quality written English. Your press releases, bylines, and website copy have to convince a chemical engineer and a journalist at once.
* Judgment about claims and confidentiality. Performance data does not go out before a patent is filed. Overstated environmental claims create real legal exposure — we treat this as non\-negotiable.
* Willingness to hold a standing evening overlap with our U.S. team in Eastern Time. Bachelor's degree; chemistry, chemical engineering, materials, or environmental engineering counts for a lot.



  





**Strongly preferred**



* Time at a hard\-tech or climate\-tech company between pilot and first plant — you know the difference between marketing a product that exists and marketing a credible plan to build one.
* Experience on fundraising or diligence material: investor decks, data rooms.
* Exposure to government\-funded program communications: DOE, MNRE and the National Green Hydrogen Mission, DST, or state clean energy programs.
* Working knowledge of what drives our customers' purchasing: ISCC PLUS and mass balance chemistry, CORSIA, RED III, EU ETS and CBAM, 45Q and 45V.
* Experience hiring or art\-directing a designer and holding vendors to a budget.
* Kannada or Hindi alongside English, for local partner, vendor, and press work.



  





**What success looks like in six months**



* One agreed messaging framework in use across the website, decks, and commercial conversations, with claim boundaries written down and respected.
* A rebuilt website our commercial team sends to prospects without being asked, updatable in hours.
* A published event and speaking calendar four quarters out, submissions in, booths budgeted.
* A working content cadence and measurement baseline that shows which activity produces qualified conversations.



  





**This role is probably not for you if...** 



* You need an established brand, a real budget, or a team underneath you to be effective.
* You would rather hand technical content to someone else than get inside it.
* Saying "we do not have that data yet" to a colleague, a journalist, or a prospect makes you uncomfortable.



  





**Location, working pattern, and compensation**




 Hybrid: two days a week on site in Chikkaballapur, the rest wherever you work best. A company shuttle runs from Bengaluru.
 



 Compensation: ₹17–20 lakh fixed CTC, plus equity and benefits. A standing overlap with Eastern Time usually costs part of your evening rather than a full shift.
 



  





**What to submit**




 We read work samples closely and CV formatting barely at all. Send three to five pieces, each with a line or two of context and a clear statement of what you did versus what a team or agency did.
 


* Something technical you wrote from primary source material: a byline, white paper, application note, or technical post.
* A positioning document, one\-pager, or deck narrative you authored. We are reading the argument, not the design.
* One campaign or conference program you ran — objective, what you did, the result. Include one that underperformed and what you changed.
* A website or landing page you owned, with a live link and a note on what you changed and why.
* Optional: a press release, award submission, or placement you landed.



  





 Do not send anything under NDA. Redact figures, customer names, and unpublished data, or just describe the work — we will take your description at face value and ask about it in the interview.
 



  





**How to apply**




 Apply at https://www.renewco2\.com/careers?bzid\=6764731291dc.
 



  





*RenewCO2 is an equal opportunity employer. We judge candidates on what they have done and what they can do, and we welcome applicants of every background. If you need an accommodation at any stage, tell us and we will arrange it.*

 \* Repurpose long\-form footage into multiple social media assets.
   

 \* Maintain consistent visual quality and brand identity.

 \* Hindu rituals \& traditions

 \* Pandit stories and experiences
   

 \* Behind\-the\-scenes content
   

 \* Customer experiences
   

 \* Temple and cultural content
   

 \* Educational/religious content

 \* Develop concepts from idea → shoot → edit → publish.

 🛕 Cultural \& Religious Understanding
   

  

 The candidate should have a genuine interest in Hindu rituals, traditions and Indian culture.
   

  

 You should be comfortable understanding and correctly representing:
   

  

 \* Different Hindu pujas and rituals
   

 \* Festival traditions
   

 \* Basic Sanskrit/Hindu terminology
   

 \* Regional variations in rituals and customs
   

 \* Temple etiquette and cultural sensitivities
   

  

 Prior experience in religious/cultural content is an advantage.
   

  

  

 🚗 Travel \& On\-Site Work
   

  

 This is not a desk\-only social media role.
   

  

 You will regularly travel to:

 \* Temples
   

 \* Apartment societies
   

 \* Religious events
   

 \* Festivals
   

 \* BookMyPooja events
   

  

 You should enjoy being on the ground, meeting people, carrying out shoots and finding interesting stories.

 Required Skills
   

  

 Must Have

title: Head Of Product Marketing
description:
****About CertifyOS****
 CertifyOS is building the data infrastructure that powers modern healthcare.
   

  

 Today, healthcare organizations rely on fragmented and outdated provider data. This creates unnecessary administrative work, regulatory risk, and higher costs across the system. We’re solving that problem.
   

  

 Our API\-first platform automates provider licensing, enrollment, credentialing, and network monitoring by connecting directly to hundreds of primary data sources. We help healthcare organizations maintain accurate, compliant, and reliable provider networks at scale.
   

  

 Our vision is simple:
 **One API. One provider ID. Frictionless provider data.**
 We’re backed by leading investors and built by a team with deep experience in provider data systems. At CertifyOS, we value authenticity, accountability, collaboration, results, and openness to feedback. We’re building a high\-ownership team focused on solving real infrastructure problems that impact millions of patients.
   

  

****About The Role:****
 We are seeking a Head of Research, Competitive Intelligence \& Product Marketing to own market intelligence, pricing strategy, product portfolio optimization, and go\-to\-market execution for Certify's Provider Data Management platform. This is a high\-impact, cross\-functional role at the intersection of strategy, data, and commercialization — built for someone who can turn raw market signals into clear, revenue\-driving decisions
 *and* 
 translate those decisions into compelling market narratives that move buyers.
   

  

 You will be the connective tissue between what the market demands and how Certify goes to market — owning not just the intelligence and strategy, but the activation of that strategy through product marketing, sales enablement, and positioning. This role is as much about execution as it is about insight.
   

  

****About The Role:****
 We are seeking a Head of Product Marketing to own market intelligence, pricing strategy, product portfolio optimization, and go\-to\-market execution for Certify's Provider Data Management platform. This is a high\-impact, cross\-functional role at the intersection of strategy, data, and commercialization — built for someone who can turn raw market signals into clear, revenue\-driving decisions
 *and* 
 translate those decisions into compelling market narratives that move buyers.
   

  

 You will be the connective tissue between what the market demands and how Certify goes to market — owning not just the intelligence and strategy, but the activation of that strategy through product marketing, sales enablement, and positioning. This role is as much about execution as it is about insight.
   

  

****What You'll Do:****
* Competitive Intelligence \& Market Research
* Own end\-to\-end competitive intelligence for the Provider Data Management (PDM) space — tracking competitor positioning, product roadmaps, pricing moves, and win/loss patterns.
* Build and maintain a continuous market monitoring system — synthesizing signals from analyst reports, customer interviews, sales conversations, and public filings into a living intelligence database.
* Deliver weekly, monthly, and quarterly market reports with clear insights and recommended actions for product, sales, and leadership — including building AI\-driven architecture to automate reporting workflows.
* Conduct regular primary research (customer interviews, prospect calls, win/loss debriefs) to pressure\-test hypotheses and surface ground\-truth insights that secondary research can't provide.
* Pricing Strategy \& Revenue Optimization
* Develop and own Certify's pricing strategy across all products and segments — balancing customer value, competitive dynamics, and revenue growth objectives.
* Model pricing scenarios for new products, expansions, and enterprise deals — providing finance and sales with clear pricing frameworks that maximize deal velocity without leaving revenue on the table.
* Design and test pricing experiments (e.g., value\-based vs. usage\-based models) informed by customer willingness\-to\-pay data, cohort analysis, and market benchmarks.
* Product Portfolio \& Packaging Optimization
* Evaluate and optimize Certify's product portfolio to ensure packaging, bundling, and feature prioritization align with business goals and maximize revenue per customer.
* Identify cross\-sell and upsell opportunities by analyzing product usage data, customer segments, and whitespace in the market — translating findings into actionable packaging recommendations.
* Monitor product performance metrics continuously and make data\-backed recommendations for improvements across pricing, packaging, and feature differentiation.
* Product Marketing \& Messaging
* This is where research meets revenue. You won't hand off insights to a separate team — you'll own the translation of market intelligence into the positioning, messaging, and content that drives pipeline and closes deals.
* Own Certify's product positioning and messaging framework — defining how each product and capability is described, differentiated, and sold across all buyer segments and personas.
* Develop and maintain a full library of sales and marketing assets: battlecards, one\-pagers, solution briefs, case studies, pitch decks, ROI calculators, and objection\-handling guides — built from your own research and updated continuously as the market evolves.
* Lead go\-to\-market launches for new products, features, and packaging changes — coordinating with Product, Sales, and Marketing to ensure launches land with clarity and drive measurable adoption.
* Build and own Certify's buyer persona library — deeply understanding the motivations, objections, evaluation criteria, and success metrics of key decision\-makers (health plan medical directors, credentialing ops leaders, procurement, IT, etc.).
* Develop thought leadership content and market narratives — white papers, market sizing analyses, industry benchmarks — that position Certify as the authoritative voice in the PDM space and support demand generation efforts.
* Partner with Marketing to ensure campaign messaging is grounded in validated market intelligence and resonates with target segments — bridging the gap between data and creative execution.
* Support demand generation by identifying the highest\-value market segments and building the research\-backed targeting rationale that informs campaign strategy and ABM prioritization.
* Product Team Integration \& Roadmap Influence
* This role has a uniquely close relationship with the Product team — functioning as the market\-facing counterpart to Product's internal\-facing focus. Where Product owns the what and how of the platform, you own the why and for whom — and the two must be deeply integrated.
* Serve as the primary voice of the market inside product planning — bringing customer research, competitive data, and market sizing into roadmap discussions to ensure investment flows toward the highest\-value opportunities.
* Co\-own the product discovery process with Product leadership — designing and running customer research programs (user interviews, surveys, advisory boards) that generate the qualitative and quantitative signals needed to prioritize effectively.
* Translate product capabilities into market\-ready value propositions for every significant release — working hand\-in\-hand with Product Managers to ensure new features land with clear messaging, adoption materials, and sales training.
* Maintain a continuous feedback loop between Sales, Customer Success, and Product — capturing field intelligence, win/loss themes, and customer sentiment and synthesizing it into structured quarterly product input reports.
* Define and track product marketing KPIs — feature adoption rates, enablement utilization, message resonance scores — and use these to continuously refine positioning and packaging recommendations.


****What Success Looks Like****
* Market Intelligence Velocity: Weekly competitive briefings delivered to leadership; automated reporting pipeline live within 90 days.
* Pricing Impact: Measurable improvement in ACV and win rates within 6 months of pricing strategy implementation; ≥2 pricing model updates per year informed by data.
* Portfolio Clarity: 100% of product lines have a documented packaging and tiering rationale; portfolio reviewed and updated quarterly.
* GTM Enablement: Competitive battlecards and pricing guides maintained for 100% of active competitors; ≥80% of sales reps rating intelligence materials as highly useful in quarterly surveys.
* Product Marketing Coverage: Full positioning and messaging framework documented and live within 60 days; all major product releases launched with complete go\-to\-market packages.
* Revenue Contribution: Research insights directly traceable to at least two new revenue\-generating initiatives per year, including upsell opportunities or new segment entry.


****What You’ll Need:****
**Must\-Have Experience**
* 5–8\+ years in competitive intelligence, market research, pricing strategy, or product strategy in a SaaS or technology\-driven industry.
* Demonstrated track record developing and deploying pricing models that improved win rates, ACV, or NRR in a B2B context.
* Strong analytical skills — fluent in data and able to independently build financial models, analyze usage data, and synthesize qualitative and quantitative signals into crisp recommendations.
* Background in healthcare SaaS, health plan operations, or provider data — familiarity with credentialing, network management, or regulatory compliance a strong plus.
* Proven ability to influence cross\-functional teams (Product, Sales, Finance, Marketing) and drive strategic decisions without direct authority.
* Exceptional communication and executive presentation skills — able to distill complex market dynamics into clear, compelling narratives for senior leadership and board\-level audiences.


****Preferred Experience****
* Experience building or scaling a competitive intelligence function from scratch, including designing research processes, tooling, and reporting cadences.
* Hands\-on experience using AI tools to accelerate research workflows — e.g., automated monitoring, LLM\-powered analysis, or data aggregation pipelines.
* Familiarity with usage\-based or value\-based pricing models, willingness\-to\-pay research methods, or conjoint analysis.


**Our Research \& Culture Principles**
* Ground Truth First: No insight without validation. You talk to customers, prospects, and the market — you don’t just read reports.
* Insight to Action: Research without a recommended action is incomplete. You close the loop between intelligence and business impact.
* Low Ego, High Standards: Nothing is beneath you — you dive into the data, own the details, and hold yourself accountable to outcomes.
* Prioritize Relentlessly: The market generates infinite signals. You know which ones matter and focus your energy accordingly.
* Deliver A\+ Work: “Good enough” is not our bar. The quality of your research reflects on Certify’s credibility with customers, investors, and partners.


****Benefits Of Working At Certify****
* At Certify, we’re building with intention and taking care of the people doing the work.
* Your well\-being matters to us. We provide 100% coverage of health, dental, and vision insurance premiums for employees. Our US\-based team benefits from unlimited PTO, with at least two weeks off each year to recharge. In India, employees are supported with health insurance, statutory leave benefits, and additional wellness (menstrual) leave for women.


 We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to do their best work, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences.
   

  

 If you require reasonable accommodations during the application process, please contact recruiting@certifyos.com.
   

  

 We are also committed to pay transparency and foster an open culture where compensation conversations are encouraged and respected.

title: Senior Director - Performance Marketing (Remote)
description:
**Own the paid media engine for a $1Billion\+ brand. Decide what to launch and where the budget goes.** 




  





**Total Annual Package:** 
 Up to USD $240,000 \+ comprehensive benefits (Base salary \+ monthly performance bonus of up to 20% of base)
 



**Location:** 
 Remote (Global)
 



**Growth path from here is fluid:** 
 all paid channels, including the ones you select, moving toward scope at the intersection of capital allocation, creative strategy, and P\&L ownership. What takes 4\-5 years elsewhere happens in 1\-2 here.
 



  





**We've been AI\-first since December 2023:** 
 Every proposal that reaches the CEO ships with an LLM validation link. Your first spend case gets stress\-tested by an advanced model to eliminate blind spots.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 Puffy, a market\-leading, nine\-figure D2C brand and Top 5 US mattress brand with over $1 billion in sales, is hiring a Senior Director of Performance Marketing to own a multi\-million\-dollar monthly paid media engine across Google and Meta with full authority over systems, measurement, creative testing, capital allocation, and team, reporting directly to the CEO.
 



  





 This role exists to convert a multi\-million\-dollar paid budget into maximum contribution margin, building the decision systems, measurement infrastructure, and team that let the revenue engine run and scale without day\-to\-day executive involvement.
 



  





**The Problems You'll Own:** 



* **Primary: Decide what to launch and where the budget goes:** 
 A multi\-million\-dollar monthly budget runs across Google and Meta, and every standard campaign type is already live and optimized: brand and non\-brand search, PMax, Meta prospecting and retargeting, Shopping and feed. Growth now has to come from what isn't running: new campaign structures, new creative, a different mix of spend.



  




* **Secondary: Build the system that runs the scaling decisions:** 
 Design and document the rules that govern spend, when to pause, when to increase budget, when to pull back, and the measurement each decision depends on. The system should run the scaling without day\-to\-day executive oversight.



  





**The Career Accelerator:** 




 This is not a role where you manage dashboards and present decks.
 



  




* **The scope is scarce** 
 : very few Senior Directors of Performance Marketing get simultaneous authority over multi\-million\-dollar monthly budgets on both major platforms, full ownership of measurement and creative systems, org design power, and a direct line to the CEO with no layers in between.
* **Your first 12 months:** 
 build pause/hold/scale logic, budget guardrails, and escalation protocols from scratch. Deploy incrementality testing and reconcile platform attribution against backend reality. Architect the creative engine as a system: concept pipeline, testing taxonomy, briefs, hook/hold analytics, UGC, and whitelisting. Design capital allocation on marginal return rather than platform\-reported averages. Design promo architecture across the retail calendar: pulse strategy, financing offers, funnel alignment. Identify, evaluate, and pilot paid channels beyond Google and Meta. Structure the performance marketing function itself. Shape the future of performance marketing at Puffy, where paid media is the primary growth lever.



  





**What Is In It For You:** 




 This isn't just another performance marketing role. This is your chance to become a true industry architect.
 



  





**1\. Own the Paid Engine End to End, With No Layers Above You** 




 You set the strategy, build the systems, and own the outcomes.
 



  




* You allocate multi\-million\-dollar monthly budgets across Google and Meta on marginal return rather than platform\-reported averages, design the pause/hold/scale logic and budget guardrails that govern all paid spend, and serve as the single source of truth on paid media performance. Creative runs as a system you architect: concept pipeline, testing taxonomy, briefs, hook/hold analytics, UGC, whitelisting.
* You hold profitability to a contribution\-margin standard after returns and financing costs, not ROAS in isolation. You lead, assess, and structure the performance marketing function with org design authority and CEO sign\-off, reporting directly to the CEO.



  





**2\. Join a High\-Performance Organization and Partner with the 1%:** 



* 🏆 Puffy: Top 5 Mattress Brand in US with Over $1 Billion USD in Sales
* 🌍 Great Place to Work Certified
* 💡 Work directly with Forbes Council Member CEO. Your vision is the company's vision.



 Gain firsthand exposure to strategic decisions and high\-velocity execution that drives a global brand
 



  





**3\. Embrace Radical Flexibility** 




 Work from anywhere in the world with meaningful time zone overlap. Structure your environment around your best thinking, whether that's a home office, a co\-working space, (OR) our Dubai headquarters (with full relocation, visa support, and 0% income tax if you choose). Your output is your credential, not your location.
 



  





**4\. Become the Operator Other Brands Try to Hire** 




 In most companies, performance marketing leaders inherit a system somebody else built and spend the next three years defending its numbers in meetings. Here you build it. When the CEO decides how much capital goes into growth next quarter, your model is the input to that decision, not a report on it afterwards. You'll leave with a paid media system you designed end to end, and the proof that it held contribution margin at scale, which is the part almost nobody in this function can actually show. Puffy has been AI\-First since December 2023, so you'll build it with an AI\-native toolbox behind you rather than an agency deck in front of you.
 



  





**What You'll Need:** 



* 7\+ years in performance marketing with sustained ownership of $1M\+/month on both Google and Meta (concurrently or across roles). "Ownership" means authority over strategy, structure, and budget, not just execution.
* Google depth at PMax\-era: campaign structure, feed management, brand/non\-brand economics.
* High\-AOV considered\-purchase experience ($1,000\+ order values): sparse\-conversion, long\-decision\-cycle categories.
* Personally built, not inherited, bid, budget, and pause decision systems at scale. You'll be asked to present a playbook you authored.
* Statistical decision literacy: volume gating, false\-kill vs. wasted\-spend trade\-offs, threshold derivation, incrementality test design.
* Creative testing systems at scale in a post\-ATT environment: concept\-vs\-variation discipline, creative analytics.
* Team leadership including senior direct reports. Experience building or restructuring a performance marketing function.
* Structured approach to new channel evaluation: selection frameworks, pilot design, budget allocation, and kill criteria.



  





**Good\-to\-Have:** 



* Scripting against Meta/Google APIs; Google Ads Scripts.
* Mixed agency \+ in\-house background.
* Experience with emerging paid channels (e.g., TikTok, Connected TV, affiliate/partnerships, etc.).
* D2C e\-commerce background in home goods, furniture, or comparable high\-AOV verticals.



  





**The Puffy DNA:** 




 We're restless, perpetually hungry, and fast\-paced, driven by an unwavering belief that we can outperform any competitor, regardless of their size.
 


* **Be the Owner:** 
 We don't hire employees; we welcome owners. You're accountable for results, not activity.
* **Execute with Urgency:** 
 We thrive in high\-stakes environments by making thoughtful decisions quickly and acting decisively.
* **Demand Excellence:** 
 We solve the hard problems that others can't, pushing the boundaries of our craft.
* **Be AI\-First:** 
 Daily multi\-turn AI conversations challenge your assumptions.
* **Go All\-In:** 
 When the mission demands it, we rally as one team to cross the finish line.



  





**✨ Your Total Compensation \& Benefits:** 



* 💰
 **Compensation:** 
 Total Annual Package: Up to USD $240,000 \+ comprehensive benefits (Base salary \+ monthly performance bonus of up to 20% of base)



 Annual salary review every January
 


* 🏥
 **Health \& Protection:** 
 Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance (based on country of hire)
* 🌴
 **Time Off:** 
 Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) \+ Public holidays



  





 💼
 **Work Environment:** 



* AI\-First organization with access to AI\-native tool stack
* Remote First: Work from the comfort of your home office
* Learning \& development opportunities
* International team collaboration across 16\+ nationalities. Your assumptions get challenged daily.



  





**🏆 Rewards \& Recognition:** 



* Eligibility for selection to the Leaders Club, an elite recognition program featuring premium wellness memberships, exclusive networking with senior leadership, and annual leadership retreats
* Eligibility for nomination as 'We Are' Champion of the Month, monthly recognition with gift vouchers and company\-wide celebration for exceptional contributions



  





**Ready to Shape Your Story?** 




 Click "Apply" and take the first step.

**Description**
 Digital Lifecycle Strategist at Strategic Product Planning
   

  

 Together with our customers and supply chain partners, governments, societies and other stakeholders, we are moving to develop and introduce transport and infrastructure solutions that drive prosperity socially, environmentally and financially.
   

  

 The shift to software\-defined vehicles (SDV) is fundamentally reshaping the automotive industry. At Company Group, we are not just adopting this transformation \- we are defining how it creates business value at scale. We are now looking for a Digital Lifecycle Strategist to strengthen Strategic Product Planning and play a key role in defining our future product portfolio direction.
   

  

 Why This Role is Different
   

  

 This is not a technology development role, and it is not a role focused on building digital services.
   

  

 This is a high\-impact strategic leadership role where you will define how software\-defined vehicle (SDV) capabilities translate into product portfolio direction, lifecycle value models, and long\-term business impact.
   

  

 You will ensure that SDV capabilities are reflected in the product plan, portfolio priorities, and lifecycle strategies, enabling sustainable value creation beyond the point of sale.
   

  

 What You Will Drive
   

  

**As Digital Lifecycle Strategist, You Will**
* Define the strategic framework connecting product strategy, feature roadmaps, lifecycle value models, and digital monetization
* Identify and prioritize strategic SDV initiatives impacting the product portfolio
* Shape how SDV capabilities influence product evolution and portfolio priorities (incl the ability to decouple functionality from hardware, enable continuous feature evolution, and create lifecycle\-based value streams through software, connectivity, and data)
* Establish principles for lifecycle value creation, including feature packaging and value capture over time
* Influence investment decisions and portfolio trade\-offs by integrating lifecycle thinking into the product plan


 Your future team
   

  

 You will join Strategic Product Planning, a highly strategic function within Trucks Technology. The team plays a central role in setting the direction of the long\-term product portfolio, translating business and customer needs into strategic product priorities, and navigating industry transformation.
   

  

 We work cross\-functionally and globally, with strong collaboration across brands and engineering.
   

  

 Who are you?
   

  

 You are not learning software\-defined vehicles \- you have already operated in this space for long and understand how software, connectivity, and business models reshape the product lifecycle.
   

  

* You bring 10\+ years of experience in strategic roles within automotive OEMs, technology companies, or adjacent industries
* You have direct experience shaping product strategy, lifecycle offerings, or digital monetization at scale
* You have influenced portfolio\-level decisions, not just contributed to individual initiatives
* You understand the intersection of product planning, software platforms, and business models in a software\-defined vehicle context


 You combine strategic thinking with strong business acumen and a holistic, future\-oriented mindset. You are comfortable operating in complex environments where industry standards are still evolving, and you can turn ambiguity into clear direction, focus areas, and priorities that guide long\-term decision\-making.
   

  

 You build trust through collaboration and are recognized for bringing stakeholders together across functions, brands, and levels. At the same time, you are confident challenging assumptions, highlighting difficult trade\-offs, and helping organizations converge on decisions that create long\-term impact.
   

  

 You take a data\-driven approach to strategy, simplifying complexity into actionable insights, and communicate with clarity and impact. Whether through storytelling, visualization, or executive dialogue, you are able to articulate direction in a way that drives alignment and momentum.

title: Associate Director - Growth & Retention
description:
**About Snapmint:** 




 India’s booming consumer market has over 300 million credit\-eligible consumers, yet only 35million actively use credit cards. At Snapmint, we are building a better alternative to credit cards that lets consumers buy now and pay later for a wide variety of products, be it shoes, clothes, fashion accessories, clothes or mobile phones. We firmly believe that an enduring financial services business must be built on the bedrock of providing honest, transparent and fair terms.
 



  





 Founded in 2017, today we are the leading online zero\-cost EMI provider in India. We have served over 10M consumers across 2,200 cities and are doubling year on year. Our founders are serial entrepreneurs and alumni of IIT Bombay and ISB with over two decades of experience across leading organizations like Swiggy, Oyo, Maruti Suzuki and ZS Associates before successfully scaling and exiting businesses in patent analytics, ad\-tech and bank\-tech software services.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 As Senior Manager / Associate Director – Growth \& Retention, you will own the full lifecycle P\&L—from activation to repeat behaviour to reactivation—and lead a multidisciplinary team of 12–15 across analytics, CRM, campaign operations, personalisation, and rewards. This is a function\-head role. You will set strategy, manage a significant incentive budget, and represent Growth \& Retention in leadership forums.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 ● Full Lifecycle P\&L: CLTV, contribution margin, incentive budget allocation, and ROAS across all customer segments and product lines.
 



 ● Activation: Turn new users (especially checkout\-origin) into first\-time transactors on Snapmint; drive app adoption and reduce time\-to\-first\-purchase.
 



 ● Deepening Engagement: Build the repeat flywheel—cross\-sell across marketplace, vouchers, personal loans, and recharges; increase multi\-product adoption.
 



 ● Retention \& Reactivation: Prolong active lifespan, predict and reduce churn, run winback campaigns with documented payback periods.
 



 ● Rewards \& Loyalty: Oversee the rewards programme as an integrated lifecycle lever—merchant partnerships, unit economics, and programme ROI.
 



 ● Team \& Organisational Leadership: Build, mentor, and scale a high\-performing team; set quarterly priorities; be the executive stakeholder for the CRM/engagement tech stack
 



  





**Qualifications:** 




 ● 7\+ years of experience, with 4\+ years in lifecycle/CRM/growth at a consumer internet or fintech company.
 



 ● 3\+ years of people management—you’ve led and developed teams during high\-growth phases.
 



 ● Proven P\&L ownership—you’ve been accountable for a lifecycle or retention budget and its economic outcomes, not just engagement metrics.
 



 ● Strong analytical foundation: SQL, Python, CLTV/RFM modelling, A/B testing, and cohort economics.
 



 ● Hands\-on familiarity with CRM platforms (CleverTap, MoEngage, or similar) and multi\-channel campaign design (push, WhatsApp, SMS, email, IVR).
 



 ● Exposure to rewards or loyalty programme mechanics is a strong plus.
 



 ● A leader who sets the agenda, makes decisions with margin and payback in mind, and drives cross\-functional influence with Product, Credit, and Data Science.

title: Marketplace Channel Lead
description:
About California Design Den
 



 California Design Den is a US premium home\-textiles brand — bedding and bath — sold across the major US online marketplaces and national retailers. We are founder\-led and profitable, with teams in the United States and India.
 



  





 About the role
 



 Amazon is the bulk of our business today. Our other marketplaces — Walmart, Target, Wayfair, Kohl's and Nordstrom — are the growth story, and right now they run as a part\-time extension of an Amazon\-shaped week. We're hiring the person who owns them. This is a commercial ownership role, not an account\-management or listing\-maintenance seat. You will own what we sell on every marketplace that isn't Amazon: the assortment, the pricing architecture, the promotional calendar, the retailer relationships, and the number.
 



  





 What you'll own
 



 • The growth number for Walmart, Target, Wayfair, Kohl's, Nordstrom and any channel we add.
 



 • The channel plan — which SKUs, at what price architecture, with what promotional calendar, and why. A channel is not a mirror of the Amazon catalogue.
 



 • Walmart first — concentrate our proven SKUs in WFS, run a coupon strategy aligned to the wider deal calendar, and bring Walmart advertising in\-house.
 



 • Channel advertising — own the budget and performance on Walmart Connect first, then the others as they scale.
 



 • Retailer relationships — own the merchant and category\-team relationship at each retailer: programme access, promotional slots, item\-setup escalations, compliance.
 



 • The pricing and margin case per channel — build it and bring it; retailer fee structures, fulfilment economics, competitive floor. (Final pricing sits with our pricing function; you own the argument.)
 



 • Channel health \& competitive intelligence — keep constant watch on content quality, organic visibility and search rank, ratings and reviews, assortment coverage and in\-stock availability, and competitors' pricing and promotions; surface the issues and the openings that move the growth number.
 



 • Channel demand \& availability — forecast demand by channel, flag fulfilment and stock constraints early, and make the case to supply chain to steer inventory toward the highest\-value marketplace opportunities. (Allocation sits with supply chain; you own the forecast and the argument.)
 



 • The business reviews — monthly and quarterly, written by you, leading with a recommendation.
 



 • Expansion calls — the written read on any new channel: size of prize, cost to serve, and a recommendation with the numbers behind it.
 



  





 What we're looking for
 



 • 3–5 years growing a US marketplace or retail.com channel commercially — Walmart Marketplace / WFS strongly preferred, or Target Plus, Wayfair, or a retailer\-dot\-com account — with a P\&L or a growth number attached to your name.
 



 • A builder, not a plan\-manager. You've personally stood up assortment, in\-housed ads, and negotiated promotional slots for a channel — not relayed retailer requirements for one that already had a team.
 



 • Commercially numerate: retailer fee structures, WFS and fulfilment economics, contribution margin, promotional lift and payback. You can build the case and defend it.
 



 • You've run marketplace advertising at the level of budget, placement and return.
 



 • You've managed a retailer merchant relationship directly and can point to something it unlocked.
 



 • You read the channel like an operator — you watch content, search rank, reviews, stock and competitor moves, and act before they cost you the number.
 



 • You write a business review that leads with a recommendation.
 



 • Amazon literacy expected — these channels move with the Amazon deal calendar. Strong Amazon category\-management or marketplace backgrounds are very welcome; what matters is that you've built a non\-Amazon channel commercially.
 



 • Home, textiles or a comparable considered\-purchase consumer category is a plus.
 



  





 Why this role is worth your time
 



 • You own a set of channels outright and report to the head of the function — a founding channel role, not a seat in a channel team.
 



 • Real scale behind Amazon to fund the bet, and a short path from idea to live.
 



 • A company that will back a commercial owner with the tools and the mandate to grow.
 



  





 How to apply
 



 Apply here on LinkedIn with your CV and a short note (4–6 lines) on one marketplace channel you grew: where it started, what you changed, and where it ended — and the one thing you'd do first at Walmart.

 We're looking for a sharp, proactive Brand Solutions Manager who leads with thinking and follows through with action. This is not a role for someone who waits for briefs. You will identify brands worth going after, find the gap or opportunity in their current marketing, build a compelling insight\-led strategy around it. And then use that strategy to open the doors. The pitch is your introduction. The relationship is what you build from there.
 



  





 If you're someone who reads a brand's campaign, immediately spots what's missing, and knows exactly what to tell the brand team to get a meeting, this role is for you.
 



  





**What you'll do** 




***Primary \- Identify \& Strategise***

* Build sharp, insight\-led influencer marketing strategies tailored to the brand unprompted, before any brief exists

***Secondary \- Outreach \& open doors***



* Use your strategy as the hook to reach out to brand decision\-makers. (Marketing heads, CMOs, founders, brand managers)

* Translate offline\-defined journeys, audience criteria and filters into executable CRM journeys and workflows.

* Build a strong understanding of retail banking products, including savings, personal loans, auto loans, mortgages and remittances, and how CRM activity contributes to revenue, customer engagement and profitability.

**3\. Minimum Requirements** 



* 7\+ years of relevant experience in CRM, customer lifecycle management, marketing automation, campaign execution or digital engagement, preferably in retail banking.
* Hands\-on experience building and executing CRM journeys in Microsoft Dynamics 365 / Microsoft CRM or a comparable enterprise CRM / marketing automation platform.
* Strong understanding of journey orchestration, audience segmentation, eligibility rules, filters, exclusions, triggers, channel routing and workflow configuration.
* Practical understanding of retail banking products and customer journeys; experience with savings, personal loans, auto loans, mortgages and/or remittances is strongly preferred.
* Ability to independently manage execution from business requirement through CRM build and go\-live.
* Strong stakeholder management and follow\-up skills across multiple teams and dependencies.
* Strong Excel skills, including ability to structure, clean up and improve complex operational trackers and build management reporting.
* Comfortable working with data, performance metrics and dashboards; able to interpret results and translate them into execution actions.
* Strong attention to detail, ownership mindset and ability to manage multiple CRM initiatives simultaneously.
* Able to operate independently in a complex, multi\-stakeholder banking environment and proactively identify what needs to happen next.



**6\. Preferred Experience** 



* Experience with large regional / international banks.
* Experience with Microsoft Dynamics / MCD or similar CRM platforms, including production journey go\-live.
* Experience in CRM automation, trigger\-based marketing, lifecycle campaigns or next\-best\-action environments.
* Experience working with retail banking commercial objectives and understanding how CRM initiatives contribute to top\-line and bottom\-line impact.
* Experience partnering with analytics teams on campaign performance, optimization and test\-and\-learn.
* Experience managing CRM operating trackers, dashboards and governance processes.

title: Marketing Operations Specialist, Asset Management
description:
**About Northern Trust**
 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
   

  

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
   

  

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
   

  

**Overview Of The Role**
 Northern Trust Asset Management's global marketing strategy is evolving, our team is growing and we’re looking for individuals interested in growing with us. We are seeking passionate, results\-driven, creative thinkers, with a high attention to detail who value collaboration.
   

  

 Reporting to the Head of Product Marketing Operations, the Marketing Operations Specialist position is a generalist role within our production team in Marketing Operations. The production team establishes and adapts the update cycle process and procedures to create scale and mitigate marketing/business risk. This includes, but is not limited to, creating a cycle framework, implementing regulatory updates, managing collateral updates, and automating deliverables. The team also assists with Seismic, specifically content maintenance and uploads and executing tasks designed to modernize the platform.
   

  

 The Marketing Operations Specialist has primary responsibility for the updating, maintenance and production of our quarterly and annual performance marketing content and materials across print and digital platforms. Secondarily, during off\-update cycle periods, the Specialist will take on additional efficiency projects.
   

  

 The role will require strong collaboration and partnership within Marketing and across Data Operations and Technology, Product Development and Management, Investments and Client Portfolio Management, Compliance and Legal, and Distribution to establish clear objectives and priorities.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Complete quarterly/annual update cycle of collateral materials (pitchbooks, profiles, flyers, bios, etc.) including content updates, status reporting, compliance submissions, and being well\-versed with all data and sources (performance, characteristics, rankings, internal databases, etc.)
* Create and manage procedures to efficiently and effectively scale content update \& maintenance, mitigate risk and comply with industry and internal standards
* Establish and maintain relationships throughout the firm, across Compliance, Technology/Data, Client Portfolio Managers/Portfolio Managers, Distribution, Reporting, and others
* Implement ad hoc content updates due to organization changes, fund actions, and regulatory rules \& changes, as established by governing bodies (SEC, FINRA, ASIC, FCA, ESMA, etc.), across various investment offerings, regions, and marketing assets, including coordinating changes to product webpages
* Review and identify opportunities to use technology to support efficiency and/or automation of marketing content and recurring deliverables, eliminating data dependency, redundancy \& reduce cycle time
* Be intellectually curious, gain a knowledge and understanding of our products, as well as continuing to research and learn about Marketing Operations and production advances in the industry
* Increase productivity by simplifying workflows using data and AI‑and automation\-driven tools
* Support the overall Marketing Operations team, acting as back\-up support for other roles and responsibilities within the group as designated


**Experience \& Skills**
 The successful candidate will benefit from having:
   

  

* 3 years of financial services performance/data update experience preferred
* Understanding of the investment management industry, familiarity with investment vehicles, marketing constructs, regulatory requirements, and distribution channels preferred
* Effective collaboration and communication (verbal \& written) skills
* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, with a commitment to quality
* Ability to prioritize in a fast\-paced environment
* Ability to follow established procedures and maintain accurate records
* Ability to think creatively and outside the box to find to solutions to known problems
* Demonstrated ability to multi\-task, ­effectively manage and navigate multiple projects, organize competing objectives and manage deadlines
* Strong work ethic and professional demeanor
* Creative and technical abilities across the Microsoft office suite, including Copilot


**Working with Us**
 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
   

  

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**
 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
   

  

**About Our Bangalore Office**
 The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub \- Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

description:

 Mudrex is one of India's leading crypto investment platforms, backed by Y Combinator and Nexus Venture Partners. We help users invest in digital assets through products built around simplicity, security, and trust.
   

  

**Role Overview:**
 We’re looking for a data\-obsessed Product Marketing Manager (4–5 years) to join Mudrex’s GTM and Growth team.
   

  

 You’ll own product GTM, lifecycle campaigns, reactivation, retention, cross\-sell, and upsell across Mudrex’s crypto ecosystem — from Spot and Futures to Alpha and other new products.
   

  

 This is a highly hands\-on, numbers\-driven role where you’ll use user data to identify opportunities, build segments, launch experiments, and drive measurable business impact.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* GTM \& Product Launches: Own end\-to\-end GTM for new products and features — positioning, messaging, launch strategy, and execution across product, email, and community.
* Lifecycle \& Campaigns: Plan and optimize monthly engagement, activation, and reactivation campaigns using CleverTap, with clear measurement of business impact.
* Retention \& Reactivation: Analyse the user lifecycle, identify churn and at\-risk users, and build strategies to improve retention and bring dormant users back.
* Cross\-Sell \& Upsell: Identify opportunities to move investor users into active trading products such as Futures, using behavioural and transactional data.
* Data \& Experimentation: Build ICPs and user segments, analyse cohorts and funnels using Metabase/SQL, and run A/B tests to improve conversion and adoption.


**Primary KPIs**
* Activation \& cross\-sell conversion
* Reactivation and D30/D90 retention
* Product adoption and engagement
* Campaign ROI and incremental trading activity
* LTV and revenue impact
* New product/feature adoption


**What We’re Looking For**
* 4–5 years of experience in B2C Product Marketing, Growth, or Lifecycle Marketing, preferably in Fintech.
* Crypto/trading experience is a strong plus, not mandatory.
* Strong understanding of user lifecycle, retention, churn, reactivation, cross\-sell and upsell.
* Proven experience owning GTM and growth campaigns end\-to\-end.
* Hands\-on experience with CleverTap, Amplitude, Plotline, or similar tools.
* Strong data and analytical skills; comfortable with Metabase/SQL or using AI to analyse data and answer business questions.
* Highly execution\-oriented with a strong bias for experimentation and measurable outcomes.
* Excellent communication and storytelling skills.


**The Ideal Candidate**
 Someone who can look at a user dataset and answer:
   

  

 Who should we target? Why? What should we tell them? What action do we want them to take? And did it actually move the metric?

title: Director of Product Marketing
description:
**The Opportunity\-** 




  





 The database market is being rewritten. Legacy monoliths can't deliver the scale, resilience, and cloud\-native architecture that modern applications and AI agents demand. YugabyteDB is leading that transformation with YugabyteDB, the distributed SQL database built to run anywhere, at any scale, without forcing a trade\-off between consistency and reach.
 



 We're hiring a Director of Product Marketing to own how the world understands that story.
 



 This is a global role based in Bangalore. You will own positioning and messaging for our core products worldwide, not for a single region, and you will be the senior product marketing voice in India. You'll work at the intersection of product, demand generation, sales, community, and developer relations, turning deep technical reality into narratives that differentiate and drive the pipeline.
 



  





**What You'll Do\-** 




  




* Own end\-to\-end positioning and messaging for YugabyteDB products, grounded in real customer problems and honest competitive assessment.
* Lead global product launches, coordinating product, engineering, sales, marketing, and DevRel to bring new capabilities to market with impact. You own the outcome, not just the launch checklist.
* Write and produce creative and credible content technically: solution briefs, battle cards, pitch decks, white papers, analyst submissions, and demo narratives that the field actually uses and buyers actually finish.
* Own competitive intelligence across PostgreSQL\-compatible databases, distributed SQL entrants, cloud\-provider offerings, and legacy RDBMS vendors. Keep it rigorous, keep it current, and make it usable in a live deal.
* Run analyst relations alongside the VP: briefings, inquiries, and submissions to Gartner, Forrester, and GigaOm.
* Partner with developer relations so community messaging, open\-source storytelling, and go\-to\-market motion reinforce each other rather than diverge.
* Build sales enablement that shortens ramp time and lifts win rates. Be the person a seller calls the night before a competitive bake\-off.
* Drive partner and ecosystem marketing, with particular focus on the AI ecosystem: model providers, agent frameworks, and AI infrastructure partners.
* Report on pipeline influenced, win rate against named competitors, launch adoption, and content engagement, and use those numbers to decide what to stop doing.
* Feed market signal back into the roadmap. You'll have a standing seat with Product and leadership, and we expect you to use it.



  





**What You Bring\-** 




  





 We're hiring for a high bar, and these are the things we require from the candidates:
 


* 10\+ years in product marketing, with substantial time in databases, data infrastructure, or cloud\-native platforms. You know this terrain, and you don't need a ramp to understand why replication and consistency models matter.
* Technical credibility. You don't need to write production code, but you need to hold your own with a staff engineer or a skeptical DBA and earn their respect in the first ten minutes.
* A portfolio of positioning and messaging work you can walk us through: what the market believed before, what you changed, and how you knew it worked.
* Experience supporting a developer\-led or open\-source motion. You understand that community trust is earned slowly and spent quickly.
* Demonstrated ownership of cross\-functional launches where you carried the outcome, not just the project plan.
* Exceptional writing. A post, a one\-pager, and an analyst brief should all read like they came from the same clear\-thinking company.
* Good presentation skills. Expect to present to a technical audience during virtual and in\-person events
* Startup or scale\-up experience. You operate with speed, ambiguity, and fewer resources than the plan assumed.
* Fluency with AI tooling in your actual workflow( research, drafting, competitive monitoring, synthesis). Be ready to show us how it changed your throughput, not just that you've tried it.
* Comfort operating from India on a global charter. Flexibility for local and international travel.



  





**Nice to have\-** 




  




* Meaningful depth in PostgreSQL, distributed systems, or cloud infrastructure.
* Experience marketing an open\-source product alongside a commercial offering.
* Prior analyst relations ownership.
* Experience as the first senior marketing hire in a region.



  





**Why Yugabyte\-** 




  




* **A once\-in\-a\-career window.** 
 YugabyteDB is central to solving the world’s AI agent and application problems. Every week, new opportunities arise. It’s fun, it’s fast\-paced, and it’s something you’ll be proud of later in your career.
* **Category\-defining technology.** 
 YugabyteDB is the open\-source distributed SQL database built for cloud\-native applications. It's PostgreSQL\-compatible, globally distributed, and production\-proven at scale.
* **Real traction.** 
 Yugabyte is trusted by leading enterprises across financial services, retail, gaming, and beyond. This isn't a pre\-revenue bet.
* **A team that ships.** 
 Product and engineering move fast. You'll have no shortage of launches to lead or stories to tell.
* **Marketing leadership who's in the trenches with you.** 
 This role reports directly to the VP of Product Marketing and Developer Relations, someone who cares deeply about craft and will invest in your growth.
* **Competitive compensation.** 
 Salary, equity, and benefits commensurate with a senior role at a well\-funded, high\-growth company.

Provides daily operational updates, a weekly performance report, a monthly marketing dashboard and a quarterly marketing review.

title: Marketing Strategist
description:
* **RetainIQ**
* **Bangalore**
* **1\-2 years experience**
* **₹8\-10 LPA (based on experience)**



  






 If you've been doing marketing for a few years and find yourself more interested in the strategy and craft of customer retention than another Meta ads dashboard, read on.
   





**About us** 


 RetainIQ is a tech\-first retention marketing company based in Bangalore. We've built our own personalization platform that powers email and SMS programs for D2C brands across the US; candle companies, supplement brands, apparel labels, outdoor gear, pet products. Our SaaS tooling sits at the core of how we deliver retention outcomes that our clients can measure directly in revenue.
 





 We're hiring across the marketing team this year as we grow. This is one of the most important roles in the company; the person in this seat is the brain behind every brand's marketing program.
   





**What you'll actually do** 


 You'll own marketing strategy for 5\-6 D2C brand accounts. The work spans:
 



* Build the quarterly retention strategy for each brand you own. Where the revenue is coming from, where the gaps are, what to fix next.
* Translate strategy into monthly campaign calendars. Promotional sends, lifecycle flows, A/B tests, segmentation experiments.
* Write campaign briefs that designers and copywriters execute against. Some weeks you'll write copy yourself.
* Run weekly client calls. Read their data, present what's working and what's not, recommend the next move. These are senior\-level conversations with founders and marketing leads.
* Audit existing email and SMS programs. Find what's broken or missing and build a plan to fix it.
* Use our internal personalization platform, Klaviyo, Hiro Analytics, and a deep AI tooling stack to move 3\-5x faster than a traditional marketer.
* Work alongside a Designer, a Pod Lead, and a Customer Success Associate. Strong collaboration is the default mode.


**What we're looking for** 
* 1\-2 years in marketing of any flavor. Performance marketing, content marketing, brand marketing, lifecycle marketing, growth marketing, all relevant. Email marketing experience specifically is a plus but not a requirement.
* Comfortable with data. You should be able to look at a campaign report or a funnel chart, form a hypothesis about why the numbers look the way they do, and recommend a next step.
* Strong written communication. Briefs, copy, client emails, internal docs. Writing is most of the job. Strong writing is non\-negotiable.
* The ability to think in systems. Lifecycle marketing isn't a sequence of campaigns; it's an interconnected engine. We need someone who can see the engine.
* Comfortable on calls with US\-based clients. Confident, warm, articulate. You should be able to hold your own with founders and marketing leads.
* Klaviyo, HubSpot, Mailchimp, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, MoEngage, or any modern ESP experience is a plus, not a requirement. We'll teach you our stack.
* Service mindset paired with a strong point of view. You like clients and want them to win, but you also push back when they're wrong.


**What we're not looking for** 
* Pure media buyers who haven't done strategic or lifecycle work.
* Marketers who define themselves by which platform they ran ads on. We care how you think, not what platforms you've touched.
* People who think marketing is about creativity alone, with no patience for spreadsheets, performance data, or process. The role is 60% rigor, 40% craft.
* Candidates who view agency work as a stepping stone they want to leave in 12 months. The best growth here comes from staying long enough to own a real book of business.


**What you get** 
* ₹8\-10 LPA based on experience. The Specialist vs Strategist title is decided at offer based on level.
* Real ownership from week one. You'll be the named lead on 4\-5 brand accounts, not a junior on someone else's account.
* Exposure to 50\+ US D2C brands across categories. Few marketing roles in India offer this.
* AI\-augmented workflow. We invest heavily in tooling, including our own platform, and you'll come out of this knowing how to leverage AI for marketing better than 99% of marketers.
* Growth path: Senior Strategist, Pod Lead are the real next steps for the right person.
* Hybrid working out of our Bangalore office.



  





**How to Apply:** 




  





 Please fill this form \-\>
 **https://forms.gle/CS2AU27C6Wwmvy6K8** 




  





**Selection Process:** 



1. Apply via form
2. Assignment
3. L1 interview with a senior marketing strategist
4. L2 interview with marketing head

description:
**MISSION** 




  





 Retail Investors across the world are ready to build wealth, but lack research \& advice they can trust. StockGro is fixing that.
 



  





 As India's leading stock market advisory and research platform, StockGro connect 35M\+ users with 150\+ SEBI\-registered experts and our proprietary Stoxo AI. On our platform, users access research\-backed trade ideas and turn complex stock market data into simple, actionable insights; facilitating research, backtesting and trade execution on one platform. We are also expanding our intelligent investing infrastructure across GCC, starting with the UAE.
 



  





 We were featured among CB Insights Top 100 Fintechs globally (2023\) and highlighted by the World Economic Forum (2026\) for driving financial inclusion through AI (2026\).

 Founded in 2020 by Ajay Lakhotia (former VC and seasoned entrepreneur), StockGro set out to solve a fundamental gap: making trusted, high\-quality investment advice accessible to everyone. Today, we are India's largest stock market advisory and research platform, empowering over 35 million users to invest smartly.
 



  





*Backed by Global Leaders*




 We have raised \~$110M from marquee investors including BITKRAFT Ventures, General Catalyst, SBI Investments (Japan), and Roots Ventures, with early backing from angels like Kunal Shah, Vivekananda Hallekere, and Rahul Garg.
 



  





*Driven by High\-Density Talent*




 Our team includes senior leaders from Sequoia, Swiggy, Glance, Airtel, and Uber, alongside alumni from ISB, the IIMs, and the NITs. Together, we are building an AI\-powered investment intelligence stack and scaling our footprint across the GCC to make smart investments universally accessible.
 



  





*Why Join Us?*




 You will work on hard, meaningful problems that help generations build wealth. We move fast, think clearly, and give you complete ownership to build products that transform lives for millions of global investors.
 



  





**Why this role?** 




  





 We do not want to be another brand demystifying the space by talking about personal finance.
 



 We want to enable users to
 **do better research** 
 .
 



 This is a high\-impact role where you will drive initiatives that build StockGro’s brand association with
 **better research in capital markets** 
 . You will be responsible for creating content that does more than inform \- it helps users understand markets, ask better questions, and make more informed decisions.
 



  





**What we expect?** 




  




* Build and own original content IPs



 Develop and own original, recognisable content IPs that
 **scream “Research”** 
 across social media and other relevant channels.
 



  




1. Understand our target audience, identify what they want to learn, and build repeatable content franchises that drive engagement, learning, and strong brand recall \- while owning the performance metrics behind them.
2. The content should span market instruments and themes including
 **equities, mutual funds, ETFs, bonds, commodities, macroeconomics, personal finance, and broader capital markets.**



  




* Be close to the markets



  




1. Track capital\-market developments in real time and identify opportunities to turn market\-moving events, earnings, economic announcements, sector developments, and emerging trends into high\-impact content.
2. Work closely with internal teams to move quickly when something matters to the market and create content that is timely, relevant, and useful.



  




* Turn research into content



  




1. Drive high\-quality
 **research reports, articles, blogs, video scripts, newsletters, social content, and other finance\-first formats** 
 for StockGro’s owned and digital channels.

1. Analyse market data, company earnings, economic events, financial trends, and other relevant information to create content that helps users understand

1. Collaborate closely with
 **Design, Video, Product, Growth, and Community** 
 teams to turn research and insights into high\-performing multimedia content that drives both engagement and learning.

1. Measure content performance through relevant engagement, consumption, retention, and brand metrics.
2. Use audience behaviour, platform trends, and performance insights to continuously improve content formats, distribution, and the overall content strategy.

 Help us build the brand people associate with

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Location: Bengaluru, Pune — on\-site
 



 This regional real\-estate developer has always sold through brokers and word of mouth in its home city. Its next project is in a second city where it has no existing broker network and no name recognition, which means digital is now the primary way it will reach buyers rather than a supporting channel. The company has partnered with Flexiple to hire a Digital Marketing Manager to own that shift.
 



**What you'd be building** 




 You will set up and run digital demand generation for a project launch from close to zero: paid search and social aimed at homebuyers researching a new city, a landing page and lead\-capture flow, and a retargeting sequence for people who visit a show apartment but do not book on the spot. Real estate lead cycles are long and this is not a lead\-farming role — you will be measured on qualified site visits and bookings, not raw form fills.
 



**How the launch team runs** 



* You report to the head of sales and marketing and work alongside the on\-ground sales team that handles site visits
* You manage the budget and agency relationship for paid media directly
* You track cost per qualified lead and cost per booking, and adjust spend weekly based on what sales is closing



**Who this role needs** 




 Two to seven years in digital or performance marketing, ideally with some real\-estate, high\-ticket, or long\-cycle\-purchase experience. You should be comfortable owning a paid budget directly, reading a CRM to understand what is actually converting to bookings rather than just leads, and working closely with an on\-ground sales team rather than at arm's length from them.
 


* Hands\-on experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads, including landing\-page and retargeting setup
* Comfort with a CRM and basic funnel reporting



**What you'd get out of it** 




 You would be the first owner of a real digital budget at this company, not inheriting someone else's dashboards, with direct visibility into what converts to actual bookings and a straight line to the head of sales and marketing.
 



**How this moves** 




 A short case exercise on the launch, one round with the head of sales and marketing, and a decision within two weeks.
 



 This application also puts you forward for other digital marketing roles we are currently hiring for.

**1\. Brand Strategy \& Creative Direction** 



* Own creative and strategic decisions that align with company goals, objectives, and budget.
* Lead idea development to create compelling, motivating campaigns that drive audience response.
* Develop branding collateral for digital platforms (graphics, videos, articles) and traditional formats (catalogues, brochures, diaries, calendars, wall paintings, signboards, flex banners, posters).
* Conceptualize campaigns for in\-store and exclusive\-store branding, including product branding, logo placement, colour schemes, packaging, and user manuals.
* Ensure consistent branding across online and offline channels.



  





**2\. Digital Marketing, E\-commerce \& Performance** 



* **Performance Marketing \& SEO:** 

 Execute and scale paid ad campaigns across Google and Meta; use keyword research and Google Search Console to monitor and improve search visibility.
* **E\-commerce \& Web Optimization:** 

 Manage website aesthetics and user experience — page layouts, imagery, and copywriting — to improve conversion rates.
* **Social Media \& Brand Growth:** 

 Plan and execute a consistent social media calendar to expand community reach and organic engagement.



  





**3\. Offline Retail \& BTL Execution** 



* Manage setup operations for new retail outlet openings.
* Participate in branding activities such as online campaigns, mobile showroom (display truck) tours, field demonstrations, exhibitions, TV/radio ads, and other promotional activities.
* Coordinate end\-to\-end design and nationwide fulfilment of physical print materials for regional teams.
* Support company events — season kick\-offs, annual dealer meetings, technician and farmer meetings, press meetings, etc.
* Visit dealers regularly to strengthen in\-store and neighbourhood branding.



  





**4\. Team Leadership** 



* Manage the in\-house creative pod — two graphic designers and one video editor — directing day\-to\-day operations and workflows.
* Work with external agencies on ATL, BTL, digital, and PR activities to strengthen KisanKraft's image among farmers, dealers, and government stakeholders.
* Build the team: recruit, train, and continuously raise the bar.



  





**5\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Market Intelligence** 



* Align the organization around a consistent marketing direction and product line strategy.
* Analyze brand positioning through market research, dealer and exhibition visits, consumer insights, and competitor tracking to identify opportunities and issues.
* Partner closely with the sales team to map branding activities to crops and seasons, ensuring strategy stays in sync with crop data across regions.



  





**6\. Performance Tracking \& Reporting** 



* Track and report on the performance of all marketing campaigns and branding activities, including progress of your team and external agencies, to management.
* Stay flexible to take on new assignments as business priorities shift.



  





**Travel** 





 Occasional travel is required to visit exhibitions, customers, and farmer events.
