title: Marketing Programs Manager - Europe Strategic Market Unit
description:
Job description:
   

  

 About the role:
 
 This is an Enterprise\-focused B2B marketing position responsible for shaping and orchestrating impactful Marketing programs for the region, reporting directly to the Europe CMO. Proactively collaborating with stakeholders across the business to drive integrated programs aligned to ABM, Events, and Campaigns to enhance Wipro’s reputation in the market. 
   

 The role will focus primarily on collaborating with Wipro’s industry experts and Consulting Partners in Europe to supercharge priority client engagement with Wipro’s unified suite of AI\-powered platforms, solutions and transformative offerings.
 


 R͏esponsibilities:
 
 Orchestrate key marketing programs at a Pan\-Europe level in close collaboration with the Field Marketing leads across the region. Specifically:
 



 •    Partner with Wipro’s industry experts and Consulting leaders in Europe – To build and lead Consulting\-led, AI\-Powered, \& Industry\-focused market activation. Coordinate marketing resources to deliver relevant industry content and a joined\-up approach, feeding 1\-to\-1 and Industry cluster ABM.
   

 •    Planning and cross\-functional collaboration – Connect teams across Marketing to align resources behind a cohesive and coordinated outreach plan for Europe, targeting key clients and industries.
   

 •    Account\-based Marketing: Design 1\-2\-1 programs, capability, and content for local deployment to help shape and win large deals, with emphasis on initiatives that can be repeated and scaled.
   

 •    Large Industry events located in Europe: Support the Europe CMO to drive regional event activation to maximize global investment and client impact; to shape and enable the agreed plans working closely with the global event owners, Business owners, and the Field Marketing leads in the region, evaluate regional client impact and ensure swift follow\-up on leads generated.
   

 •    Campaign coordination and activation: Working across a matrix structure of Central Marketing and Field Marketing teams to design and execute impactful campaigns across a variety of channels. 
   

 •    Analyst \& Advisor collaboration: Support the Europe CMO to drive pan\-Europe A\&A initiatives in close collaboration with the Market Development team. Shape and deliver programs and capability centrally and for scale, designed for local activation/localization.
   

 •    Alliance Partner collaboration: Work proactively with Alliance Partner marketing colleagues and Wipro’s regional Partner leaders to build regional programs that attract MDF and can be rolled out across Europe to enhance our brand reputation and client outreach efforts.
   

 •    KPI Measurement \& Data Insights: Utilize analytics platforms working closely with the MarTech team to understand program impact and create dashboards/reports to interpret and visualize outcomes to guide others.
 


 E͏xperience:
 
 We’re looking for an energetic Enterprise B2B Marketing professional, with experience working in fast\-paced, large matrix environments. The successful candidate will be a strong communicator and proactive collaborator, capable of leading teams and projects, and a track\-record of driving change and impact within the function. Specifically:
   

 •    Minimum 10 years’ B2B marketing experience, preferably working in IT Services, SaaS or Technology industries. Ideally with experience aligned to the Europe region.
   

 •    A strong team player who demonstrates good communication skills and initiative.
   

 •    Strong background in ABM, content creation/curation for B2B Programs and campaigns. 
   

 •    Experience of leading matrix teams and projects, plus a track\-record of delivering and evidencing marketing impact (on revenue, relationships and reputation).
   

 •    Excellent knowledge of marketing channels, technology and platforms, ideally Salesforce.com, Marketo, and 6Sense or similar.
   

 •    Good organizational skills, experience of working in a fast\-paced environment, and ability to effectively coordinate multiple stakeholders.
   

 •    Strong analytical skills with ability to highlight key insights in an impactful and simple way.
   

 •    High energy self\-starter with a can\-do attitude, and ability to learn quickly.
 


 ͏
 




 Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end\-to\-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA \- as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention. Come to Wipro. Realize your ambitions.

title: Sr Mgr, Field Marketing
description:
At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation.
   

  

 Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.
   

  

**Job Family Overview**
 The Marketing family group at F5 is responsible marketing and advertising, including creative services, market research and customer insights, product messaging, and branding and design. Supports marketing efforts for online media and platforms as well as printed marketing materials.
   

  

 F5’s Field Marketing family is responsible for developing and executing marketing strategies to support brand awareness, demand generation, and customer engagement across various regions and geographies. Collaborates closely with sales, product marketing, communications and digital teams to align local messaging, campaigns and go\-to\-market plans with global business objectives. May span content development, event execution, campaign management and performance tracking.
   

  

**Field Marketing Fundamental 5**
**TECHNICAL ACUMEN**
 Possesses a broad understanding of marketing strategies to drive creative solutions and brand awareness. Knowledge of planning, organizing and executing programs that generate new prospects, advance existing opportunities and align Marketing investment with targeted campaigns, programs, and initiatives that contribute to pipeline growth, deal acceleration and awareness.
   

  

**CRITICAL REASONING (JUDGMENT, DECISION MAKING, AND PRAGMATISM).**
 Exercises sound judgment based on an ability to incorporate experience, data, priorities, and stakeholder needs, and evaluate potential constraints to arrive at the most beneficial path forward. Consistently exhibits the ability to navigate situations with thought, purpose, and sensibility after adequately contemplating various available courses of action, balancing the trade\-offs between immediate and long\-term needs. Recognizes that while the effect of a single fix may not always be terribly significant, the accumulative effect over time makes each decision extremely valuable.
   

  

**INITIATIVE \& ADAPTABILITY**
 Does more than is required or expected, not because someone requested it but because it will improve or enhance a product and/or
   

  

 avoid problems. Plans for upcoming problems or opportunities and takes actions accordingly. Applies original thinking to improve processes, methods, systems, or services. Deals well with ambiguities, focusing on evaluating a situation, identifying what is and is not a priority, and moving toward the most logical outcome.
   

  

**PARTNERSHIP**
 Recognizes collaboration fosters the most effective exchange of ideas and talent, facilitating open dialogues with a wide variety of contributors and
   

  

 stakeholders, building partnerships, leveraging skillsets, and sharing knowledge to achieve a common goal. Creates alignment through mutual accountability,
   

  

 transparent communications, and the application of change management principles.
   

  

**COMMUNICATION AND COLLABORATION**
 Conveys information, vision, and strategy in an accurate and timely manner, adjusting to ensure understanding based on the audience. Actively listens; seeks to understand rather than respond. Proactively solicits and values diverse perspectives, ideas, and opinions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Marketing professional with 10\-20 years experience in leading high impact teams.
* Lead marketing strategy and execution across multiple geographies or industry segments, ensuring alignment with corporate growth objectives.
* Build strong partnerships with regional and field sales leaders to inform marketing plans, messaging, and account targeting.
* Drive performance reviews across campaigns, adjusting strategies based on pipeline data, win/loss insights, and customer engagement metrics.
* Champion adoption of marketing automation, ABM, and analytics tools across the team to improve personalization and ROI tracking.
* Foster collaboration across marketing functions (e.g., demand gen, content, brand, creative) to deliver cohesive and impactful programs.


**Attributes**
* Advanced understanding of functional areas and a competent understanding of the overall company and competitive environment.
* Problems are not clearly defined and lack strategic direction.
* Erroneous decisions will result in critical delay(s) in schedules and/or unit operations and may jeopardize overall business activities.
* Decisions directly impact medium\-term (more than one year) results of the team/ program/group.
* Requires the ability to persuade others in sensitive complex situations while preserving relationships.
* Applies knowledge in local Marketing practices to convince other stakeholders of desired departmental outcomes.

description:

title: Manager - Content and Marketing
description:
**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a strategic and experienced communications and marketing leader to drive the media, content, communications and brand storytelling agenda for Inspire Institute of Sport (IIS). The role is responsible for shaping how IIS is positioned and represented across media, digital platforms, athlete storytelling, institutional communications and key sporting moments. The role combines strategic planning with hands\-on execution, working closely with athletes, coaches, leadership, partners, donors, agencies and internal teams.
 



  





 The role will serve as a key custodian of the IIS brand narrative — defining what we say, how we say it, where we say it and how we build sustained visibility for IIS, its athletes, programmes and impact.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Media, Communications \& Brand Strategy** 



* Develop and lead the annual media, communications and content strategy for IIS, aligned with organisational priorities, sporting calendars and long\-term brand objectives.
* Own IIS's external narrative across earned media, digital, social, institutional and stakeholder communications.
* Develop proactive media strategies around major sporting milestones, athlete achievements, institutional announcements and strategic initiatives.
* Build and maintain relationships with relevant national and sports media, publishers and other communication stakeholders.
* Lead communications around high\-profile sporting events, including the Commonwealth Games, Asian Games and LA 2028 journey.
* Identify and manage reputational and communications risks, including crisis and sensitive communications where required.



**2\. Content \& Storytelling** 



* Own the overall content strategy and editorial direction across IIS's digital and social ecosystem.
* Establish and maintain a consistent brand voice, tone and visual/editorial language across platforms.
* Develop content narratives around athletes, coaches, programmes, sporting achievements, institutional milestones and IIS's wider impact.
* Lead the ideation and execution of content across formats including video, social, long\-form storytelling, photography, graphics, web and editorial content.
* Plan and oversee content calendars around sporting events, athlete milestones, campaigns and institutional priorities.
* Work closely with creative teams, production partners, agencies and internal stakeholders to deliver high\-quality content.



**3\. Marketing \& Campaigns** 



* Develop and execute integrated marketing and communication campaigns to strengthen IIS's brand awareness and positioning.
* Lead content\-led launches and campaigns for new sports programmes, initiatives and IIS properties.
* Develop campaigns that translate IIS's athlete development and sporting impact into compelling public\-facing narratives.
* Oversee campaign planning, execution, measurement and optimisation across relevant channels.
* Identify opportunities to leverage major sporting events and cultural moments to increase IIS's visibility.



**4\. Athlete \& Sporting Communications** 



* Develop storytelling frameworks that bring IIS athlete journeys, performances and human\-interest stories to life.
* Lead communications and content planning around athletes participating in major international competitions.
* Work with coaches, programme managers and athlete support teams to identify stories, milestones and opportunities.
* Coordinate media opportunities, interviews, athlete features and other visibility initiatives.



**5\. Donor \& Stakeholder Communications** 



* Own the communications and content dimension of IIS donor relationships and partnerships.
* Develop brand\-integrated storytelling and campaigns that demonstrate the impact of donor support.
* Lead content inputs for donor communications, impact stories and the annual report/funding impact narrative.
* Work closely with leadership and internal stakeholders to ensure consistent messaging across institutional and external communications.



**6\. Agency, Team \& Budget Management** 



* Lead and manage an in\-house media/content team and external agency partners.
* Define agency scopes, identify/select partners, manage workflows and ensure quality and timely delivery.
* Provide strategic and creative direction to agencies across content, PR, digital, design, production and related requirements.
* Own and manage the annual marketing and communications budget, including planning, allocation and vendor management.
* Establish effective processes for prioritisation, approvals, production and delivery across multiple stakeholders.



**7\. Digital \& Owned Platforms** 



* Lead the content and communications strategy across IIS's owned digital platforms, including social media and website.
* Oversee the strategic development and evolution of the IIS digital ecosystem.
* Ensure the website and social platforms effectively communicate IIS's programmes, athletes, achievements and institutional impact.
* Track content and digital performance and use insights to inform future strategy.



**8\. Strategic Projects \& Brand Development** 



* Lead major brand and communications projects that strengthen IIS's long\-term positioning.
* Drive strategic initiatives such as website redevelopment, brand assets, institutional storytelling and the IIS Inspire Museum project.
* Coordinate multiple agencies, departments and senior stakeholders to deliver complex projects end\-to\-end.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen the relationship between IIS, JSW Sports and the wider JSW ecosystem.



**9\. JSW Sports / Ecosystem Integration** 



* Collaborate across IIS and JSW Sports properties to identify opportunities for shared storytelling, audience development and brand amplification.
* Lead communications and content strategy for relevant cross\-property initiatives and partnerships.
* Provide strategic communications and content counsel to other JSW Sports properties where required.



**Key Requirements** 



* 10\+ years of experience in media, communications, content, marketing, brand or related roles, preferably within sports, media, entertainment or adjacent industries.
* Strong understanding of sports media, digital content, PR, brand storytelling and integrated communications.
* Demonstrated experience developing and executing strategic communication and marketing plans.
* Experience managing teams, agencies, vendors and significant budgets.
* Strong editorial judgement with the ability to turn complex institutional, sporting or athlete stories into compelling narratives.
* Experience working with senior stakeholders, athletes, coaches, partners, donors and media.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple high\-priority initiatives simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong understanding of social and digital platforms and evolving content formats.
* Ability to operate comfortably between strategy and execution in a fast\-paced sporting environment.
* Passion for sport and a strong understanding of the role that storytelling and communications play in building sports properties and athlete brands.

Our robust product portfolio includes world leading MCUs, SoCs, Analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products.  Renesas employs roughly 21,000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. * Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including marketing and customer success teams, to drive customer engagement and revenue growth.
* Stay up to date with industry trends, competitor activities, and Altium’s evolving product offerings.
* Office based in Bangalore with potential travel within India


**Qualifications**
**Who We’re Looking For**
* Bachelor's degree in business, communication, or a related field is desirable or a combination of equivalent education and experience.
* 10\+ years of experience in SaaS software sales , preferably with a focus on annual subscriptions and maintenance contracts; ECAD, MCAD, or PLM experience is a strong plus.
* Proven leadership experience with a track record of successfully managing and coaching sales teams.
* Strong communication and negotiation skills with the ability to influence decision\-makers at all levels.
* Self\-driven and results\-oriented with a passion for sales and business growth.
* Experience working with customers across PAN India is essential
* Proficiency in CRM systems such as Salesforce is highly desirable.
* Fluency in English is required; knowledge of additional Indian languages is a plus


**Additional Information**
 Altium Limited, a part of the Renesas Group and headquartered in San Diego, California, is a global software company accelerating the pace of electronics innovation. We are redefining electronic product creation in a software\-defined world with our industry\-first cloud\-based platform that unites every stakeholder and phase of electronics development.
   

  

 From startups to world’s technology giants, our digital platforms give more power to PCB designers, supply chain, and manufacturing, letting them collaborate as never before. At Altium, our teams are empowered to innovate, collaborate globally, and help create the future of electronics development.
   

  

 We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
**Marketing Manager** 




 Own Growth. Drive Visibility. Turn Traffic into Business.

 8 LPA \- 10 LPA
 



  





**Why this role exists** 




 For most customers, the journey with Zolo starts online. Whether someone is searching for co\-living, student housing, hotels, or short stays, search remains one of the most powerful acquisition channels available to the business. As Zolo continues to scale, we need a growth\-focused marketer who can ensure that customers discover us before they discover our competitors. This role exists to build and scale a predictable acquisition engine through SEO and Google Ads.
 



 A strong hire will help us:
 


* Increase qualified website traffic
* Improve search visibility across key categories
* Generate high\-quality leads at efficient costs
* Improve conversion from traffic to bookings
* Build sustainable growth beyond paid dependency

* Own SEO performance across Zolo businesses
* Manage and optimize Google Ads campaigns end\-to\-end
* Drive growth in organic traffic and lead generation
* Improve conversion rates across landing pages and campaigns
* Maximize marketing ROI through continuous optimization
* Build a data\-driven growth engine through experimentation and analysis



 This is not a campaign execution role.
 



 It is end\-to\-end ownership of search visibility, paid acquisition performance, and growth outcomes.
 



  





**About Zolo** 




 Finding dependable accommodation has historically been fragmented and inconsistent.
 



 People settled for compromises because the system offered few trustworthy options.
 



 Zolo reimagined living and hospitality as a connected journey.
 



 Zolo Coliving simplifies urban living.
 



 Z Hotels serves the modern traveler with consistency, warmth, and operational discipline.
 



 Today, over 100,000 people trust Zolo across different phases of life. Our ambition is to build the most trusted living and hospitality ecosystem for the new generation.
 



  





**What you will be responsible for** 




**1\.Own SEO Growth**

* Improve keyword rankings across priority business categories

* Identify opportunities to grow organic visibility and traffic

* Ensure continuous improvement in acquisition metrics



**3\.Drive Traffic\-to\-Conversion Performance** 



* Improve landing page performance and conversion rates
* Partner with design and product teams to optimize user journeys
* Run A/B tests and growth experiments
* Identify and remove conversion bottlenecks



**4\.Use Data to Drive Decisions** 



* Track traffic, lead generation, conversion, and acquisition metrics
* Monitor CPL, ROAS, CTR, conversion rates, and keyword performance
* Build performance dashboards and business insights
* Take decisions based on data rather than assumptions



**5\.Own Growth Experiments**

* Strong reporting visibility across growth channels

 You will likely thrive here if:
 


* You enjoy solving growth problems through data and experimentation
* You are comfortable owning outcomes, not just activities
* You think in traffic, leads, conversions, and revenue
* You enjoy identifying opportunities others miss
* You are analytical, curious, and execution\-focused

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability

 A marketing degree is not mandatory.
 



 Strong execution capability, curiosity, and ownership matter more.
 



  





**The impact you will have** 



* You directly influence customer acquisition and business growth
* You help customers discover Zolo through search
* You improve marketing efficiency and ROI
* You build scalable growth channels that contribute to long\-term revenue growth



  





**Why join now** 




 Zolo is entering its next phase of growth across multiple business lines.
 



 Search and performance marketing will play a critical role in:
 


* Customer acquisition
* Revenue growth
* Brand visibility
* Long\-term scalability

title: Head of Marketing
description:
**Head of Marketing** 




**Location** 
 : Bengaluru,India
 



 Reports to the Chief Product Officer
 



  





**About Deep Cognition** 




 Deep Cognition builds AI automation for freight forwarding and customs brokerage. Freight forwarding runs on people and paperwork. We build the AI that handles the repetitive work so teams can focus on customers.We have two products. Agentic TMS is a transportation management system run by AI agents. The agents handle quoting, booking, customs filing, and invoicing across the shipment lifecycle. PaperEntry AI is intelligent document processing. It reads commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading, and customs entries with 99 percent or better accuracy. Together they let a forwarder or broker move 5 to 10 times more volume with the same team.Our customers include C.H. Robinson, Maersk, JAS Worldwide, Dachser, and Rohlig Logistics. We process over $1 billion in goods each year.
 



 We are an early stage company with a small, fast team. Our headquarters is in Dallas, Texas. Our engineering and marketing teams are in Bengaluru. Our customers are in the US, Canada, Europe, and Asia.
 



  





**The role :** 




 We are hiring a Head of Marketing to own our pipeline. You will report to the Chief Product Officer, who currently leads marketing. Your job is simple to state. Grow the number of qualified leads. Turn those leads into sales meetings. Make our brand the one forwarders and brokers think of when they think about AI for logistics. This is a hands on leadership role. You will set the strategy. You will also run campaigns yourself. You will manage a small in house team and a bench of external contractors and agencies.
 



  





**What we are looking for :** 



* 8 or more years in B2B marketing. At least 3 years leading a team or a function.
* Experience at an early stage startup. You have built marketing from a small base with a small budget.
* A track record of growing pipeline. You can show the numbers.
* Experience managing external contractors and agencies. You know how to brief, measure, and replace vendors.
* Strong writing. You can produce a clear email, landing page, or one pager without an agency.
* Comfort with data. You know your cost per lead, conversion rates, and pipeline sources.
* Based in Bengaluru or willing to relocate. Hybrid work from our Bengaluru office.
* Able to work with a US based leadership team. Some evening calls each week.



  





**What you will do :** 



* Own the lead pipeline target. Report on it weekly.
* Run demand generation across email outbound, LinkedIn, paid search, SEO, webinars, and trade shows.
* Build and manage the marketing tech stack.
* Manage external contractors for content, design, video, paid media and appointment setting. Set clear briefs. Hold them to results.
* Write and edit content that speaks to freight forwarders and customs brokers. Cover both Agentic TMS and PaperEntry AI.
* Plan our conference and trade show calendar. Run our presence at events.
* Work with Sales on lead handoff, follow up, and conversion.
* Work with Product on positioning, launches, and customer stories.
* Own our website and our presence on review and analyst sites.
* Hire and coach a small marketing team as we grow.



  





**It would be great if you have :** 



* Logistics, freight, customs, or supply chain industry experience. This is our ideal profile.
* Experience marketing to US and European buyers from India.
* Experience marketing AI agents, TMS, or document automation products.
* Experience with outbound prospecting and sales engagement tools.



  





**Why join :** 



* Own the marketing function end to end. Report directly to the leadership team.
* Two products customers love. Our users save hours every day.
* A real market. Logistics is a multi trillion dollar industry that still runs on paper.
* Hybrid flexibility. Work from home part of the week.

* Health \& Wellness: Comprehensive healthcare coverage for you and your dependents.

 As the global leader in AI\-powered recruitment marketing, we are transforming talent attraction and recruitment media buying for the world’s largest and smartest employers, staffing businesses, RPOs, and recruitment advertising agencies.

Powering millions of jobs every day, our data\-driven recruitment marketing platform uses advanced data science and machine learning to dynamically manage and optimize talent sourcing and applications across all online channels while providing real\-time insights at every step of the job seeker journey, from click to hire.
 



  





 This is an
 **in\-office, high\-ownership** 
 role for a sharp, ambitious individual looking to dive deep into the mechanics of B2B SaaS marketing strategy, with a heavy emphasis on digital execution and data analytics. You won't just be assisting; you’ll be contributing to core business outcomes.

 You will be embedded within our dynamic marketing team, gaining hands\-on experience across the strategic and tactical layers of a global marketing organization.
 



  





**1\. Digital Strategy \& Campaign Management** 



* Own the execution and initial analysis of digital marketing campaigns across Meta (Facebook, Instagram), Google Ads, and emerging B2B platforms.

* Explore the strategic principles of programmatic advertising, advanced audience targeting, and rigorous A/B testing to inform future strategy.

* Assist in building, testing, and deploying email and SMS re\-engagement campaigns that directly impact our lead nurture funnel.
* Focus on optimization—from template readability and mobile responsiveness to ensuring impeccable quality control (grammar, spelling, and formatting).
* Track detailed campaign performance and translate results into concrete recommendations for improving audience engagement.



  





**3\. Marketing Analytics \& Business Intelligence** 



* Become proficient with core marketing tools: Google Analytics, CRM (Salesforce/Hubspot), and advanced Excel for data manipulation and reporting.
* Help synthesize raw data into clear, concise reports and strategic insights that influence executive decision\-making.
* Develop a foundational understanding of SEO, SEM, and crucial marketing performance metrics (CPA, ROAS, LTV) within a B2B context.



  





**4\. Cross\-Functional Strategic Support** 



* Collaborate closely with Product, Sales, and Content teams to support high\-priority, ongoing marketing initiatives.
* Maintain critical marketing documentation, track project deliverables, and ensure strategic alignment across all projects.
* Conduct high\-value research, including deep competitor analysis and market trends, to inform content and strategic planning.



  





**The Tech Stack You'll Master:** 




 Get hands\-on experience with the tools that power a high\-growth tech company:
 


* **Core Platforms:** 
 Excel, CRM, Google Analytics, Advanced Email \& SMS marketing platforms.
* **Ad Platforms:** 
 Direct exposure to Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager.
* **Analytics \& SEO** 
 : Learn the ropes with top\-tier SEO/SEM tools like SEMRush.



  





**Who You Are:** 




 This role is for the
 **future marketing leader** 
 —someone who is curious, results\-oriented, and thrives in a fast\-paced environment.
 


* Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related analytical field.
* A data\-driven mindset is non\-negotiable—you love solving problems with data and are fascinated by digital platforms.
* Exceptional analytical, critical thinking, and communication skills (written and verbal).
* Highly adaptable and capable of managing multiple priorities in a dynamic, high\-growth environment.
* Bonus: Any prior exposure to digital marketing (personal projects, coursework, previous internships) is a plus, but your raw potential and drive are what matter most.



  





**What You’ll Gain:** 
 Your Acceleration Path
 


* **Real\-World Impact:** 
 You'll work on live, global campaigns that directly contribute to Joveo's growth. No busy work.
* **Advanced Toolset:** 
 Master cutting\-edge ad technologies and marketing analytics tools used by top B2B firms.
* **Mentorship:** 
 Learn the ropes from industry experts and work within a collaborative, fast\-moving marketing team.
* **Career Pipeline:** 
 This internship is a highly visible, performance\-based opportunity with a clear and strong potential pathway to a full\-time role.



  





**Build the next chapter of Joveo. Apply now**

title: Senior Marketing Manager, Social Commerce
description:
**Description**
 Do you believe video is worth a thousand words when it comes to helping you decide what to buy online? Come join the team that is redefining how Amazon customers use videos to make better purchase decisions! Our vision is to help customers discover and shop with confidence through trusted video content created by influencers and sellers. We will seamlessly blend content with commerce, inspiring and informing millions of customers through their buying journeys. At Amazon, we continuously look for opportunities to invent on behalf of our customers, helping them find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. We are reshaping customer buying behavior on Amazon through these creator powered ‘Amazon Shopping Videos’, which includes both Livestreams as well as short\-form videos.
   

  

 We are looking for an analytical and results\-oriented Sr. Product Marketing Manager to lead this Video/Social Commerce marketing charter for India. You will build and launch new product marketing initiatives, drive Go\-To\-Market strategies and help drive awareness and traffic for the program. You will be working closely with Business, Product, Business Intelligence and Tech teams to drive exponential growth for the program in the next 3 years. You will have exceptional product marketing, communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work independently to deliver results. A successful candidate for this role will be an independent, creative problem\-solver with great business acumen who can think big and has the ability to lead multiple projects simultaneously while managing competing deadlines.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Grow adoption of ‘Amazon Shopping Videos’ by driving awareness, demand, and acquisition through marketing campaigns across multiple (onsite and offsite) digital channels.
* Develop and deliver GTM strategies and frameworks, which are scalable and repeatable across various product feature launches.
* Conduct customer research to develop insights and enhanced brand positioning to stay competitive in this growing space.
* Oversee strategy, execution, and performance of cross channel marketing plans to build awareness, adoption and engagement of key features.
* Partner with product teams to develop product roadmaps for features meant to drive Monthly Active Users (MAUs), engagement and retention for the program.
* Analyze and report on performance metrics and set up test plans to improve the campaign performance.
* Drive regular reviews of roadmap progress and results with leadership.


 A day in the life
   

  

 The role will require influencing multi\-functional stakeholders and working with local and international teams. You will be working to grow adoption of this product across different customer segments, and work with a cross\-functional organization that includes product, engineering, UX design, and program management. Additionally, you will own and manage all creator facing educational materials. Successful candidates will be strong leaders who can prioritize well, communicate clearly, and have a strong track record of delivery. You are comfortable taking initiative and working across teams in a relatively unstructured environment.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 6\+ years of professional non\-internship marketing experience
* Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
* Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
* Experience building, executing and scaling cross\-functional marketing programs
* Experience leading go\-to\-market for consumer software or hardware product launches


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience using any of SQL or other analytical tools for conducting data analysis
* Experience with customer segmentation, profiling, and targeting
* Master's degree in marketing, advertising, business or equivalent

description:
**About Goodera** 




  





 Goodera is the world’s leading platform for employee engagement, helping companies build meaningful, purpose\-driven workplace experiences through employee volunteering. We partner with 500\+ enterprises, including 75 Fortune 500 companies like IBM, ServiceNow, and Amazon to help teams connect with purpose while driving social impact. Operating across 100\+ countries and 30\+ languages, Goodera delivers hosted volunteering and team engagement experiences \- virtual, in\-person, and hybrid \- through a network of 2,500\+ hosts. In 2025 alone, we facilitated 10,000\+ experiences engaging over 500,000 employees worldwide. With consistent 100% YoY growth and profitability since April 2024, Goodera is backed by leading investors including Elevation Capital, Nexus Venture Partners, Omidyar Network, Zoom Ventures, xto10x, and Ursula Burns.
 



  





 Goodera enables end\-to\-end employee engagement programs, with a core focus on corporate volunteering. We help organizations design and deliver meaningful experiences that drive both employee engagement and social impact.
 



  





 What we do:
 


* End\-to\-end program management: Design and execute corporate volunteering initiatives from concept to completion
* Curated opportunities: Match organizations with the right experiences from our global catalog of volunteering activities
* Program planning \& participation: Support timelines, campaigns, and communications to drive employee registrations
* Hosted experiences: Deliver engaging, high\-quality sessions led by trained Goodera hosts who guide, orient, and contextualize each experience

 This transformation together with Lenovo’s world\-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.
   

  

**Manager, Content Platform Governance**
**Position Summary**
 The Program Manager, Content Platform Governance will execute the day\-to\-day operating model of the company’s sales enablement content ecosystem, with Highspot as the primary platform. This role ensures sellers can quickly find trusted, relevant, current content within their workflow and that content owners follow consistent standards for publishing, metadata, lifecycle management, and measurement.
   

  

 The role is responsible for applying established governance standards and operating processes to ensure sales content is accurate, current, discoverable, properly tagged, and managed consistently. The successful candidate will be highly organized, detail\-oriented, and comfortable coordinating across content owners, publishers, Sales, Marketing, Sales Enablement, and IT.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Operate and maintain the established Highspot governance model, including content structure, navigation, metadata, publishing standards, and lifecycle processes.
* Administer daily platform activities, including user access, publisher support, Spot and page updates, publishing coordination, and issue resolution.
* Review content submissions for required metadata, ownership, naming conventions, approvals, and alignment to publishing standards.
* Coordinate content lifecycle activities, including scheduled reviews, content updates, archival, retirement, and remediation of outdated or duplicate materials.
* Maintain accurate content records, governance trackers, publisher lists, and documentation of standards and operating procedures.
* Conduct routine platform\-health and content\-quality audits; identify gaps and coordinate remediation with publishers and content owners.
* Support content owners and publishers with training, guidance, and practical assistance in using Highspot and following governance requirements.
* Produce recurring reporting on content health, metadata completion, publishing activity, aging content, platform usage, and publisher compliance.
* Help translate reporting insights into clear action lists for content owners, business groups, and governance reviews.

title: Senior Partnerships Manager - US
description:
Sprinto is an
 **Autonomous Trust Platform** 
 that centralizes trust requirements across
 **security frameworks, vendors, and customers.**
 Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.
   

  

 Backed by top\-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve
 **raised** 
**$31\.8M** 
 in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over
 **4,000 organizations across 75 countries** 
 , Sprinto helps organizations stay audit\-ready, manage real\-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With
 **300\+ native integrations** 
 and AI\-driven automation, Sprinto supports
 **200\+ global security standards natively** 
 , including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI\-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.
   

  

**Founded in 2020** 
 by second\-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.
   

  

**Life as a Sprinter \-**
 Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.
   

  

 We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.
   

  

 Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.
   

  

 We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.
   

  

 And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.
   

  

**The mission \-**
 We're hiring a
 **Partnership Manager** 
 to build and scale Sprinto's partner ecosystem. This role is about creating long\-term revenue through strategic partnerships, not just managing existing relationships.
   

  

 You'll identify, recruit, and enable consulting firms, channel partners, resellers, system integrators, and managed service providers who can take Sprinto to new customers and markets. From building the partner pipeline to driving joint go\-to\-market initiatives and co\-selling opportunities, you'll own the partner journey end to end.
   

  

 We're looking for someone who understands that successful partnerships are built on mutual growth. Someone who can influence senior stakeholders, create repeatable partner programs, and turn relationships into predictable pipeline and revenue.
   

  

**Where you'll leave your mark?**
* Build and scale Sprinto's partner ecosystem by recruiting consulting firms, MSPs, MSSPs, system integrators, resellers, and channel partners
* Own the end\-to\-end partner lifecycle, from prospecting and qualification to onboarding, enablement, and long\-term success
* Design and execute joint go\-to\-market strategies, including co\-selling, co\-marketing, and partner\-led growth initiatives
* Develop partner enablement assets, business plans, sales collateral, and value proposition decks to help partners sell Sprinto effectively
* Partner closely with Sales teams on strategic opportunities and participate in customer conversations alongside partners
* Track partner health through pipeline generation, deal registrations, win rates, deal velocity, and overall revenue contribution
* Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to align on business goals, performance, and growth opportunities
* Own partner operations, including CRM and PRM hygiene, partner tiering, deal registration processes, and reporting
* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success teams to launch partner programs and campaigns that accelerate growth


**The kind of builder we're looking for \-**
* 5–8 years of overall experience, including 3\+ years in SaaS partnerships, alliances, channel sales, or ecosystem roles
* Must have recent experience building and scaling partner programs across US
* Strong understanding of partner\-led GTM motions, channel sales, and indirect revenue models
* Proven ability to recruit, enable, and grow strategic partners that contribute measurable pipeline and revenue
* Strong commercial acumen with experience supporting or participating in enterprise sales cycles
* Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship\-building skills across executive and operational stakeholders
* Experience working cross\-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success teams
* Highly organized, self\-driven, and comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment


 This Role Is Ideal For Someone Who
   

  

  

* Enjoys building partnerships from scratch instead of simply managing existing accounts
* Thinks beyond partner recruitment and focuses on long\-term partner success and revenue generation
* Can balance strategic relationship\-building with operational excellence
* Loves collaborating across teams to create scalable GTM programs
* Is energized by building new markets and expanding partner ecosystems
* Measures success by partner\-generated pipeline, revenue, and long\-term business impact


**How we care for our Sprinters?**
* Co\-working, on the house: If co\-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance
* We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills
* We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to
* Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary
* Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you


**Inclusion \& Diversity \-**
 At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.
   

  

 We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Growth Champion
description:
**About Be Limitless** 


 Be Limitless is a feature\-rich job search marketplace — built as a hybrid of Naukri.com, Instagram, and LinkedIn. The platform brings together customers (employers and recruiters) and candidates (job seekers) in one place, with the discovery and engagement layer of a social platform and the intent\-driven matching of a job board.
 





 We are well\-funded and putting real capital behind scaling this platform aggressively.
 



**The Opportunity** 


 We've built the product. What we haven't cracked yet is the classic marketplace cold\-start problem: getting both sides — customers and candidates — active on the platform at the same time, and keeping them there.
 





 This role exists to solve exactly that. There is no existing playbook to execute — the person in this role will build one from scratch, through direct hustle, before it becomes a repeatable growth motion for a wider team to scale.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 

 •     Own early\-stage growth across both sides of the marketplace — customers and candidates — as a single, accountable owner of the cold\-start problem.
 



 •     Personally drive acquisition of the first 100 customers and the first 1 lakh candidates through direct outreach, partnerships, community\-building, and hands\-on growth tactics.
 



 •     Design and run unconventional, low\-cost go\-to\-market experiments; double down on what works and kill what doesn't.
 



 •     Build the early acquisition and retention playbook — the foundation a growth team will scale once traction is proven.
 



 •     Work closely with product and marketing to turn direct market feedback into fast platform improvements.
 



 •     Track and report on growth metrics, and iterate quickly based on data rather than assumption.
 



 •     Act as the face of Be Limitless in the market during this early phase — building direct relationships with founding customers and candidate communities.
 



  




**What We're Looking For** 

 •     Proven experience scaling a two\-sided marketplace or platform from zero to meaningful traction — ideally in job search, recruitment, social, or consumer tech.
 



 •     A genuinely entrepreneurial mindset: comfortable without a playbook, biased toward action over process.
 



 •     Strong sales and business development instincts, with a track record of personally closing early customers.
 



 •     A young, high\-energy, hands\-on operator — this is a builder role first, not a management role, in its early phase.
 



 •     Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid iteration in a startup\-like environment.
 



 •     Excellent communication skills — equally credible speaking to a corporate customer and a first\-time job seeker.
 



  




**Nice to Have** 

 •     Experience in recruitment, HR\-tech, job search, or talent marketplace businesses.
 



 •     A track record in growth hacking, community\-led growth, or content/influencer\-driven acquisition.
 



 •     An existing network among employers, recruiters, and/or job seekers in India.
 



  




**What You'll Get** 

 •     Genuine ownership of strategy and execution — not implementation of someone else's plan.
 



 •     The chance to build a category\-defining platform from the ground up, backed by serious capital.
 



 •     Competitive compensation with performance\-linked incentives tied to the growth you drive.
 



 •     Direct access to, and mentorship from, the founding leadership team.
 



  




**How to Apply** 


 Send your resume along with a short note on how you've solved a similar cold\-start problem before — what you did, and what the results were — to \[add application email / link].
